title: ‹Destination› Errand
description:
Got a box sitting at <EM4>‹Location›</EM4> that needs to make its way over to <EM4>‹Destination›</EM4>. Any chance you can knock this out real quick?

Might be the easiest gig I’ve ever assigned out. Only real threat would be tripping over your own feet. A <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> would also be smart to bring along. 

Stows out.

title: ‹Destination› Stroll
description:
Any chance you’re at ‹Destination›?

Need a box hustled from <EM4>the entrance inside Gaslight at the L2 Lagrange of Pyro V</EM4> to <EM4>‹Destination›</EM4>. Get it there on time and unbroken and it’ll be the easiest creds you’ll ever earn.   

-Smokey

title: ‹Location› has been greenlit
description:
Word came down from the Judge that we're to hit ‹Location›. It's owned by CFP and security there have been less than hospitable to some of the locals, so they gotta go.

They may talk a big game about bringing security, but they got guns and are more than happy to use 'em.

Stows out.

title: ‹Location› needs help
description:
We just received reports of a massive attack against ‹Location› by a large group of armed individuals led by ‹Target Name›, a notorious outlaw who has been threatening Citizens for Prosperity personnel for months. Details are still yet to be confirmed but we know there have been multiple casualties.

Citizens for Prosperity is looking for any qualified security personnel to go and retake the outposts from these hostile elements. Our understanding is that ‹Target Name› tends to hide behind their soldiers, but will emerge if you take enough of the rank-and-file out.

While we don't like to resort to violence, management can see no other way of resolving this situation and continuing our good work in the system.

Good luck,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

title: ‹ship› clean up
description:
Got a particular salvage job that we could use some extra hands on. 

We need you to find a ‹ship› that got punched out around ‹location›. Security’s already searching for it and if they find it, they’ll ID it for sure and we’ll be in loads of trouble.

So, we want you to make sure that can’t happen. Either tow the ship out of the search area or rip the entire hull off so nobody can tell who it belonged to. Whatever you decide, keep your mouth shut about this. 

We’ll cred you up and anything you scrap is yours to keep. But if security finds the ship before you’re done, we’ll all be screwed and you won’t get paid so don’t disappoint.

Do it quick and clean.

Stows out.

title: ‹Target Name› Reported Missing
description:
ABOUT THE JOB
After receiving a report that ‹Target Name› has been missing, microTech Protection Services is seeking a qualified contractor to begin an onsite search of Lobby to learn their current whereabouts. The missing individual was last seen entering the Lobby so it's recommended to begin the search there.

RESPONSIBILITIES
• Provide own transportation to Lobby.
• Confirm the location of ‹Target Name› and if they are still alive.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
• 2 years security experience.
• Available for immediate deployment.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
• Experience with conducting missing person investigations.

title: ‹Target Name› Vanished
description:
I’ve got people left and right askin’ me if I know what happened to ‹Target Name›. Now personally, I’d be more than happy to see ‘em gone for good, but for whatever reason they got friends in high places demanding answers.

I can’t spare any of my people to go on a wild goose chase, so I'm looking for the perfect candidate to go over to Abandoned Section and find out what happened to ‹Target Name›. You’ll get paid if you find where they are.

10 credits says they got way too high and passed out in a dark corner somewhere.

-Smokey

title: ‹Target Name›’s Time Has Come
description:
We’ve had our sights set on taking out ‹Target Name› for a while now, but we’ve never been able to find the right moment. Enough waiting. You’re going to create the right moment for us.

Head to Lobby and take out a bunch of lowlifes running around the Lobby. Kill enough of those losers, and ‹Target Name› will have no choice but to come face you themselves. That’s when you take ‘em out and earn yourself a nice fat payday.

title: A Batch from Scratch
description:
Normally, I like to cook everything from scratch myself. Pride in product and all. But every once in a while, whether it's too much demand or too much heat or whatever, I need to rely on other labs for an order. 

My hands are tied up here though, so I could use someone to help oversee the whole production line for me. Couldn't think of anyone better and more available than you.

* TO-DO LIST *

1. PROCESSING - Take the raw material from  ‹Pickup 1› to ‹Pickup 2›
2. PACKAGING - Take the refined product from  ‹Pickup 2› to ‹Pickup 3›
3. DISTRIBUTION - Take the finished goods from  ‹Pickup 3› to ‹Drop Off 1›

Just don't get distracted in the middle and wander off. It happens more often than you'd think. Manage to finish the full list, and I'll see to it you get nice cut of the profits.

-Wallace

title: A Call to Arms
description:
The Civilian Defense Force needs YOU! Everyday, in the Stanton system innocent civilians are preyed upon by vicious outlaws and heartless criminals.

NO MORE.

Under the authority of the UEE and the Militia Mobilization Initiative, the CDF is deputizing all combat minded individuals in good legal standing* to engage and neutralize any individuals or vehicles that they verify to have an active CrimeStat.

In exchange for these selfless contributions to the general populaces safety, the CDF will financially compensate those who successfully bring these criminals to justice with a reward** of ‹Reward Value Wanted 1› UEC per outlaw dealt with. 

Now is your chance to help bring about a positive change for yourself and all other Stanton travelers. Sign up today and do your part!

* Be aware, acquiring a CrimeStat will revoke CDF membership and cancel any outstanding contracts.
** Please note, criminals encountered as part of paid contract work do not qualify for the reward.

title: A Chance to Impress
description:
Firstly, allow me to introduce myself. To put it rather dramatically, I deal in lives. 

People hire me when some soul needs to be extinguished, and I in return employ the perfect person to serve as the extinguishant. This provides security to all parties involved as none know the identity of the other. An ideal situation as far as these things go.

I was recently made aware that you may possess skills that would make you of service to me and decided that it would be worthwhile to pursue the validity of this claim. 
 
If you have any interest in forging a working relationship, I will need a demonstration of said skills. 

Seek out and discreetly kill ‹Target Name› over at ‹Location›.

Do so successfully and you will be rewarded. Not only that, but you will have proven yourself worthy of further consideration.

Sincerely,
Vaughn

title: A Fond Farewell
enemyShips: Anvil F7C-M Super Hornet Mk I
description:
It is with deep disappointment that I send this message. A peerless contractor of ours was out on a job, but it seems like the target may have gotten the better of them.

I need you to travel to <EM4>‹Location›</EM4> and see if our contractor, <EM4>‹Target Name›</EM4>, is truly gone.

I suspect that the location will be somewhat chaotic since there will most likely still be multiple threats on site. Therefore, a supporting crew is strongly advised.

Sincerely,

Vaughn

title: A little retaliation
description:
Been getting word that CFP security have been getting a little more aggressive and started pushing people out of the homes they've built out of the scrap in the system and they want payback, so they came to us.

Head out to ‹Location› and clear out the CFP there. Should be pretty cut and dry with a nice payday.

Stows out.

title: A Mother's Plea
description:
My son Nico was sadly among the victims of the tragic accident at Covelex's Gundo station and they still haven't returned all of his personal possessions to me. I understand that they have to do things according to regulations, but it seems unconscionable that they wouldn't make some allowances for the grieving family members. To that end, I'm seeking someone who will be able to go to the station for me. To be clear, Gundo is currently considered off limits, meaning that this would not be above board, but I feel my situation warrants special consideration. My sister says that the rate I am offering is the correct amount for retrieving the crate with Nico's belongings (#964) and bringing them to ‹Destination›, so hopefully I can find a competent individual to settle this matter quickly.

Sincerely,
Gloria Theolone

title: A Swift Reprisal
description:
Hey,

Some two-bit thugs are holed up in ‹Location›. Wouldn’t pay them any mind, except the arrogant skags tried to hit an outpost under our protection.

We chased 'em off with little trouble, but we can't let that kind of disrespect go unpunished. Our Clips are busy with some bigger fish, so we'd like you to take care of this for us. 

Stows out.

title: A Well Deserved Break
description:
There is a member of the Nyx gang the Claw Salamanders, ‹Target Name›, who has made it on to my naughty list. They had been on the run for quite awhile, but just recently popped back up at an old mining station in the Keeger Belt. Our lucky day shall be their last.  

Word is that you can find them at ‹Location›.  Unfortunately, there is a strong chance you may have to do some repairs to the station itself before you can gain access to that particular area.

But I'm sure you're more than up to the challenge.

Sincerely,
Vaughn

description:
Adagio Holdings
A Proud Equal Opportunity Employer

> About us <
As the leading procurer and distributor of salvage rights, Adagio Holdings are now looking to expand into the acquisition and distribution of salvageable materials to both small and large-scale businesses.

> About the job <
As a part of this initiative, we need keen-eyed contractors capable of identifying salvageable materials, efficiently stripping them, and delivering the Recycle Material Composite (RMC) and salvaged components to us.

This introductory contract will require you to head to <EM4>‹Location›</EM4> and strip an abandoned ship approved for salvage.

Once you've gathered the RMC, you'll deliver it to the freight elevator located at <EM4>Levski</EM4>.

> Requirements <
     - Any class/size of salvage ship

For advice on salvaging, consult <EM4>A Salvager's Guide to Material Collection</EM4> in your mobiGlas journal.

> Disclaimer <
Contractors are responsible for ensuring that they are collecting materials from vehicles that are considered fair salvage under the pursuant UEE laws. Adagio Holdings is in no way liable for any crimes or misdemeanors committed by contractors and will offer no compensation or reparation for any persons affected by these actions.

title: Additional Resources For Research

requires.title: Interested in Building a Better Future?

description:
To all available contractors,

Rayari scientists are hard at work trying to solve the issues with failing regen tech. Currently, their efforts are hindered by a lack of materials which they believe could be essential for their experiments.  

In particular, our scientists at <EM4>‹Destination›</EM4> have had to put their work on hold after running out of those resources. With a restock from our normal provider not possible for months owing to short supply, we’ll pay a premium to anyone who can assist with restocking the materials.

For more information on the animals in question, refer to "Explorer's Guide to Harvestables" in your Journal.

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing

title: Aid The Blockade
description:
Now that Crusader’s found their fleet, it seems the Nine Tails finally realized just how useful a bit of extra help can be.

Long story short, they’re looking for some hired muscle to keep Crusader at bay. You’ll and everyone else who volunteers get a payout for every security ship you take down. 

And on top of that, if all of you keep Crusader occupied long enough for the Nine Tails to finish up whatever the hell it is that they’re up to with this quantum blockade, you’ll get a big fat bonus.

title: Alert: ‹Location› under attack
description:
We need any available security personnel to report to ‹Location›. A group of armed individuals have attacked one of our outpost clusters and we're in desperate need of help. Although the group seems to be unaffiliated with any of the known gangs, we've received word that their leader is ‹Target Name›, a local outlaw with a vicious reputation.

Please head out as soon as you can and secure the area by taking out the outlaws and ‹Target Name›.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

title: All Things Come To An End
description:
They say there is no honor among thieves. Today, it seems, you're targeting one of your own. 

Please head to ‹Location› and kill ‹Target Name›. What you do with the others there is entirely up to you.

Earnestly,
Vaughn

title: All Things Come To An End
description:
I am not sure if you’re acquainted with ‹Location›, but ‹Target Name› is the one who calls the shots there. I need them eliminated.

That is easier said then done, I'm afraid. They are notoriously reluctant to see to matters personally, preferring their underlings to handle the dirty work. That said, eliminate enough of the underlings and they will have no choice but to deal with you themselves.

Earnestly,
Vaughn

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

With all these Alliance Aid ships hauling valuable cargo around, outlaws in the area have gone into a feeding frenzy. We just got word of one of their latest targets via emergency beacon and need you to go over to the <EM4>‹Location›</EM4>, assess the situation, <EM4>neutralize any remaining hostiles</EM4> in the area, and if needed, secure the shipment for delivery to <EM4>Levski</EM4>.

Be sure to bring a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to handle the cargo. 

This contract is non-negotiable.

description:
All right, this one is going to be a bit different. See, with everything going on with Alliance Aid, we had a screw up with our contracts and an important shipment got overlooked. Since lives are at stake, and you've already done so much to help the Transport Division, I was kinda hoping that you'd be able to step up and do a double run for us?

There's a medium scale haul of <EM4>Molina Mold treatment on microtech</EM4> and shipment of <EM4>ventilation filters on Hurston</EM4> waiting for pick-up. You'll need to make both stops, load up everything, and bring it all to <EM4>Levski</EM4>. 
 
To handle the cargo, your ship should be big enough to carry cargo containers up to <EM4>2 SCU</EM4> in size. 

And I would double check to make sure you have your <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you before heading out. Would be a huge headache if you forgot to bring one!  

It's really amazing of you to be helping out like this,

Ella Tieno 
Jr. Logistics Coordinator 
Covalex Shipping  
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

title: Alliance Aid: Escort Needed
description:
Citizens for Prosperity need a combat-experienced pilot to provide extra support to an Alliance Aid pilot who is making a vital trip from <EM4>Asteroid Mining Base</EM4> for the ongoing relief effort. 

Outlaws have been launching more attacks thanks to the increased activity brought on by the Molina Mold outbreak, so it’ll be your job to make sure that they stay safe while they’re completing their work. This route is relatively safe, so I'm not expecting too much trouble, but its better not to take the risk.

If you’re interested, you’ll rendezvous there and await further instructions.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

We've been able to track the group to <EM4>‹Location›</EM4>, but before you head out, you're going to need to some recruiting of your own. Unless you <EM4>take a few wingmen with you</EM4>, not sure you'll be able to neutralize this particular outlaw pack.

title: Ambush XenoThreat Strike Wing
description:
Been handed some strong intel on a XenoThreat strike wing's flightpath. Looking for contractors who can dust off now and be set up at <EM4>‹Location›</EM4> ahead of them. Local conditions will mask your scanner signatures so you can give them the surprise of their lives. Let's turn the hunters into the hunted.

Interested?

Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

title: An Unprecedented Opportunity

description:
It has recently been brought to my attention that you may possess a set of skills that could be beneficial to the both of us.

Should you recognise my name, I have no doubt that you will be aware of the nature of my business. I am an intermediatory. I deal with the tedious logistics in order to execute the wishes of my clients. 

If you are interested in pursuing this line of work, I will first require proof of your abilities.

Let’s start simple. A client is very interested in discerning the current health of  <EM4>‹Target Name›</EM4> and are hoping we can deliver them some bad news. Their last contact with them placed their ship around <EM4>‹Location›</EM4>.

If they have indeed shed this mortal coil, confirm their condition via your mobiGlas, then we may yet have more work for you.

Sincerely,
Vaughn

title: Annihilate Sentries
description:
Recent scans discovered several orbital sentries and ships at ‹location›. We believe they’re part of an espionage campaign targeting XenoThreat, in response to our recent actions in the Stanton system. Seems XenoThreat must be doing something right, if they’re out here spying like this.

We’re looking for an experienced and highly-skilled merc willing to eliminate this operation. If you don’t want Pyro to become a surveillance system, then this is your chance to stop it. The sentries probably won’t be too big of an issue, but pay mind to the patrol ships. If they manage to break away, you’ll have a whole lot more trouble breathing down your neck. 

You’ll have our gratitude and a sizable payment once the job is done. 

Comm. Spec. Engler

title: Another Attempt at Red Wind Delivery
description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

Even though we haven't hired you in a while, we could use the extra help right now.

PACKAGES FOR PICK UP (ANY ORDER)
     · Package <EM4>#‹Item 1›</EM4> from the <EM4>‹Pickup 1›</EM4>
     · Package <EM4>#‹Item 2›</EM4> from the <EM4>‹Pickup 2›</EM4>
     · Package <EM4>#‹Item 3›</EM4> from the <EM4>‹Pickup 3›</EM4>

DROP OFF LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)

     · Package <EM4>#‹Item 2›</EM4> to the <EM4>‹Dropoff 2›</EM4>
     · Package <EM4>#‹Item 3›</EM4> to the <EM4>‹Dropoff 3›</EM4>

If you pull this delivery off, we can see about making it a more regular thing again. And don't forget to pack a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to bring along. 

‹Contractor›

title: Another Chance to Impress
description:
It is not often in life that we get another chance to make a first impression, but I am going to provide to you with just that.

To say I was disappointed in how things last transpired on your last assassination attempt would be a severe understatement. However, here is your chance to prove yourself capable of more. 

Kill ‹Target Name› over at ‹Location› and I will consider the slate wiped clean. 

Sincerely,
Vaughn

title: Apprehend Bounty: ‹Target Name› (HRT)
description:
ABOUT THE JOB
microTech Protection Services is looking for a qualified bounty hunter to apprehend ‹Target Name› who has so far been able to evade capture. They are coordinating an active raid at Inventory Center, and we believe that they may finally be lured out of hiding if their forces there attacking the Inventory Center are faced with strong enough resistance. 

RESPONSIBILITIES
• Provide own transportation to Inventory Center.
• Neutralize ‹Target Name›’s criminal associates near the Inventory Center to draw the target into the open.
• Neutralize ‹Target Name›; using force if necessary.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
• Access to combat equipment and mode of transport.
• Available for immediate deployment.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
• Ability to handle high pressure situations.

description:
MISSION SPECS

Area of Operation: Nyx System 
Hostile Forces: Vanduul
Equipment Specs: Combat Ready
Briefing: 
An Idris-class People's Alliance security vessel named Tranquility is currently engaged with a <EM>Vanduul capital ship</EM4> near an old <EM4>QV Extraction station</EM4> and Intersec is looking for combat pilots to lend some support.

Scramble to the AO and <EM4>engage Vanduul fighters so the Tranquility can focus on the capital ship</EM4>.

Deacon Tobin 
Operations Manager 
InterSec Defense Solutions  

This communication consists of confidential information solely intended for the recipient. Please disregard if received in error and notify the sender. All operations are conducted at the contractor’s own personal risk and must adhere to UEE and system law where applicable.

title: Assist Retreating Ship
description:
One of our people is currently under attack at ‹Location›. They have attempted to elude their attackers to get to safely, but the outlaws have proven too skilled for them to break away. 

We need you to fly there, engage with the attackers, and then destroy the nearby fuel reserves. The hope is that this display of destruction will dissuade them from continuing pursuit.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

description:

description:

Citizens for Prosperity

title: Away From Prying Eyes
description:
I told the Nine Tails that blocking quantum travel to hold a whole area hostage was gonna attract the wrong kind of attention, but do they listen to me? No. Now Crusader’s got dozens of scanning ships out there poking their noses into things I’d rather stay hidden. 

That’s why I'm trying to hire as many people as I can to help me out. I wanna pay you for each Crusader scanning ship you take out. 

In fact, I’ll even up your rate per-ship if all of you hit a certain number of kills. Call it a performance incentive.

And if you're really feeling like an overachiever, take out any fools brave enough to try running cargo to the blockaded station. I've got some suppliers who'll be appreciative of the extra demand.

title: Back up needed at outpost
description:
Those XenoThreat punks launched an attack against ‹Location› so we're looking for people to go fend them off. 

Get out there and waste every XenoThreat you see.

Stows out.

title: Backup Needed Now
description:
Some People’s Alliance members with a death wish decided to target one of our ships. Need someone to hustle over to <EM4>‹Location›</EM4> and show ‘em what happens when you mess with the Headhunters.

Stows out.

description:
Got a big job for a big player. We’re in the process of making someone disappear, like completely vanish, and a part of that is recovering the blackbox from the “accident” that they had recently over at <EM4>‹Location›</EM4>.
Only problem is, seems the people this person hired to stage the accident have gotten it in their heads that there’s more money to be made. So much so that they’re still keeping tabs on the now deceased’s ship.
These guys aren’t playing around either. You’ll need a couple of friends to help you do this. But if you can get the blackbox out of there and into our hands by dropping it at <EM4>[Destination|Target|Address]</EM4>, we can really make it worth your while.

-Bit Zeros

title: BlacJac Bounty Trial Contract
description:
ATTN: Former BlacJac Bounty Hunter

I know BlacJac stopped giving you bounty contracts, but times change and here we are giving you another chance.

If you're able to complete the bounty on ‹Target Name› over at ‹Location› then we can see about getting you reinstated.

Thanks,
Gloria Mesa

Private Contract Supervisor
BlacJac Security, "Protection Provided"

title: BlacJac Bounty Trial Contract
description:
ATTN: Bounty Hunters

Not sure if you’re interested, but BlacJac is looking to expand our roster of bounty hunters. We got more jobs than our current contractors can handle, so I’m hoping that you might be able to help pick up some of the slack.  

Your qualifications look good on paper, but before we make anything official, BlacJac needs to see how you perform in the field firsthand. Even got a test case all lined up – we want you to sort out ‹Target Name›. They were last seen at ‹Location›. Should be a fairly straightforward bounty without too much resistance. Perfect thing to sharpen your teeth on.

Good luck,
Gloria Mesa

Private Contract Supervisor
BlacJac Security, "Protection Provided"

title: Blackbox Recovery Request: Investigator Level
description:
Hockrow Agency 
Case File #BR74382
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Summary: 
A known outlaw attacked and destroyed a ship near <EM4>‹Location›</EM4>. The agency has been contracted to retrieve the ship’s blackbox in order to build a case against them and lobby for Advocacy intervention. 

Contract Investigator Actions:
An operative is needed to head to the crime scene at <EM4>‹Location›</EM4>, secure the area from any hostiles present to procure the blackbox, and deliver to <EM4>[Destination|Target|Address]</EM4>.

Additional Notes:
Be advised that there are still <EM4>hostile forces in the area</EM4> that will attack. These will most likely have some experience fighting, so be prepared. 

This contract has been flagged as a <EM4>combat mission</EM4>.

title: Blackbox Recovery Request: Junior Level
description:
Hockrow Agency 
Case File #BR83215
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Summary: 
Client hired the agency to look into the destruction of one of their ships near <EM4>‹Location›</EM4>. They are claiming that the ship was destroyed by an ex-partner and need the blackbox to prove it.

Contract Investigator Actions:
Dispatch to <EM4>‹Location›</EM4> and locate the derelict ship. Secure the area from any hostiles. Retrieve the blackbox and deliver it to <EM4>[Destination|Target|Address]</EM4>.

Additional Notes:
Whoever destroyed the ship could still be in the area so be prepared for a fight, as such this has been flagged as a <EM4>combat mission</EM4>.

title: Blackbox Recovery Request: Lead Investigator Level
description:
Hockrow Agency 
Case File #BR23665
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Summary: 
Operative with <EM4>extensive combat experience</EM4> needed to retrieve a <EM4>blackbox</EM4> from a compromised ship at <EM4>‹Location›</EM4>. Client hasn’t specified why they need it but are paying good money to have it back. 

Analysis of the wreck indicates that there are some serious hostiles in the area, so any attempt to retrieve will likely require a fight. Our records indicate that these hostiles are highly trained and aggressive, so prepare accordingly.

Contract Investigator Actions:
Route to <EM4>‹Location›</EM4> and secure the blacbox by any means necessary. Once obtained, deliver it to <EM4>[Destination|Target|Address]</EM4> for payment.

Additional Notes:
Operations wanted to reiterate that this will be a <EM4>heavy combat mission</EM4> so make sure you bring allies or equipment to handle it.

title: Blackbox Recovery Request: Probationary Level
description:
Hockrow Agency 
Case File #BR56263
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Summary: 
Need an operative to extract the blackbox from a destroyed ship. The ship’s owner claims that it was genuinely lost in an outlaw attack, but the insurance company has doubts. We’ve been hired to find out which is true.

I suspect that the perpetrators are long gone by now, so you shouldn't run into any resistance.

Contract Investigator Actions:
Proceed to <EM4>‹Location›</EM4>, secure the black box in the derelict spaceship there and return it to <EM4>[Destination|Target|Address]</EM4>.

Additional Notes:
You will need to EVA for this one so make sure you got a suit.

title: Blackbox Recovery Request: Senior Investigator Level
description: Blackbox Recovery Request: Senior Investigator Level

title: Blackbox Recovery Request: Special Investigator Level
description:
Hockrow Agency 
Case File #BR547384
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Summary: 
This request comes down from Head Office. 

We’ve just learned that a recent ship attack near <EM4>‹Location›</EM4> might have been the work of a notorious and equally elusive outlaw ringleader. The last time they popped their head above water was years ago, so this is a rare opportunity to catch them. This is an opportunity that our client does not want to pass up. We need a <EM4>top-tier operative</EM4> with elite combat experience to retrieve the blackbox of this downed ship in order to prove the ringleader’s involvement.

<EM4>There will be highly-trained hostiles present on the scene</EM4> who will put up significant resistance to your presence. Eliminate them and complete the mission.

Contract Investigator Actions:
Immediately scramble to <EM4>‹Location›</EM4> and clear the surrounding airspace in order to secure the blackbox. Once obtained, deliver it to <EM4>[Destination|Target|Address]</EM4>.

Additional Notes:
Head Office stresses that this will be an incredibly difficult mission to pull off. Make sure you bring your A-game.

We had another ship attacked out near ‹Location› and received conflicting reports about who did the ambush, so we're looking to hire someone to fly out and <EM4>retrieve the blackbox</EM4>. Last thing we want to do is blame the wrong people. You should be able to carry it, but <EM4>you'll need a ship with some storage.</EM4>

title: Block XenoThreat Expansion
description:
XenoThreat are on the warpath right now. They’ve launched simultaneous attacks on several Headhunters sites and stretched our fighters thin. Got word they’re planning to storm The Golden Riviera next, and we can’t get anyone there to defend it. 

I’m looking to pay someone to pull together a crew, gather supplies, and mount a strong defense for us. Gonna be honest with you, this is shaping up to be a hell of a fight. Xenos are sending some of their most experienced forces there. Not much else I can say except that they’ll probably stagger the arrival of their forces, wipe them all out and you’ll be paid handsomely. 

Think you can rise to the occasion?  

-Stows

title: Blow Up Citizens for Prosperity Fuel Reserves
description:
I'm getting pretty bloody sick of Citizens for Prosperity sticking their noses where they don't belong. 

Started thinking that it might be pretty nice to ground their fleet for a little bit. We blow up their fuel tanks at ‹Location› and those little pissheads won't be going nowhere quick.

Sound like your kinda thing?

-Stows out

title: Breach and Steal
description:
Hey there. 

Nine Tails got themselves a little problem. As it turns out, they got a little side biz in the underground organ trade. Now that an area I generally like to steer well clear of, but a gig’s a gig, right? It seems that one of their mobile butcher shops aboard the 'October Rising' got pinched by private security while out chopping. Now the Nine Tails are willing to cut ties with the ship and its crew (who are probably all dead anyway), but they need a particular crate extracted. Guess it was a special order or something.

Anyway, get aboard the October Rising, get the package, and get out.

Security’s still hanging around so watch yourself and maybe bring some friends, but remember, your priority is the package. If you're looking to save yourself some extra hassle, you could also black out the area by shutting down the nearest comm array if you want to avoid the crimestats for, you know, killing a bunch of a security. But hey, you do you.

Once you’re out, drop the package off at the clinic on Grim HEX and I’ll sort your payment.

Easy peasy,

Ruto

title: Bring Down the Hammer
description:
Sent ships to investigate a distress beacon only for it to turn into an ambush by the People’s Alliance. They’ve been fighting like hell to get away but can’t seem to extract themselves.

Let’s get ‘em some help on the double. Think you can go on over to <EM4>‹Location›</EM4> to give ‘em some support?

-Stows

title: Bulk Covalex Shipment Needs Recovering
description:
Hi,

Here's the situation. After spending an hour on comms talking to the hauler, trying to help them diagnose what's wrong with their ship, it's been decided that we now need to get someone to head over to <EM4>‹Location›</EM4> and complete the delivery.

This is a pretty big one. You'll need a ship that can store <EM4>32 SCU cargo containers</EM4> and unless you're super strong a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> to shift it all.

I would really appreciate if we could just get this one done. Take the cargo to the freight elevator at <EM4>‹Destination›</EM4> and we can put this all behind us.

‹Contractor›

Ella Tieno 
Jr. Logistics Coordinator 
Covalex Shipping   
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.' 

Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

*********
__Background Information__
A group warrant has been issued for the notorious Arlington ship jacking gang after their recent brazen attempted theft of an Idris from a repair yard. While the heist was stopped, the members of the group have scattered to the black. Eckhart Security has been granted the bounty for the immediate capture of all high-level gang members: Maltrox Arlington, Kass Dent, Nicks Cantwell, Sam ‘Weepy’ Arlington, Oslo Arlington, and Les Arlington.
*********

Maltrox Arlington has been keeping a low profile recently, but we think he's come out of hiding. A patrol was refueling at a station when one of their ships was boosted. You are authorized to use whatever force is necessary to neutralize the target.

title: Carefully Clear Site
description:
We’ve been contracted to take care of a delicate situation. A gang has settled into <EM4>‹Location›</EM4> that we need to get cleared out. Only issue is that there’s still some civilians there too. 

Looking for someone with the skills and good trigger sense to get rid of those outlaws without harming any innocent people. If that’s you, grab your gear and get over there. 

Eugene Walton
Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

title: Cargo Hauling Opportunity with Ling Hauling

unlocks.title: Ling Family Rookie Cargo Haul - Small Scale
Ling Family Rookie Cargo Haul - Medium Scale

description:
Hi,  
 
This is Petra Ling, and I’m proud to offer you a new and exciting opportunity to partner with Ling Family Hauling. When my parents started this company, their goal was to provide fast and reliable courier deliveries around the greater Crusader area. It quickly became a success, and as our reputation grew, so did our operations.  
 
Now, under my stewardship, Ling Family Hauling is taking the next big step – cargo hauling. Demand for this new service is growing faster than I expected, and that’s great news for both of us.   
 
If you’ve ever wanted to be a hauler, then I can make your dreams come true. Best way to learn something is by doing it, and I’ve got a haul of <EM4>‹Item›</EM4> that needs to go from <EM4>‹Location›</EM4> to <EM4>‹Destination›</EM4>.  

No prior experience is necessary, but here’s a few things to keep in mind. All pick-ups and deliveries must be done at a freight elevator or autoloaded. You will need a ship that can hold <EM4>2 SCU cargo containers</EM4>, and a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to move them around. 
 
Upon successful completion of this delivery, you will be promoted to a ‘trusted contractor’ status and more hauls will become available to you.     

 
Sincerely,  
Petra Ling  
Managing Director of Cargo Operations 
Ling Family Hauling 

 

 

 

Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.

title: Cargo Retrieval
description:
Need someone to snag some cargo for us. We were using an old Hathor PAF for dead drops, but a local gang has dug in and we can’t get our shit.

If you feel like kicking some ass, grab the cargo from the freight elevator at <EM4>‹Location›</EM4> and deliver it to the freight elevator at <EM4>Grim HEX</EM4>. 

From what I’ve heard this place is full of all sorts. Won’t be easy getting out stuff back, but that’s what we’re paying you for.

Just make sure you got a ship that can handle a <EM4>32 SCU</EM4> load, and try not to get shot in the process. A <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> would also be smart to bring along. 

Stows out.

title: Cargo Shipment Must Be Completed
description:
More and more CFP ships are being targeted lately, and despite our best efforts to keep our trading routes quiet, we're still losing haulers to outlaw attacks.

Our pilot over at <EM4>‹Location›</EM4> is the latest casualty. It pains me to think about how much we've lost, but as long as there are people who need our help, we have to keep on fighting.

If you have a ship that can carry <EM4>32 SCU cargo containers</EM4> and a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4>, we need you to head to the above location and recover that cargo.

This won't be easy, the pilot was one of our best and wouldn't go down without a fight. Let's not underestimate these outlaws, bring a trustworthy crew and watch each other's backs.

Once you've got the cargo, deliver it to the freight elevator at <EM4>‹Destination›</EM4> and I'll get it processed.

Good luck and take care,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

title: Cargo Transfer from Shuttered Facility
description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL 
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS' 
----------------------------    

ASD reached out to us as it seems one of their old labs, <EM4>‹Location›</EM4>, still has some cargo being stored there they want to get their hands on.

You would fly there in a ship that can handle containers up to <EM4>32 SCU</EM4> in size, land in the hangar, load up from the freight elevator, and then transport it all back to <EM4>Teasa Spaceport</EM4>. 

Just be sure to keep your head on swivel while you’re at the facility and try not to let your curiosity get the better of you Abandoned sites like this can be home to all sort of nastiness.  And don't forget to pack a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to bring along. 

BE YOUR BEST – Take pride in the work you do and you’ll do work to be proud of.

title: CDF ALERT: ‹Location› Blockade Runners Needed
description:
*FOR IMMEDIATE SYSTEM-WIDE RELEASE*

A hostile fleet of ships equipped with quantum jammers have created a blockade around  ‹Location›, disabled the station's defensive turrets, and stolen a large supply of Zeta-Prolanide. In response, the CDF has received authorization to activate its volunteer force. 

Though the overall situation is dire, the theft of the Zeta-Prolanide is our priority. Without direct action, the loss of the sector's Zeta-Prolanide stores could have a devastating effects to the wider economy of the whole system. 

While local security forces are investigating the incursion, they've tracked the stolen inventory to several locations. CDF volunteers are tasked with heading to these locations, recovering the stolen Zeta-Prolanide, and transferring it back to the station before the material completely degrades and is no longer viable. Just be careful, intel suggests that larger clusters of Zeta-Prolanide have a higher outlaw presence.

Since time is of the essence, having a tractor beam to assist in moving the cargo is highly advised.

As an added incentive, volunteers will receive regular bonus payments for their combined efforts.

title: CDF ALERT: Attack on XenoThreat
description:
*FOR IMMEDIATE SYSTEM-WIDE RELEASE*

Attention, Naval forces have regrouped for a final assault on the XenoThreat outlaw pack that have been plaguing Stanton System. The Navy has officially requested for any CDF volunteers to help provide combat support in this final push to secure our system.

SAIC Rowena Dulli from the Advocacy is the official attaché to the CDF and will be running the operation.

title: CDF ALERT: Xenothreat Ambush - Support Needed
description:
*FOR IMMEDIATE SYSTEM-WIDE RELEASE*

Attention, XenoThreat forces started to ambush Naval convoy ships transporting vital supplies while en route to Jericho station at the Pyro Gateway in the Stanton System. The Navy has requested CDF forces to help recover these supplies from the wreckage and safely deliver them to Jericho. 

The Navy has organized a community stipend to handle the distribution of payment. This will be distributed among all CDF volunteers at assigned intervals. An indicator will appear on your HUD to measure these payouts.

Please note that some of these supplies are highly volatile if not handled correctly. Use caution while transporting these materials:
* Zeta-Prolanide degrades over time until breaking down completely.
* AcryliPlex Composite becomes explosively unstable if damaged.
* Diluthermex releases a destructive energy pulse if exposed to quantum travel.
 
Additionally, while not as volatile, the supplies of DynaFlex lost during the attack are still urgently needed by the Navy to complete their repairs of the Javelin and should be a priority for recovery.    

Also, XenoThreat hostiles might still be in the area so be careful. CDF volunteers with combat experience are also urged to contribute by securing these areas from lingering XenoThreat forces.

SAIC Rowena Dulli from the Advocacy is the official attaché to the CDF and will be running the operation.

title: Checking For a Pulse
description:
A rather creative former contractor of ours with a knack for staging accidents was so swept up in their work that they forgot to confirm the death of <EM4>‹Target Name›</EM4> for us.

The target’s body should be located at <EM4>‹Location›</EM4>. I need you to give the hopefully deceased an inspection to ensure the job was completed to our standard. 

Do be careful when you arrive at the location. It wouldn’t surprise me if there was a few vultures lurking around.

Sincerely,

Vaughn

title: Claim #‹Claim Number›: ‹Ship› Salvage Rights
description:
Attention:

Rights to a new Salvage Claim are available for purchase. Exclusive access to the ship’s verified coordinates in monitored space will be provided upon confirmed credit transfer. The coordinates will remain accessible as long as the accepted contract is active. When you are satisfied with the amount of material you've salvaged, you may abandon the contract early with no penalty to clear the coordinates from your Starmap.

Claim #‹Claim Number›:
• SHIP: ‹Ship›
• CAUSE OF ACCIDENT: ‹Ship Story›
• LOCATION: ‹location›

Adagio Rights Division

title: Cleaning Up Someone Else’s Mess
description:
You know when you ask someone a question and you have a feeling they’re lying, but you choose to give them the benefit of the doubt? Yeah. That’s what I’m dealing with right now.

title: Combat Gauntlet - Scenario #1
description:
Looking to gain critical hands-on experience battling a variety of targets and situations? Then my Combat Gauntlet might be the perfect fit for you.

Please understand that this course is intended for pilots who have already mastered flying basics and are ready to take their abilities to the next level. If you’re starting off and want to learn the ropes, I’d recommend logging some hours in an Arena Commander simpod. But for those ready to face a real challenge, I firmly believe that students learn best by doing. 

That’s why I’ve designed these eight scenarios to be as realistic as possible. I promise you this is the closest thing to Navy combat pilot training you can get without enlisting, so don’t expect a lot of hand holding. <EM4>The risk of injury to yourself or your ship should be taken very seriously.</EM4>

GAUNTLET SCENARIOS:
1. Single Targets
2. Multiple Targets
3. Target Priority
4. Target Stealth
5. Missiles and Countermeasures
6. Multi-Crew Targets
7. Corvette with Escorts
8. Capital Ship Encounter

So, if you’re ready to challenge yourself and prove you got what it takes to be a great pilot, the first scenario will focus on handling a single target. Head to <EM4>‹Location›</EM4> to begin.

As a bonus, successful completion of the scenario will net the original contractor holder an award of <EM4>‹Scrip Amount› MG Scrip</EM4>.

TRICKS OF THE TRADE:
- Situational Awareness – Don’t get so focused on taking a target that you aren’t watching your flight path. No good taking out the enemy if you fly headfirst into an asteroid.

Good luck out there, 
Instructor Gilly    

ABOUT GILLY’S FLIGHT SCHOOL 
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or a professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”

title: Combat Gauntlet - Scenario #2
description:
Congrats on completing part one of this eight-part course.

Scenario two will focus on how to deal with multiple targets at the same time. Goal here is give you a better handle on how to balance offense and defense.   

Whenever you’re set, grab a combat ship, and head to <EM4>‹Location›</EM4> to begin.

As a bonus, successful completion of the scenario will net the original contractor holder an award of <EM4>‹Scrip Amount› MG Scrip</EM4>.

TRICKS OF THE TRADE:
- Pick Your Fight - For situations where you’re coming up against multiple targets of equal threat, your best strategy is to focus on neutralizing one target at a time to gradually reduce the amount of incoming fire.

Good luck out there, 
Instructor Gilly     

ABOUT GILLY’S FLIGHT SCHOOL  
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or a professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”

title: Combat Gauntlet - Scenario #3
description:
Congrats on completing part two of this eight-part course.   

The third scenario throws tactical considerations into the mix. This time around the attacking ships are from distinct classes with distinct battlefield applications. Knowing what targets to prioritize is vital to surviving engagements against multiple ships.      

Whenever you’re ready, head to <EM4>‹Location›</EM4> to get started.

As a bonus, successful completion of the scenario will net the original contractor holder an award of <EM4>‹Scrip Amount› MG Scrip</EM4>.

TRICKS OF THE TRADE:
- Bigger They Are – Try to evaluate which threat is the most dangerous and take them out first.
- Shields – If you’re taking a lot of damage, don’t be afraid to boost away and let your shields regenerate.

Good luck out there, 
Instructor Gilly     

ABOUT GILLY’S FLIGHT SCHOOL  
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or a professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”

title: Combat Gauntlet - Scenario #4
description:
Congrats on completing part three of this eight-part course.

Good combat pilots know not all threats are apparent. It’s the threats you don’t expect that can be the most devastating. Scenario four is focused on how to identify and deal with stealth targets. Hopefully by the end, you’ll understand just how important your radar is in determining who you’re really up against. Expect to have regular and stealth ships hunting you down.    

Make your way to <EM4>‹Location›</EM4> whenever you’re ready, and remember to keep your eyes on your radar.

As a bonus, successful completion of the scenario will net the original contractor holder an award of <EM4>‹Scrip Amount› MG Scrip</EM4>.

TRICKS OF THE TRADE:
- Surprise Attacks - Pinging your surroundings can sometimes reveal hidden ships. Be ready for contacts to show up unexpectedly.

Good luck out there, 
Instructor Gilly     

ABOUT GILLY’S FLIGHT SCHOOL  
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or a professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”

title: Combat Gauntlet - Scenario #5
description:
Congrats on completing part four of this eight-part course.   

The fifth scenario focuses on defensive tactics. Knowing when to take evasive measures and deploy either decoys or noise countermeasures is essential to your survival. That’s why the aggressors in this exercise will be armed with missiles.   

Ensure your countermeasures are fully stocked and then go to <EM4>‹Location›</EM4> to start.

As a bonus, successful completion of the scenario will net the original contractor holder an award of <EM4>‹Scrip Amount› MG Scrip</EM4>.

TRICKS OF THE TRADE:
- Ready to Launch - Easy access to your decoys and countermeasures can be critical in your success in dealing with incoming missile fire. 
- Stand and Fight - Resist the temptation to hit the afterburner to escape as you’ll increase your signature and make it easier for the missile to hit you. They’re almost certainly much faster than you anyway.
- Close the Gap – While it may seem counterintuitive, getting closer to an enemy ship can be an advantage. Missiles have a minimum range and if you’re inside of it they won’t be able to get a lock on you.

Good luck out there, 
Instructor Gilly     

ABOUT GILLY’S FLIGHT SCHOOL  
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or a professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”

title: Combat Gauntlet - Scenario #6
description:
Congrats on completing part five of this eight-part course.

I’m bringing out the big guns for scenario six. Time for you to go up against larger, multi-crewed ships, which provide a few new challenges. Not only will you have to contend with their enhanced firepower but their multifaceted shields means you’ll have to target one shield face continually to do real damage. Easier said than done when both of y’all are moving at such fast speeds.      

Find your way to <EM4>‹Location›</EM4> whenever you're ready.

As a bonus, successful completion of the scenario will net the original contractor holder an award of <EM4>‹Scrip Amount› MG Scrip</EM4>. 

TRICKS OF THE TRADE:
- Size Advantage – When going up against a larger ship, try to stay away from their front as typically this is where the majority of their offensive fire is located. 

Good luck out there, 
Instructor Gilly     

ABOUT GILLY’S FLIGHT SCHOOL   
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or a professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”

title: Combat Gauntlet - Scenario #7
description:
Congrats on completing part six of this eight-part course.

You’ve gained a lot of experience across the past six scenarios, and now it’s time to put it all to practice. Scenario seven puts you up against a corvette-class ship and its escorts. This extended encounter will push you to the limit and test everything you got.   

The only thing left is to understand the limit of your skillset. To put it simply, you can’t do everything yourself. Developing and maintaining relationships with fellow pilots that you can call upon for support is really the last piece of the puzzle. Not saying you can't overcome encounters like this by yourself, but even the Navy doesn’t send their ace pilots on a patrol alone.    

Once you decided whether to do this alone or call in some support, head over to <EM4>‹Location›</EM4> to kick off the encounter.

As a bonus, successful completion of the scenario will net the original contractor holder an award of <EM4>‹Scrip Amount› MG Scrip</EM4>.

TRICKS OF THE TRADE
- Strength in Diversity – Think about the roles your allies will be filling and choose who to bring carefully to help balance strengths and weaknesses. You’ll want ships capable of taking on the Corvette while others deal with the escort.

Good luck out there, 
Instructor Gilly     

ABOUT GILLY’S FLIGHT SCHOOL   
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or a professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”

title: Combat Gauntlet - Scenario #8
description:
Welcome to the final scenario of the Combat Gauntlet.

Throughout this course, you’ve gotten to experience the advanced combat and defensive tactics needed to survive a variety of encounters. Time to take all those new skills and knowledge and see how they hold up against a large capital vessel and some escort ships.

You know the drill by now. Once you and all your allies are set, find your way to <EM4>‹Location›</EM4> to see how you do when truly pushed to the limits.

As a bonus, successful completion of the scenario will net the original contractor holder an award of <EM4>‹Scrip Amount› MG Scrip</EM4>.

TRICKS OF THE TRADE
- Patience is a Virtue – If you’ve balanced your squadron properly, you should be able to come out on top, just don’t expect it to be a quick fight. Ships this big don’t go down quickly.

Good luck out there, 
Instructor Gilly

title: Confiscate Contraband
description:
Crusader Security has learned that an illegal production facility at ‹Location› is currently being used to manufacture contraband. 

We are seeking a contractor to secure the site, confiscate any contraband, and deliver it to us at Seraphim Station. The administrative commodity terminal will allow you to submit the contraband into our evidence hold and collect your payment.

Now, this is an automated facility so it’s not clear how long they’ll be manufacturing for, or even how many people may be on site. To be safe, I would go in expecting to meet heavy resistance.

Your total compensation will be based on how packages are safely delivered into evidence.

CONTRACT AUTHORIZED BY:
Liaison Officer Vanzant
ID# 712L921P

title: Confiscate Contraband
description:
ATTN: Verified Mercenary Operators

We’ve been able to trace a recent surge of contraband to an automated production facility at ‹Location›. We can’t be sure how much longer the site will be up and running, so BlacJac needs someone on site to sweep through, secure the contraband, and transport it to us at Baijini Point. Once there, you can use the administrative commodity terminal to transfer the contraband to us and collect your reward.

We haven’t been able to determine what kind of hostile force will be present, but whatever you encounter, you’re authorized to use lethal force as necessary. 

The more contraband you manage to bring to us, the more credits you’ll earn.

Thanks,
Lt. Aaron Riegert

Private Contract Supervisor
BlacJac Security, "Protection Provided"

title: Confiscate Contraband
description:
HURSTON DYNAMICS
OUTSOURCING DEPARTMENT

CONTRACT: Confiscate Contraband
CONTRACTOR AFFILIATION: Independent
OUTSOURCE MANAGER: T. Odington
RISK ASSESSMENT: High
RUSH CONTRACT: No

Hurston Security has learned of an active, illegal automated production facility at ‹Location› and is seeking a contractor to secure the site and confiscate as many packages of contraband as possible for delivery to a Hurston Security facility Everus Harbor for immediate disposal. Transfer of the contraband and attribution of your reward payment should be done through the administrative commodity terminal there.

You are authorized to use any force necessary to complete your objective. Payment will be based on the amount of contraband secured.

title: Convince Upstarts to Abandon Sector
description:
Everyone has been talking about a new player named ‹Target Name› who is operating out of ‹Location›. They've become a real concern for the Headhunters. 

It's time to shut them down. 

Head over, take out ‹Target Name› and then clear out any fuel stores they have there to convince anyone remaining to leave. 

Figure after you pull this off, nobody will even remember their name.

-Stows

title: Convoy Caught in Brutal Attack
description:
We just received word that a convoy of Citizen for Prosperity affiliated ships have been targeted by outlaws and that our people are in dire need of assistance. 

If you are available, we need combat ready pilots at ‹Location› to defend our people. Note that at this dire time, we cannot afford even a single lost ship and expect with your assistance for all of our people make it out alive.

Good luck,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

title: Coordinated Takedown

requires.title: Capture Arlington Gang Member Les Arlington

description:
Interesting assignment came my way. I need two separate targets taken out: ‹Target Name› and ‹Target Name 2› 

Problem is, either one gets word about the other being hit, they’ll go to ground. Can’t risk losing either of them. 

It’ll take considerable coordination, but I want you to hit them both at the same exact time.  

And since you can’t be in two places at once, you’ll need to find someone you can trust to help on this.

Thankfully, my intel says that both the targets should be traveling alone. That should help make things a bit easier on you.

description:
Hey,

Have a bit of good news for you. Covalex recently finished an evaluation of our contractor pool, and decided to reconsider your status as a cargo hauler. To requalify, all you need is to successfully complete the following delivery.

Pick up <EM4>Quartz</EM4> from a freight elevator at <EM4>‹Location›</EM4> and deliver it to a freight elevator at <EM4>‹Destination›</EM4>. In order to complete this haul in a fast and efficient manner, you'll need a ship that can haul <EM4>1 SCU cargo containers</EM4>.

Hopefully everything goes smoothly so we can welcome you back to the team.

By the way, we strongly encourage contractors to bring a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> along.   

Covalex Shipping

title: Crash some ships
description:
A lotta wannabe gangs have stepped to the Headhunters over the years thinking that they could force their way into the system. We're still here. They aren't. But it seems the survivors of these groups have decided to band together and try again. Guess some people never learn.

Latest group hit a couple of our convoys while on supply runs. Shouldn't be a surprise that the Judge wants to stomp them out quick. We've learned they're out near ‹Location› and likely rearming for another attack. 

We want you to go there and make them wish they died with their old gang.

Stows out

title: Crew Hasn’t Checked In
description:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Crew Hasn’t Checked In

WORK BRIEF: 
Just got word that one of the mining teams is unaccounted for. They were supposed to be back hours ago, but no one’s heard from them. Family have tried to reach out but haven’t gotten a response from anyone on the crew.

I can send you their last known location, so we’re looking for someone to go check in and see if they’re okay. If the worst happened, <EM4>please identify anyone you find</EM4>. I’m sure the families would appreciate some closure on what happened.

Thanks

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon entire crew's status confirmation.

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

title: Critical Cargo Extraction
description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Recover Cargo
Approval code: = ‹Approval Code›

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

Calling for a skilled contractor to recover a displaced shipment located at <EM4>‹Location›</EM4>. Client's hauler was transporting some high value cargo when they decided to respond to a distress beacon and got ambushed by a group of outlaws. The client believes their pilot is gone but their cargo could still be recovered.

The information we have so far is that you'll need a ship that can carry <EM4>32 SCU cargo containers</EM4>, a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> for shifting the goods, as well as your support ships to help deal with the outlaws at the location. 

Client will be expecting the completed delivery to be made to the freight elevator at <EM4>‹Destination›</EM4>.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

title: CRITICAL FLEET REFUEL
enemyShips: Anvil F7C-M Super Hornet Mk I
Anvil F7C-R Hornet Tracker Mk I
Anvil F7C-S Hornet Ghost Mk I
description:
Heyo,

Over at <EM4>‹Location›</EM4> we just got a refueling job for an entire small fleet of ships who all together need <EM4>‹Hydrogen Fuel› SCU of Hydrogen and ‹QTFuel› SCU of Quantum Fuel</EM4>. Talk about when it rains it pours!

The client will pay you at the rate of <EM4>‹Fuel Rate› aUEC per SCU of Hydrogen</EM4>, and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

Unfortunately, where they're held up isn't the nicest of sectors so I'd be alert for any tomfoolery while you're doing the run. 

It'll be best to try get them all back on their way as soon as you can.

Happy trails,

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"

title: CRITICAL REFUEL REQUEST: ‹Ship›
description:
Hi,

Another day another beacon. There's a <EM4>‹Ship›</EM4> looking to be topped up with ‹Fuel Type› at <EM4>Asteroid Mining Base</EM4>.  The client vessel will pay you at the rate of <EM4>‹Fuel Rate› aUEC per SCU of Hydrogen</EM4> and  <EM4>‹QTFuel Rate› aUEC per SCU of Quantum</EM4>, and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

I can't lie: it's a nasty place to get stuck and a worse place to get caught by surprise. We've lost good people out there - even the ones who got lucky made it home with pieces missing.

If you decide to take the job, do me a favor and keep everything peeled. If you've got a buddy with time to spare, maybe reach out for a little back-up.

Maybe I'm being paranoid, but that doesn't mean they're not out to get you, as Momma Deloit used to say. 

Actually she never said that - but I'm pretty sure she would if she did this for a living.

Just do the job and get home safe, okay?

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"

title: Crucial Supplies Need Retrieving
description:
We were in the process of delivering an urgent shipment to the folks over at <EM4>‹Destination›</EM4> when our pilot ran into a group of outlaws. They tried to run, but it was already too late.

There is silver lining though. The trackers are showing the cargo is still intact, located at <EM4>‹Location›</EM4>. There's a good chance the outlaws are guarding it while they locate a ship big enough to transport everything. While I don't want to risk losing another pilot, the need of the cargo aboard is desperate enough that it justifies the decision to send someone to recover it.

This won't be easy, these outlaws showed our pilot no mercy. You'll need to take them out first before getting the cargo back. Bring a ship that can store <EM4>32 SCU cargo containers</EM4> and a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> for the moving. Deliver it to the freight elevator at <EM4>‹Destination›</EM4>  and let's make this right.

Fly safe,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

title: Curious Weapon
description:
Wikelo find very strange but functional weapon while wandering through your systems. It very simple but very effective. If you bring me things, I show you what I do to it.

Very fun.

title: Danger: Contraband Weapons Inbound
description:
This is a general warning. We have learned that the Headhunters are transporting a large amount of weapons into the system with the intent of launching attacks against CFP-owned settlements.

While we believe that change can only come to this system through nonviolence. The presence of these weapons will undoubtedly cause considerably more bloodshed and devastation so we want to remove them from the equation.

Any of our supporters with appropriate combat training are asked to undertake this dangerous assignment out near ‹Location›. We will compensate you for the tremendous risk you are taking.

Thank you and be safe out there,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

title: Dangerous Ambush
enemyShips: Anvil F7C-M Super Hornet Mk I
Anvil F7C-R Hornet Tracker Mk I
Anvil F7C-S Hornet Ghost Mk I
description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Ship Ambush
APPROVAL CODE = ‹Approval Code›

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

A high profile client recently lost an important shipment when a pilot double-crossed them and ran off with their product. After weeks of hunting we’ve discovered that they were connected with an outlaw pack, so the client is looking to us to deter similar future issues from arising. The ultimate target is the pilot of a <EM4>‹Ambush Target›</EM4>, who leads the crew responsible. This won’t be easy. They don’t go anywhere without escort fighters and sub-capital ships. That’s why we highly recommend that you find a trusted friend or two who can handle this with you.  
  
Intel gathered by our analysts indicates that they frequently fly by an <EM4>emission cloud</EM4> near <EM4>Asteroid Mining Base</EM4> which would provide an excellent area to stage a surprise strike.

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract. We’re also adding a bonus payment of <EM4>‹Scrip Amount› MG Scrip</EM4> that’ll go to the main contractor.

This contract is non-negotiable.

title: Dangerous Take
description:
I was hopin’ you’d be interested in pulling a little job for us. Got some goods over at ‹Location› that are just right for the taking. Only problem is – and it’s a big one – the bastards running the place have the whole area rigged with proximity mines. 

You’ll need to find someway through, or if you can’t be bothered, someway to trigger the lot. Either way, just try not to blow yourself up. Then you just need to grab the stuff and take it over to ‹Destination›.

It won’t be easy to pull off, but if you do, I promise I’ll make it worth your while.

title: DEAD SAINTS - Rookie Rank - Medium Cargo Haul
enemyShips: Anvil F7C-R Hornet Tracker Mk I
description:
One of our best distributors got busted in Stanton so we need a replacement. The guy was an incredible salesman, but a shit smuggler. We need someone who won't run face-first into a security patrol or a pack of pirates to pick up some merchandise at these locations:

PICK UP LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER) 

- Freight elevator at <EM4>a Salvage Yard on Daymar</EM4>
- Freight elevator at <EM4>‹Location 1›</EM4>

And bring it all to <EM4>‹Destination›</EM4> before security catches on to what's happening. You'll need enough space on your ship for size <EM4>2 SCU</EM4> containers, and a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> should make loading and unloading nice and easy. 

-Twitch

title: DEAD SAINTS - Rookie Rank - Small Cargo Haul
description:
We've got a shipment of contraband that needs to be hauled to a couple of different places. If you like creds, head to <EM4>Grim HEX</EM4>, load everything up, and bring it to these drop points:  

DROP OFF LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)

- Freight elevator at <EM4>‹Destination›</EM4>
- Freight elevator at <EM4>‹Destination 1›</EM4>
- Freight elevator at <EM4>‹Destination 2›</EM4>

You're gonna need a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to move the boxes and enough room in your cargo hold for size <EM4>2 SCU</EM4> containers. 

Avoid other ships if you can. Security will bust you if they figure out what you're hauling, and raiders will just take it for themselves. 

-Twitch

description:
Call me Twitch. I run the Dead Saints. 

I doubt this is the first time you've heard of us, but in case you haven't, we do a lot of things, but one of them is transporting goods that need discreet handling. 

I got your info from one of my contacts. They say you've got the stuff we like in a hauler, which works for me, because we're looking for one. 

Here's my proposal – we're offering creds to the pilot that can transport some special cargo for us. Your ship’s hold will need room for <EM4>2 SCU cargo containers</EM4>, and you'll need a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> for loading and unloading. All you have to do is get everything from <EM4>Teasa Spaceport</EM4> to <EM4>‹Destination›</EM4> without getting security involved. 
 
If you can pull the job off, the Saints will have more contracts for you down the line. 

-Twitch

title: DEAD SAINTS -- Rookie Rank, Large Scale Cargo Run
description:
If you're looking for creds, the Saints need someone with hauling experience to do a supply run from <EM4>‹Location›</EM4> to <EM4>Grim HEX</EM4>. 

You're gonna need a ship that can hold size <EM4>16 SCU cargo containers</EM4> and a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to move the boxes around. 

Don't open the crates but just so you know, most of this stuff is legal but not all of it. Try not to cross paths with anyone who might make that a problem for you. Get me?

-Twitch

title: DEAD SAINTS -- Rookie Rank, Small Scale Cargo Run
enemyShips: Anvil F7C-R Hornet Tracker Mk I
description:
Got an interesting one. Some folks who were suckered into life/labor contracts with Hurston Dynamics want to get as far from Lorville as they possibly can. They struck a deal with a people mover and got themselves put on ice. Now they just need someone to pick them up and give them a ride. 

If you're up for some popsicle smuggling, you'll find ‹total› cryopods at <EM4>Teasa Spaceport</EM4> that need to go to <EM4>‹Destination›</EM4>. Make sure you have space in your cargo hold for size <EM4>2 SCU</EM4> containers. If you use a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4>, you should be able to get everyone loaded up before Hurston security catches on. 

HD isn't too keen on anyone slipping out of their contracts, so watch your back. They shoot to kill. 

If you can pull this off, there's a nice paycheck in it for you.

-Twitch

title: Deadbeat
description:
The Headhunters recently loaned credits to ‹Target Name› under some clear conditions. Specifically, pay us back or we’ll kill you. Wild to think that wasn’t enough of an incentive, but here we are past the payment deadline. Now as much as we like ‹Target Name›, I need you to make good on our promise.

‹Target Name› was last seen at ‹Location›. Track ‘em down, ghost ‘em, and get paid. It’s as simple as that. 

Stows out.

title: Deadly Combination
description:
‹Target Name› and ‹Target Name 2›.

Two serious operators who've recently decided to make a move against their boss. Each of the pair are traveling with a small, highly trained armada and cutting deep into territory that doesn't belong to them.

You, and whoever you recruit to help, are going to take them out and it has to be both at the same time so they can't regroup.

title: Deal with ‹Target Name› and Support Forces
description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Bounty
APPROVAL CODE = ‹Approval Code›

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

Got a big league bounty contract that’s primed to be executed. <EM4>‹Target Name›</EM4> and their crew were identified executing a raid on <EM4>‹Location›</EM4>. If their MO holds true, <EM4>‹Target Name›</EM4> has surfaced to land a big score and then will disappear into the ether. Let's not allow that to happen again. 

Word is the hostile forces have spread themselves across the location. That’ll make hunting down the precise location of <EM4>‹Target Name›</EM4> difficult. In addition, expect the target to act defensively when under attack. In previous engagements, they remained hidden and directed their forces from afar. It is our recommendation that you focus on thinning out their allies first and force <EM4>‹Target Name›</EM4> to come to their own defense. Would also advise you to bring plenty of ammo and even some support to help keep you from being overwhelmed.    

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.

This contract is non-negotiable.

description:
Local crew decided to hit one of our convoys and steal our shit. They got away, but we aren't gonna let them celebrate for long. I want you to head out to ‹Location› where they got a base, blast them into ash, and get our stuff back. 

Once you got the cargo, take it over to ‹Destination› and we can all forget these assholes ever existed.

Stows out.

Find a friend of your own and hunt each of these two down. Make sure you kill them at the same time. Call it poetic justice.

They should die pretty easy. Maybe they'll have a ship or two with them but I don't think it'll be anything to worry about.

title: Defend Location and Deliver Confidential Materials
description:
ABOUT THE JOB
microTech Protection Services need a security professional for a retrieval op at ‹Location›. The location is currently under attack and security forces on-site are unresponsive and presumed dead. We believe confidential materials recently delivered to the facility for temporary holding were the target of the raid. Your main focus will be collecting those boxes and delivering them to a secure location.  

For security reasons, the confidential materials were delivered as part of a larger shipment and secured in the automated vault. The materials have unique retrieval codes that must be entered on the keypad at the package conveyor. Protocols require that only senior security officers can carry a datapad containing a code, but considering the volatile situation, we can't guarantee that the Nine Tails haven’t taken possession of them. Once secured, deliver all of the confidential materials to ‹dropoff 1› for payment.

• Provide own transportation to ‹Location›.
• Use force as necessary to collect the confidential materials.
• Deliver the confidential materials to ‹dropoff 1›.

• Access to combat equipment. 
• Access to a spaceship that can transport cargo.
• Available for immediate deployment.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
• Experience with rapid hostility de-escalation techniques.
• Experience hauling important cargo.

title: Defend Site and Retrieve Confidential Materials
description:
HURSTON DYNAMICS
OUTSOURCING DEPARTMENT

CONTRACT: Facility Sweep & Package Retrieval
CONTRACTOR AFFILIATION: Independent
OUTSOURCE MANAGER: G. Livingston
RISK ASSESSMENT: High
RUSH CONTRACT: Yes

Hurston has learned that the Nine Tails are attacking ‹Location›. Our on-site forces have suffered heavy casualties and stopped responding to comms. Initial reports indicated that the gang was attempting to obtain confidential material recently delivered to the facility. Thankfully, we have security measures in place that should give us time to respond. We need an operative to head to the facility immediately, retrieve those boxes, and deliver them to a secure location.

You and whatever backup you choose to bring are authorized to take any actions necessary when confronting the trespassers. Suspects are considered armed and dangerous. Hurston will not provide material support and/or updates regarding the status of the facility's security forces. 

The confidential materials were discreetly delivered alongside other boxes in a consignment and locked in our automated vault with access codes kept on datapads held by senior security staff. However, there’s a strong chance Nine Tails may already have gotten their hands on them. You’ll need to find those datapads and then enter the codes at the package conveyor to retrieve the confidential materials. Payment will be sent once they have been delivered to ‹dropoff 1›.

description:

If you can find a way to navigate through the mines or possibly a way to trigger them remotely, it should be relatively easy to grab the goods and make your way out of there. Drop them off at ‹Destination› and you’ll get more than your fair cut of the credits for taking on the risk.

-Bit Zeros

title: Deliver a Message
description:
Surprise, surprise. Seems like not everyone’s happy that the Headhunters are making inroads in Stanton. One crew in particular has been hitting our people and then scurrying back to <EM4>‹Location›</EM4>. 

Want you to go there and give ‘em a taste of their own medicine. Removing these lickboots should send a pretty clear message about what happens if you screw with us. 

Stows out.

title: Delivery for ‹Destination› Ready
description:
Hi, 

Got word folks are waiting for an important supply shipment that’s not arrived. Turns out it accidently got taken to the wrong place. While we look into how the mistake happened, we need someone to head over to <EM4>‹Pickup 1›</EM4> to pick up package <EM4>#‹item 1›</EM4> and deliver it to the correct location at <EM4>‹Dropoff 1›</EM4>. 

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

You available for the run?

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
