title: Delivery of Abandoned Ling Cargo

requires.title: Cargo Hauling Opportunity with Ling Hauling

description:
Hey,

Need a reliable contractor to help us out with a bit of a situation.

Our of our haulers has dropped out mid-contract and now our client's cargo is stuck in transit. Think they were trying to negotiate a better rate with us, but that's not how Ling does business. Anyway, they're done and we desperately need the shipment finished.

Petra and I have been working with this client for years now and have built up a good rapport. Be a shame to throw that all a way because of an unreliable hauler. Can you head to <EM4>‹Location›</EM4> and collect the shipment? You'll need a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> and a ship that can carry <EM4>32 SCU cargo containers</EM4>.

Take the shipment to the freight elevator over at <EM4>‹Destination›</EM4> and we'll get you paid as soon as. We'd really appreciate your help with this and I'm sure our client would too.

Thanks,  
Reyes Ling 
Cargo Logistics Coordinator 
Ling Family Hauling 

Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.

title: Delivery Pilot for Covalex
description:
Hello there,

I have a delivery I need taken care of. The order is waiting at <EM4>‹Location›</EM4> to be taken to <EM4>‹Destination›</EM4>. 

I’m sure you’ll be fine, but for full disclosure, I’m seeing a bunch of security warnings pop up for this area. Seems there have been a handful of attacks in that area in the last few days. Now, I’m not saying you’ll run into anything, but it would probably be best if you brought along a bit of protection.

Good luck,

Chase Hewitt
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping  
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

title: Demolition Mission
description:
I’m looking to send a strong message to the crew over at Storehouse and know the perfect way to do it - property damage.

All you need to do is head on over, destroy a few things here and there, and really drive home an important lesson about respecting your betters. 

Do that for me and I’ll be feeling very happy. And generous.

Interested?

title: Destroy Dangerous Drugs
description:
ATTN: Verified Mercenary Operators

Some enterprising chemists have cooked up a new product that is twice as potent and twice as deadly as the normal stuff. We were able to trace some samples back to the source over at ‹Location›. 

BlacJac wants you to head down ASAP to destroy the entire batch before it can hurt any more of the population. We can worry about making arrests later.

From everything we know about this crew, you should expect to meet heavy resistance while attempting to clear out the stash.

Thanks,
Gloria Mesa

Private Contract Supervisor
BlacJac Security, "Protection Provided"

title: Destroy Deadly Contraband
description:
A fledgling syndicate have set up shop over at ‹Location› and have been trying their hand at cracking into the drug market. Unfortunately, their product has been linked to several deaths in and around Crusader. With how potent this stuff is, it’s posing a serious threat to the public. 

Crusader is working to take down the whole operation, but as long as their product is circulating, the bodies are starting to pile up. 

We want you to go the site and destroy the stash they have there before they get a chance to sell it. However, you should expect their stash to be extremely well guarded.

CONTRACT AUTHORIZED BY:
Liaison Officer Bautista
ID# 948J030K

title: Destroy Headhunter Stolen Data
description:
The Headhunters recently attacked one of our transports and were sadly able to get their hands on some secure data. Although the encryption on it is strong, its only a matter of time before they'll be able to access it.

Before that happens, we need you to go to Rustville and destroy all traces of the information from their servers.

You'd really be helping Citizens for Prosperity out if you can pull this off.
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

title: Destroy Headhunter Stolen Data

The Headhunters recently attacked one of our transports and were sadly able to get their hands on some secure data. Although the encryption on it is strong, its only a matter of time before they'll be able to access it.

title: Destroy Illegal Drugs
description:
We’ve discovered that a group is trying to start up their own drug business over at ‹Location›. While they seem to be your average low-level thugs, the product they’re producing is toxic and responsible for the deaths of multiple civilians, so we can’t afford to allow any more to be sold.

We’re are working on a larger operation that will shut them down for good, but in the meanwhile we need to stop the flow of their drugs. That’s why Crusader wants you to go the site and destroy the stash they have there.

They will undoubtedly have guards protecting the stash, but I don’t expect them to be too much of a threat.

CONTRACT AUTHORIZED BY:
Liaison Officer Bautista
ID# 948J030K

title: Destroy Outlaw Data Servers
description:
Citizens for Prosperity have been monitoring a very dangerous outlaw group at Last Ditch and we believe that they are in midst of planning a major attack which could throw the whole system into upheaval.

In order to protect all the progress we've made here, we would like you to raid their compound and destroy all the servers housing their plans. 

This should at least provide us with enough of a reprieve for them to reconsider their offensive.

Thank you,
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

title: Destroy Toxic Narcotics
description:
We’ve been investigating a recent bout of OD’s and they all seem to have originated with a bad batch of drugs made over at ‹Location›. 

I’m working with other contractors to ferret out those responsible, but people are dying as long is the product is still out there. 

I want you to go the site and destroy the stash they have there. Should buy us some time before we shut them down for good.

They will have guards protecting their supply, so be prepared to engage with hostiles.

CONTRACT AUTHORIZED BY:
Liaison Officer Bautista
ID# 948J030K

title: Destroy XenoThreat Data Servers
description:
One of the Citizens for Prosperity members who have been serving as a XenoThreat informer has let us know that the data servers located at Shadowfall our housing a trove of information vital to the gang's operation. 

If you were able to destroy these servers on our behalf it would be a huge win for the security of the entire system.
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

title: Destroy XenoThreat Fuel Reserves
description:
I won't get into the long and complicated politics of why I'm asking you to do this, but it's enough for you to know that I want it done. 

Go to Shadowfall and blow up the XenoThreat fuel reserves there. It'll really be helping me out of a tight spot.

-Stows

title: Destroy XenoThreat Logistic Data
description:
We got a bit of a problem that I'm hoping you can solve for me. One of our informers has revealed that XenoThreat has been amassing data on Citizens for Prosperity operations throughout the system. 

This information, if used correctly, could put our people at serious risk. The best solution is for you to completely destroy the servers where the data is being stored at Remote Outpost near ‹Nearby Location›.

With their trove of information wiped out, it should give our people a fighting chance.
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

title: Destroy XenoThreat Logistic Data
description:
We got a bit of a problem that I'm hoping you can solve for me. One of our informers has revealed that XenoThreat has been amassing data on Citizens for Prosperity operations throughout the system. 

This information, if used correctly, could put our people at serious risk. The best solution is for you to completely destroy the servers where the data is being stored at Scraper's Turn.

With their trove of information wiped out, it should give our people a fighting chance.
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

title: Disable Headhunter Comm Towers
description:
Violence is never our first choice, but sometimes it must be used as a preventative measure.

We’re planning a strike on a Headhunter controlled outpost and need your help.

We need to make sure that if something goes wrong they won’t be able to call for backup and escalate the situation. That’s where you come in. We need you to head over to <EM4>Rustville</EM4> and disable the communication towers. There should be a <EM4>control panel located at the top</EM4> of each tower that you can use to deactivate them.

If you’re able to do this, Citizens for Prosperity will be able to gain some vital ground in Pyro.

It’s also worth keeping in mind for future contracts that you can choose to take out the comms towers instead of risking a fight with reinforcement dropships.

Stay alert and stay safe.

Thank you,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

title: Disable Outlaw Stronghold at ‹Location›
description:
Following a series of raids against Citizens for Prosperity aligned settlements, we believe we have traced those responsible back to ‹Location›.

Attacking them directly will pose too great of a risk and most likely encourage aggressive reprisals. Instead, we believe that if their power generators were to be disable it could force them to settle somewhere else.

Do you think you could handle it for us?
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

title: Divide and Conquer
description:
Normally, the pair of ‹Target Name› and ‹Target Name 2› would be too much to take on together. They both are about as good as it gets when it comes to dogfighting and the crew they fly with are almost as good.

But recently they split - not sure why - and are flying separate for the moment.  Someone thinks this may be the best chance to take them out. 

Gather some personnel you can trust and plan a simultaneous raid against both targets. It's too dangerous to risk one of them living after such a direct move against them.

title: Do Lava Suit
description: If you have armor, Wikelo can make it look warm. Good look for useful armor. Bring me things and will do.

title: Double Dealing
description:
Rough & Ready recently provided fueling services for a hauler named ‹Target Name›, who agreed to deliver their next load of supplies to us as compensation. Well, we just found out that the lying skag sold their latest shipment to a rival gang instead. 

We’re looking for someone to track down and eliminate ‹Target Name› for the double cross. 

An old friend of mine just spotted the skag at ‹Location›. Looks like they're loaded with more cargo that’s not coming our way, and traveling with an escort. We’re only paying you to take out the ship, so anything you find aboard is yours to keep.

- Smokey

title: Double Elimination
description:
Got a contract to take out two up and comers who've been stirring up trouble. It has to be clean, both done at the same time, or else they might cause even more trouble.  Long story short, you'll need some help on this one.

Both ‹Target Name› and ‹Target Name 2› know how to handle themselves, and the people they fly with aren't no joke either. You can expect each of them to be guarded by a few ships.

title: Double Tap
description:
A price has been set on the heads of ‹Target Name› and ‹Target Name 2›. 

While having to hit two targets isn't that weird, the client wants to send a very specific message, so they need to targets hit at the exact same moment. The extra credits should make up for the hassle.

And unfortunately since the pair aren't traveling together, it goes without saying that to pull it off you're gonna need some help. Make sure you bring people you trust can handle more than one ships since the targets are known to travel with backup.

title: double trouble
description:
If you had asked me, I would've said ‹Target Name› and ‹Target Name 2› would have wound up eventually killing each other. But instead you're going to get the honor of killing them both at the same time.

You're going to have to work for it, though.

Each one is trouble. Serious records, highly trained, and too smart to fly without backup.

Gather the best crew you can on this one. You'll need it. And don't be stingy. You can't spend credits if you're dead.

title: Down For the Count
description:
<EM4>‹Target Name›</EM4> was a name that proved particularly troublesome for some time. Whether a master of evasion or just unerringly lucky all of our attempts have thus far failed.

With that being said, it seems that someone else may have beaten us to the punch so to speak. We’d like you to visit <EM4>‹Location›</EM4> and confirm if the target has indeed been neutralized. But be advised, I suspect they’re former crew may still be in the area, most likely out of a misplaced sense of loyalty. I’d suggest a crew of your own for this one, but will defer to your expertise.

Sincerely,

Vaughn

title: Driving CFP out
description:
We've been trying to play nice with these Citizens for Prosperity people, but they've made it abundantly clear that we don't have a place in their 'safe system.' Their use of mercs for security have been causing all kinds of unreasonable violence like when this asshole ‹Target Name› opened fire on a group of settlers to drive them away from an outpost they'd been eyeing. So now the gloves are coming off.

I need some hard workers to go hit ‹Location› and take out ‹Target Name›. Odds are, they'll stay hidden until you prove you're enough of a threat, so make sure you do some damage.

Stows out.

title: Drop a XenoThreat
description:
Got a line on a XenoThreat that's been a pain in the ass. Not sure if you've heard the name, but ‹Target Name› is a scumbag even by XenoThreat standards. Vicious, sadistic, and a prick to boot. We want someone to punch their number. You up for it?

Last word was that they were somewhere around Stonetree. Head there and take 'em out. Pretty simple.

Stows out.

title: Easy Creds for Easy Work

unlocks.title: Making the Most of a Bad Situation

description:
Here’s the deal. Dead Saints need some new blood to help shift gear across the ’verse and if you can prove yourself useful, you could make some nice creds doing it.

Got an easy one to start you out. Couple of hours ago, something went down over at <EM4>‹Location›</EM4> and a pilot of mine got ghosted. My tracker’s telling me that they didn’t find the stash of gear in there.

If you can get out there, get the package back and take it to <EM4>[Destination|Target|Address]</EM4> without dying, I might have some more work for you. Can’t see you running into too much trouble as any ships you spot will likely be scavs looking for a quick cred. I’m sure you can take care of that.

-Twitch

Thanks in advance.

- Stows

title: Eliminate Vanduul Ship
description:
MISSION SPECS

Area of Operation: Nyx System
Hostile Forces: Vanduul
Equipment Specs: Combat-rated Ship
Briefing: InterSec requires the services of a skilled pilot who’s prepared to assist in taking down a dangerous Vanduul target that has been involved in numerous attacks.

Vanduul incursions have been on the rise recently, posing not only a threat to the system of Nyx, but the UEE as a whole. It is imperative that these sightings are responded to in a swift and efficient manner. 

We require you to fly to the last known sighting of the Vanduul ship at <EM4>‹Location›</EM4> and eliminate them immediately.  

Vanduul pilots are highly skilled and extremely dangerous. Engage the enemy immediately and do not hesitate – they will not show the same mercy.

Compensation proportionate to the risk of the contract will be awarded.

Respectfully,
Deacon Tobin
Operations Manager
InterSec Defense Solutions

This communication consists of a non-binding offer that upon acceptance may be immediately terminated by either party without any given notice. All operations are conducted at the contractor’s own personal risk and must adhere to system law where applicable.

title: Eliminate XenoThreat Enforcer
description:
We have intercepted a location beacon that puts <EM>‹Target Name›</EM4> and their personal attack wing at <EM4>‹Location›</EM4>. They have been one of XenoThreat's most brutal enforcers since their founding. 

<EM>‹Target Name›</EM4>'s not one to back down from a fight so hit their ships hard enough, do enough damage and they won't be able to resist joining in the action. Once they're out in the open, they'll be your main target.

Ready to go?

Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

title: Eliminate XenoThreat Idris
description:
Hey, 

The rumors are true. XenoThreat has deployed an Idris to stalk and attack Citizens for Prosperity operations in a dramatic escalation of their hostility towards us. We just received word the ship, under the command of ‹Target Name›, is advancing toward ‹location›. We can’t get our own forces there fast enough to fight them, and are in desperate need of help. 

We’re looking to hire someone brave enough to take it to these bastards. It’s not enough to scare them away, we need to guarantee that it can’t come after us again. 

Not sure if you’ve faced down an Idris before, but it’s a tall task for someone to take on alone. I’d highly recommend recruiting others to the cause.   

Best,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

title: Elite Op
enemyShips: Anvil F7C-M Super Hornet Mk I
Anvil F7C-R Hornet Tracker Mk I
Anvil F7C-S Hornet Ghost Mk I
description:
Headhunters are looking for someone with the skills and crew to execute an elite op. A military frigate and escort ships are stalking one of our Clips around the system. Don’t know their intentions but it can’t be good. Figure while they’ve got their eyes focused on their prize, we get someone to gather a crew to hit ‘em.  

Already got a spot picked out. If you get to <EM4>‹Location›</EM4> there’s an emission cloud that’s exactly what we need. Head there with friends, power down your ships, and wait for the <EM4>‹Ambush Target›</EM4> and its escorts to pass by. 

With a bonus of <EM4>‹Scrip Amount› Council Scrip</EM4> for the main contractor, payment alone should make this worth your while, but you can also keep anything you scrounge from the wreckage.

- Stows

title: Elusive Bounty: ‹Target Name› (HRT)
description:
HURSTON DYNAMICS OUTSOURCING
CONTRACT: Bounty Collection
OUTSOURCE MANAGER: I. Takao
RISK ASSESSMENT: High Risk Target (Armed Support)

Hurston Dynamics is seeking a contractor to complete a bounty for ‹Target Name›. This bounty has proven extremely elusive so far, but intel reports have tracked the target and a cohort of their known associates to Exterior Zone 2. 

However, there is a strong chance that ‹Target Name› will not risk a confrontation unless absolutely forced to. It is our recommendation that you neutralize a significant portion of the criminal’s allies first in order to draw them out. The report indicates that a large party of these hostiles are currently near the Exterior Zone 2.

Payment will be released only after the bounty has been deemed complete.

title: End Nine Tails' Occupation at Orison
description:
*FOR IMMEDIATE SYSTEM-WIDE RELEASE*

Attention, Nine Tails forces have seized control of several commercial platforms near Orison. Using an Identity Friend or Foe Inverter (IFFI), they have taken over the restricted air space surrounding the platforms and only Nine Tails affiliated ships can gain access to the area. This has severely hampered Crusader Security's initial attempts at retaking the platforms. As such, Crusader has requested that CDF forces assist in shutting down the inverter and eliminating all hostile presence. Any available CDF volunteers are encouraged to provide support.

Additional Intel:
* While the inverter is active and the airspace inaccessible, CDF has managed to gain control of a local shuttle system and route it to access Solanki Platform without the Nine Tails knowledge. Volunteers will need to head to the Crusader Industries Showroom on the Commercial Platform and get to the rooftop to find the shuttle that will travel to the occupied platforms.
* The IFFI is believed to be located in a locked storage container on a cargo barge docked at the central Admin Center.
* Access codes for the IFFI container are in the possession of the leader of the Nine Tails forces, Mendo Ren. 
* Past experience with Mendo Ren indicates that he is unlikely to show his face and risk capture. However, if all his lieutenants are neutralized, we believe he will have no choice but to take command of the forces in person and provide us the opportunity to retrieve the codes from him.
* In addition to the shuttle system, Crusader Security has informed us that there are several vehicles on the platforms available for CDF to commandeer. These vehicles will be the only way of reaching the Admin Center. NOTE - If all of the vehicles within the restricted air space are destroyed before the inverter can be shut down, then there will be no way of reaching the cargo barge and the CDF will be forced to retreat.
* The platforms are protected by Nine Tails controlled Anti-Air weapons.

Please be aware that SAIC Rowena Dulli from the Advocacy is the official attaché to the CDF and will be running the operation.

Lima Endicott

We’re looking for an experienced merc willing to eliminate these forces immediately. The sentries are the priority, but the ships might prove a bigger issue if they’re allowed to escape. You’ll have to evaluate the situation more closely once you’re on site. 

We could take care of it ourselves, but want to send in a contractor so the scum behind it don’t know who hit them. Payment will be sent promptly upon completion. Plus, the satisfaction of knowing you’re helping a good cause.

Comm. Spec. Engler

Might be worth staking out spots where they could attempt to hack their record clean. Wouldn't be the first time a prisoner has tried to wipe their sentence after escaping.

Good hunting,

Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

description:
Ran into a bit of crap luck that I'm hoping you can help me right.

A few days ago, I hired the crew of the 'Pride of Arliss' to obtain some important data for me. They pulled off the job no problem, but the bastard of a captain comm'd me demanding more credits. Turns out it wasn't the first time he's tried to pull this trick either because in middle of "negotiating" with me, his ship was attacked by some very pissed off individuals looking to teach him a lesson.

Our comm got cut off when the shooting started and that was the last I heard from him. I'm guessing he's as good as ghosted, but I want you to head to the Pride of Arliss and try to get my data off the captain's personal datapad.

Once you have it, I set up a secure transmission channel at the ARC-L1 rest stop. Travel there and when you're in range, submit the data to me through this contract to get paid.
  
Don’t try to screw me over either. Karma can be a real asshole.

title: Fight for a Free Pyro
description:
XenoThreat’s efforts to keep outside influences from infecting this system is being tested by a group that dares to call itself Citizens for Prosperity. A prominent group member, ‹Target Name›, has established operations at ‹Location› and is already hard at work spreading their lies and propaganda to anyone that will listen. If we want Pyro to remain independent of UEE and alien influence, then something must be done about this now.  

That’s why XenoThreat is issuing a kill order for ‹Target Name›. And knowing how important they are to Citizens for Prosperity’s operations, I wouldn’t be surprised if you had to fight your way through a bunch of their most fanatical followers first before you even get a shot at them. But remember ‹Target Name› is your target, and payment hinges solely on you making sure they’re eliminated. 

Comm. Spec. Engler

title: Find ‹Target Name›
description:
Last night, some no-name drifters threw down with our enforcers and ran when things got too hot. Didn't find out 'til they were long gone, but they made off with one of our Prospects when they split. Goes by the name of ‹Target Name›. 

Last we saw, they were headed in the direction ‹Location›. We need someone to head there and track down our missing Prospect. 

If you take any of them down while you're at it, all the better.

Stows out.

title: Find ‹Target Name›
description:
Last night, some no-name drifters threw down with our enforcers and ran when things got too hot. Didn't find out 'til they were long gone, but they made off with one of our Prospects when they split. Goes by the name of ‹Target Name›.

title: Find ‹Target Name› and Missing Supplies
description:
Hey,

Wondering if you can help me. I’ve lost touch with a dedicated CFP volunteer named ‹Target Name› who was tracking down supplies taken by XenoThreat. Their last comm said they believed our stuff was being held at ‹Location›. I told them to be careful, but haven’t heard anything since.

Any chance you can head out and try to locate ‹Target Name›? While there, if you spot the supplies, please bring them to ‹Destination›. I’ll give you the same warning I gave ‹Target Name›, that spot is a known Xeno stronghold. Better be prepared. Would hate for you to disappear too after visiting that spot. 

Be Safe, 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

title: Find Headhunter Captive and Stolen Data
description:
I just have received confirmation that ‹Target Name›, a Citizens for Prosperity courier, was captured by the Headhunters while transporting some critical data. 

We need you to investigate The Golden Riviera to discover what happened to ‹Target Name› and then destroy any Headhunter servers that may contain stolen data.

We're counting on you,
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

title: Find Headhunter Crewmember and Help Finish the Job
description:
You ever get a bad feeling that you just can't shake? I had sent ‹Target Name› to take out the some XenoThreat servers at ‹Location› and I'm starting think they ran into some serious trouble.

Do me a favor, huh? Go on over and see if you can figure out what happened to them and make sure that those servers are destroyed for good.

-Stows out

title: Find Lost Supply Ship
description:
Hey,

I’m concerned a ‹Ship› moving medical supplies for us might’ve come under attack. The signal was lost around ‹Location›, which has seen a spike in outlaw activity recently. Losing that ship alone would be bad enough, but it’ll be even worse if those supplies don’t make it to Canard View. 

We would need you to search for the ship at its last known position, recover the supplies, and then take them to Canard View. Your help would make a bad situation better. 

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

Thanks,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

title: Find Missing Cargo Hauler
description:
Hey, 

One of our veteran haulers got sick and backed out of a run that we desperately needed. ‹Target Name› stepped up and offered to do it. I was hesitant to give it to ‘em because it’s riskier than the routes they normally do. Seems like my concern was warranted. Last update we got from ‘em was near ‹Location›, which is XenoThreat territory.

Can’t have this hanging over my head much longer. Any chance you’d be willing to head to their last known location and see if you can find out what happened? It’d mean a lot to me and others. Not only to know the status of ‹Target Name› but also the cargo, which is really needed at ‹Destination›. If you find it and complete the delivery, it would be a huge help to the CFP members there.   

Fly safe out there,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

title: FIND SERVERS AT ASD SITE AND DESTROY
description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Destroy Server
APPROVAL CODE = VS-14

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

This a simple seek and destroy contract. The client has requested that several servers located at an ASD research site be destroyed as soon as possible. Under no circumstances should these servers be accessed, or copies of the data made.

The client believes that the servers are somewhere in the <EM4>Engineering wing</EM4>, most likely in the <EM4>Management</EM4> area. In addition to this, there is a strong chance you won’t be the only presence on-site so be wary of potential hostiles.

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

title: Find XenoThreat Captive and Stolen Data
description:
The family of ‹Target Name›, a Citizens for Prosperity courier, has been in contact with me with the terrible news that they never arrived back home. We learned that ‹Target Name› was captured by XenoThreat while transporting some critical data. 

We need you to search Remote Outpost near ‹Nearby Location› and see if you can learn what has become of ‹Target Name› and then destroy any XenoThreat servers that may contain stolen data.

Thank you,
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

title: Find XenoThreat Captives and Stolen Data
description:
A small group of Citizens for Prosperity members were supposed to be delivering sensitive data back to our headquarters in Stanton, but they never arrived. 

We now believe that they were captured by XenoThreat before they could leave the system. I'd like you to investigate ‹Location› to discover what happened to the missing crew and then destroy any servers they could be using to store the stolen data.

Your help is very appreciated,
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

title: Finish Interrupted Ling Delivery

requires.title: Cargo Hauling Opportunity with Ling Hauling

description:
Hey,

Here's the thing: one of our haulers has run into some trouble over at <EM4>‹Location›</EM4> and had to ditch their ship. Could you head over there and help us finish the delivery?

Not a huge job by any means, but you'll still need a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> and a ship with enough space to store <EM4>32 SCU cargo containers</EM4>.
 
Drop the cargo off at the freight elevator at <EM4>‹Destination›</EM4> and we'll send you the creds.

Thanks,  
Reyes Ling 
Cargo Logistics Coordinator 
Ling Family Hauling 

Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.

title: Finish the job
description:
One of our pilots was supposed to bring a shipment back to us, but seems like he got into some trouble over at <EM4>‹Location›</EM4>. Either he got his brains blasted all over the cockpit, or freaked out and ditched his ship. For his sake, I hope it’s the first one so I don’t have the hunt this asshole down. What’s important right now is that our cargo’s just sitting out there.

If you’ve got a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> and a decent ship, can you head over there and get our stuff? Chances are the assholes who attacked my pilot are still there, and I’m betting they’re pretty tough.

If you get out alive, take the cargo to the freight elevator at ‹Destination› and I’ll get you paid.

Stows out.

title: Finishing The Job
description:
One of my haulers has run into some trouble over at <EM4>‹Location›</EM4> and was forced to ditch their ship. I need someone to go there with <EM4>a heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> to grab the cargo and finish the job.

They were carrying a decent supply of gear for me, and the last thing I need is for some do-gooder to come across it and trace it back to us.

If you do run into anybody, no need to be friendly. Just shoot the asshole and get my gear. Understood?

Take it to the freight elevator over at <EM4>‹Destination›</EM4> and I’ll make sure you get a cut of the sale.

-Twitch

title: Firebird Mod

rewardItems.name: Aegis Sabre Firebird Wikelo War Special

description: Been digging into Aegis Sabre ship. Firebird is very bomb-y. Good build but could make some fun change to it. If you want, I can do. Have a look and tell me. Bye.

title: First Haul in System

unlocks.title: Help Deal with Outlaw Hunting Party

description:
Welcome to the system, not sure if you're familiar with our organization but Citizens for Prosperity are a non-profit organization dedicated to bringing security and civilization to unclaimed systems.

If you're looking for work in the system and would like to help achieve our goal, we need a package picked up from <EM4>Stanton Gateway</EM4> and taken to <EM4>‹Destination›</EM4>.

Once complete, we can offer you a variety of new job opportunities in this system and beyond.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

title: Fortune ship for you
description: Hello, practicing on making ship fly better. Xi'an help human make ship. Fly good. Salvage good. But Wikelo can make better if you want. Bring things and will do. Bye.

title: friends to the end
description:
I really hope that you're not buddies with ‹Target Name› or ‹Target Name 2› because I need you to ghost the pair of them... at the same time...

Of course they wouldn't make this easy on us and travel in the same ship or something obvious like that. No. You're going to have to put together a crew so that you can down both targets simultaneously. 

As soon as one of them is dead, be ready to drop the other one too. Can't risk either of them getting away.

And I figure I should mention that not only are both pretty good pilots, but that they'll be traveling with backup too. Nothing you can't handle I'm sure.

title: Fuel to the Fire
description:
If you’re in the market for some easy credits, I’ve got an offer for you.

See, word on the vine is that ‹location› is operating as a fuel depot. They must not have gotten the memo that the fuel trade in Pyro belongs to Rough & Ready.

That’s why you’re going to make your way there and destroy their fuel reserves. They should be easy for you to spot. They’re the large yellow storage tanks dotted around the outpost. Watch out though, there are turret emplacements defending the area, so make sure you’re ready to dodge their shots or blow the guns sky high. 

I’ll leave it up to you how you handle the demo. Bombs would be my first choice, but I don’t care much as long as the gig gets done.

- Smokey

*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

WORK BRIEF: 
I need you to check something out for me if you’re not busy. I'm looking to build on our mineral database and need some scans of <EM4>‹Amount To Scan› of Torite, ‹Amount To Scan 2› of Bexalite and ‹Amount To Scan 3› of Ice</EM4>. title: Gather Irradiated Valakkar Fangs

requires.title: Interested in Building a Better Future?

description:
To all available contractors,

We at Rayari are dedicating all our energy to stopping the regeneration technology crisis in its tracks, but to continue their efforts our scientists need materials that the company's suppliers cannot obtain. 

Rayari is seeking an experienced contractor to gather <EM4>irradiated valakkar fangs</EM4>, which can be extracted from adult valakkar that have been extensively exposed to radiation. Our scans have uncovered the existence of a qualifying population inside the storm near <EM4>‹Location›</EM4>. 

Because these animals are highly dangerous, Rayari is offering premium pay to anyone who can assist with collecting the fangs.  

Once attained, please take these valuable resources to <EM4>‹Destination›</EM4>.

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing

title: Get My Gear Back
description:
A couple of hours ago I was supposed to receive a shipment of gear from a pilot of mine. I don’t like late, so I need you to head to their location and recover my stuff. I’ve got trackers on the packages so they should be easy enough to find.

My gut says the pilot’s been ghosted. They knew how to handle a ship well, so the scavs that took them out must be decent. When you get my three packages back, take them to <EM4>[Destination|Target|Address]</EM4> for me and I’ll wire you the creds.

-Twitch

title: Get Our Shit!
description:
Someone with a death wish attacked one of our ships hauling some primo product. Our crew on the scene is outta commission, so we need someone to get there fast and recover the stash before those bozos make off with it. Any chance you can handle this for us?  
  
Looks like the attack went down at ‹Location›. Head over there and deal with the attackers before they get away. Then grab the goods from the ‹Ship› and take ‘em to Rustville. Oh, and don’t be an idiot and get high on that supply, unless you want me to send someone after you next. 

- Stows

title: Get the Good Stuff
description:
Need someone to raid a base at ‹Location› for us. Not sure exactly who’s dug in there, but they attacked one of our ships and took the drugs they were hauling. Really need that shit back. That batch is full of high potency stuff that’s worth a premium. 

Doubt they’ll want to give it back to you, so plan to take it by force. Then bring the goods to ‹Destination›. And don’t act like an idiot and get any ideas of what you could do with that stuff. Trust me, you don’t wanna get on my bad side. 

- Stows

title: get the goods
description:
Oh hello, I recently overheard a little bit of intel that ‹location› received some confidential materials that are of great interest to an acquaintance of mine. So interesting that they’re willing to pay for someone to storm the facility, grab the goods, and deliver them to ‹Drop Off 1›. Now I expect there to be plenty of security, who will most likely put up a fight, so I’d bring a gun or two. 

Word is the confidential materials were delivered in a consignment alongside other stuff and are now being stored in the facility’s automated vault. Senior security officers on-site carry datapads containing retrieval codes used to access the vault. You’ll have to get your hands on a datapad before using the package conveyor to retrieve the boxes. 

If you need a little sweetener, I’ve seen the manifest and can confirm that the other crates being stored at the facility are pretty choice. My client could care less about what happens to them, so they’re yours to do as you please. Run this right and those extra crates could be a nice bonus on top of the delivery fee for you.

title: Getting Our Goods Back
description:
We’ve been using the old Hathor <EM4>‹Location 1›</EM4> and <EM4>‹Location 2›</EM4> as stashes, but it turns out some over-eager nullbrains sniffed them out and are trying to boost our shit for their own.

Luckily, the goods are still there - for now. We need someone to visit that PAF and OLP, grab our stuff from the freight elevators, and take it to the freight elevator at <EM4>Grim HEX</EM4> where we should be able to keep it on ice. 

Here’s the list of what to grab. Don’t care what order you do ‘em in. Be sure to bring a ship that can store <EM4>32 SCU</EM4> at the very least. 

- Freight elevator at <EM4>‹Location›</EM4>
- Freight elevator at <EM4>‹Location 1›</EM4>
- Freight elevator at <EM4>‹Location 2›</EM4>

Make sure you’re ready to deal with whatever assholes you run across. A <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> would also be smart to bring along. 

Stows out.

title: Getting To the Bottom of It
description:
So we were expecting a pretty important package earlier today but turns out the pilot got ghosted and they ripped the tracking chip from it and got away. Pretty clever right? Not really, because they forgot to take the flight recorder too.

Get the blackbox from the wreck at <EM4>‹Location›</EM4> and take it to <EM4>[Destination|Target|Address]</EM4>. We’ll send you the creds when you’re done.

Oh and watch out for scavs, people are pretty desperate these days, even if it just some busted courier ship.

-Bit Zeros

title: Getting What They Deserve
enemyShips: Anvil F7C-M Super Hornet Mk I
Anvil F7C-R Hornet Tracker Mk I
Anvil F7C-S Hornet Ghost Mk I
description:
I got a situation I need dealing with pronto. A rival crew has intercepted a major shipment of gear I was expecting and all hell is breaking loose. The pilot’s ghosted, the ship’s busted, and it’s only a matter of time before they take my shit and leave. If you’re up for cracking these assholes, head to <EM4>‹Location›</EM4> and get my five packages.

Head’s up though, the pilot they ghosted was one of my best, so this crew’s got to be seriously kitted out. Bring your finest mates with you and show the bastards no mercy. Understood?

When you’re done, take the gear to <EM4>[Destination|Target|Address]</EM4> and I’ll make sure you get a serious cut of the takings.

-Twitch

title: Getting what we deserve
description:
Here’s the thing, I got a situation over at <EM4>‹Location›</EM4> and need someone with a brain between their ears to sort it out for me. Former pilot of mine thought he could cut a deal with another gang and unsurprisingly it didn’t work out for him. Now my cargo is sitting idle and being guarded by a whole bunch of nullbrains waiting for their hauler to come pick it up.

Need you to head there with a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> and a strong crew to get my shit back before its gone for good.

Take it all to the freight elevator at <EM4>‹Destination›</EM4> and I’ll give you a generous cut of the takings.

Stows out.

title: Ghost ‹Target Name›
description:
Can’t believe how many criminals are crawling around this damn system. Guess we’ll have to make some room for ourselves. 

Got a list of high-level leaders here. Nothing brings chaos and disorder to the existing gangs like a good decapitation attack. The next target is <EM4>‹Target Name›</EM4>, who we’ve tracked to <EM4>‹Location›</EM4>. Feel like ghosting ‘em?   

These old Hathor platform facilities are big and spread out. Doubt there’s a way to do this and not attract the attention of their foot soldiers. Ain’t gonna be easy but sure sounds like fun.

- Stows

title: Ghost some XenoTrash
description:
Need you to move quick on this one. There's a XenoThreat lieutenant named ‹Target Name› who's popped up for air. Judge thinks this is a big chance to mess with XenoThreat's command by taking them out. I heard ‹Target Name› was spotted flying around ‹Location›, so get there quick before they disappear again.

I'd bring some support, I doubt they'll go down without a fight. 

Stows out.

title: Go on the warpath
description:
Looking for some hitters to go drop some violence on some local dipshits who've been pulling jobs in the system against Headhunters. We tried reaching out to explain the error of their ways, but they shot our messenger, so now we go with option B.

You'll find them holed up near Remote Outpost near ‹Nearby Location›. Go there and repaint the walls with their blood.

Have fun.

Stows out.

title: Golem Rocks
description:
Universe need resources so Wikelo always respect people who dig. Good profession. If you starting and want boost to Golem ship. I can do. 

Bring. 

I make.

title: Gone But Not Forgotten
description:
Not sure what happened, but a ship moving some important supplies across the system disappeared around ‹Location›. Our crew at Rustville really needs that cargo for an upcoming operation. Any chance you could go looking for the ship and help complete the delivery?

Have no idea what happened, but my bet’s that they got ghosted. Maybe it’s just me, but I’d rather be a prepared pessimist and an ill-equipped optimist. 

- Stows

title: good help’s hard to find
description:
I know someone who’s looking to start up a new business, but they’re having a hard time hiring the skilled workers they need.

Now the thing is, they found the perfect crew over at ‹Location›, but the people they work for won’t let them go. Even hired extra armed guards to make sure of it.

What I want you to do, is go there and kill all the guards while making sure all the workers remain unharmed.

title: Happy Invictus
description:
Hello Citizens and Civilians,

The United Empire of Earth is proud to acknowledge the start of this year's Invictus ceremony. Originally started in 2542, the United Planets of Earth dispatched Naval ships to each of the settled planets to pick up the latest group of volunteers entering military service.

Now, over four hundred years later, Invictus continues this proud tradition of celebrating those among us who are standing up for others and protecting the Empire as well as showcasing the latest additions to the Naval fleet.

This year's festivities can be found on <EM4>ArcCorp in Stanton</EM4> and feature a great hall with some of the newest ships on display as well as the new <EM4>Idris Experience Tour</EM4> where you can tour an active-duty Idris, accessible at the top of the IO-North tower.

Accept this contract if you would like guidance to the festivities. As a special thank you, in partnership with the Mercenary Guild, attendees will be awarded ‹Scrip Amount› scrip.

Thank you and enjoy your Invictus.

title: Hauling ask.
description:
You been doing good work for us, so I got a favor to ask. I'll still pay you, but it's a favor. Got some cargo that needs to get bounced from <EM4>Rustville</EM4> to <EM4>Ruin Station above Pyro VI</EM4> and the guy that was supposed to do it found himself on the wrong side of an airlock, but hey, shit still needs to get done.

Only thing is you'll need a ship that can carry <EM4>4 SCU cargo containers</EM4>.  A <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> would also be smart to bring along. 

If you could sort it out for me, that'd be great.

- Stows out

title: Head Hunting
description:
The Headhunters have assembled a special strike team whose sole purpose is to attack, disrupt, and undermine our operations. As much as I’m loath to admit it, they’ve had a few small successes and are quickly becoming a concern. 

XenoThreat knows the best way to kill a snake is by cutting off its head, so we’re issuing a kill order for the strike team’s commander ‹Target Name›, who according to our intelligence sources, has been hiding at ‹Location› for a few days now. 

I’d expect strong resistance from the Headhunter forces there. From what we’ve heard, ‹Target Name› got this command partially because of the fierce loyalty they inspire in others. Putting your own crew together to tackle this would be a solid operational strategy. 

Happy Head Hunting,

Comm. Spec. Engler

title: Headhunter attack on ‹Location›
description:
A distress call just came in from ‹Location› claiming that a large Headhunter force has just attacked our outpost there. There have been multiple deaths and injuries from those who managed to flee the scene. We're looking for any available security personnel to head there and retake the outpost.

Witness accounts identified the attackers as elite Headhunter enforcers, so watch yourself out there and bring help if you can. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

title: Headhunter Needs Help
description:
You busy? A promising prospect was doing a special run for me but ran into trouble with the People’s Alliance around <EM4>‹Location›</EM4>. This one’s on me. Knew they weren’t the best dogfighter but thought they could do this without running into any other ships. 

Told ‘em to hold tight and do everything they can to stay alive until support gets there. Shouldn’t be too much trouble for someone with your skillset.  

-Stows

title: Headhunter Pilot in Trouble
description:
Just got word that a Headhunter over near ‹Location› got roped into a fight and now they can't see it through. The idiot wants me to save their sorry ass.

Guess I'm a soft touch, because I'm actually going to pay you to do it for me. What do you say? Wanna save a moron's life?

-Stows

description:
Seems we got some upstarts trying to muscle in our operations by hitting a Headhunter ship near ‹Location›. Not sure how they expected to get away with it.

They need to learn the hard way that's not how things work in Pyro. You up for heading over there and teaching these bastards a lesson?

- Stows out

description:
One of my pilots wasn't thinking straight and got themselves mixed up in a heap of trouble over at ‹Location›. 

The real kicker is the fool has a full hold. Can't really afford to lose the stuff they're carrying, so I'd appreciate it if you could go bail them out for me.

description:

Forget that. Instead, I figured I'd hire someone to go to Gundo to get my stuff and take it to ‹Destination› for me. I mean, what the hell are they gonna do about it? Anyway, it's what my brother would have wanted. It's gonna be the box marked 156.

- Ed

CFP Security forces have been attacking locals and we're looking to balance the scales. Caught wind of one in particular named ‹Target Name› who's been causing some damage and we need them taken out.

You can find them flying around ‹Location›. Go introduce yourself.

Stows out.

title: Hit on XenoThreat command
description:
These XenoThreat assholes are like aloprats. Every time you thing you wipe them out, they just pop back up again. They seem to be back to their usual shit and trying to put together something big. No idea what, but we've been cleared to stop it before it starts.

A group of XenoThreat biggies are supposedly meeting at ‹Location› to plan or just rage or whatever it is they do, but we're gonna bust it up. Or you are.

Head over there and wipe out everyone you find. Sure enough I'm sure the biggies will jump into the fight. That's what they always do.

This'll be a tough one. As much as I hate XenoThreat, they're damn good in a fight, so watch yourself and bring help if you can.

Stows out.

title: Hit XenoThreat at Remote Outpost near ‹Nearby Location›
description:
One of our people stumbled across a group of XenoThreat hiding out over near Remote Outpost near ‹Nearby Location›. Not sure if they're dug in or just passing through, but we want to hit them before they move.

Maybe bring some people if you got 'em because XenoThreat don't tend to go down easy. Get there and remind them who the power is in this system.

Stows out.

title: Hitting a CFP site
description:
Need someone to sweep Remote Outpost near ‹Nearby Location›. CFP security forces seized the outpost from a group of locals that'd been there for years. Beat the hell out of 'em from what I heard, so they came to Headhunters asking for revenge. 

Need it done fast and clean. 

Stows out.

title: Hot Shot
description:
You need a good weapon, yes? Have one for you. Small but powerful. Like an extra spicy balalu pepper. Wikelo make this pistol look extra spicy too. You bring things I need and I do a trade.

Bye.

title: Hunt Some Heads
enemyShips: Anvil F7C-R Hornet Tracker Mk I
Anvil F7C-S Hornet Ghost Mk I
description:
Got some asshole’s trying to push us out of the system. You up for pushing back?

See, there are some folks who really don’t want us here, and have started sending out hunting parties of five to seven ships, often with a bigger gun ship, to places where we’re building up our presence. Time for us to show that we’re here to stay.  

I’ve strung together a few spots starting at the <EM4>location marker</EM4> on your HUD where we’re seeing the most hostile encounters. Need you to visit each one and scan to see if we can bait them into a fight.

Know this is going to be a hard one, so don't be cocky and try to go it alone. If I were you, I'd bring at least <EM4>three friends</EM4> onboard for support. To make it worth your while, I'm promising a bonus of <EM4>‹Scrip Amount› Council Scrip</EM4> to the main contractor that pulls it off. 

- Stows

title: Hunt the Polaris
enemyShips: Anvil F7C-M Super Hornet Mk I
Anvil F7C-R Hornet Tracker Mk I
description:
*FOR IMMEDIATE SYSTEM-WIDE RELEASE*

This is a call to arms for all available Civilian Defense Force volunteers. An RSI Polaris corvette on its way to Invictus Launch Week festivities has been hijacked by the terrorist organization the Frontier Fighters. Initial intelligence reports indicate they’re attempting to escape into the Pyro system.

The Navy has officially requested for any CDF volunteers to help provide combat support immediately to neutralize this threat and prevent the Frontier Fighters from escaping with the stolen capital ship.  Additionally, as a further incentive, those who assist us in this endeavor will be awarded <EM4>‹Scrip Amount› MG Scrip</EM4> along with a small token of our appreciation.

SAIC Rowena Dulli from the Advocacy is the official attaché to the CDF and will be running the operation.

title: ICC Special Delivery
description:
Hi,

Not sure if you ever heard of them, but a rep from the ICC (they make starmaps and study space for the empire) just reached out to us about a special job they need picked up from Wikelo's Emporium. 

Kind of surprised to be honest that they having any dealings there since that Banu's trading-post doesn't exactly scream "cutting-edge science" to me.

Anyway, they want the delivery brought from there to [Destination|Target|Address]. They also emphasized that the cargo's very delicate so make sure that you use kid gloves when you're handling it, okay? (Not that you aren't careful normally, but you know how clients are.) 

Be sure to bring a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> and a ship with enough space to store <EM4>1 SCU cargo</EM4>.

Thanks,  
Conni Ling 
Cargo Logistics Coordinator 
Ling Family Hauling

title: Idea for Isaac
description:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Idea for Isaac

WORK BRIEF: 
I need your help with a plan I've come up with for Isaac. <EM4>I'll give you the details in person</EM4>, but it will involve heading back into Moraine territory, so you'll need to be prepared.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon entire crew's status confirmation.

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

title: Idris War Game
description:
To test the preparedness of our response teams, we would like volunteers to simulate an assault against a CDF Idris by neutralizing and taking control of the vessel.

To be clear, the goal of the exercise is not to destroy the Idris, but for you to attempt to board the craft and maintain control of it as long as possible. Volunteers should expect to meet full resistance from the Idris' highly trained crew and are encouraged to get an updated imprint beforehand.

Coordinates will be provided upon confirming your participation.

Thanks and good luck.

title: Illegal Blockade - Neutralizing Nine Tails Fleet
description:
Crusader Security has confirmed the location of the outlaw Nine Tails fleet responsible and is mobilizing now to end the quantum blockade of ‹Location›.

We are again seeking trained security professionals to join with our emergency response efforts and assist in neutralizing this dangerous threat.

Before accepting, please be aware that the Nine Tails are fully expected to offer considerable resistance and that until the blockade is ended, quantum travel will not be possible in the sector.

CONTRACT AUTHORIZED BY:
Director Sasha Rust
ID# 122L964G

title: Illegal Blockade - Seeking Nine Tails Fleet Responsible
description:
Crusader Security has learned that the criminal organization known as the Nine Tails have set an illegal blockade around ‹Location› and stopped all incoming and outgoing quantum traffic in the sector.

The outlaw fleet must be located, and the blockade terminated.

We are urgently requesting any trained security professionals in the system to join Crusader Security forces and protect our scanning ships as they seek out the location of the Nine Tails fleet causing this blockade.

Please bear in mind that with quantum travel disabled and numerous hostiles in the area, this should be considered a high-risk operation. Proper equipment and a full tank of fuel is strongly recommended for all pilots joining this emergency response effort. 

CONTRACT AUTHORIZED BY:
Director Sasha Rust
ID# 122L964G

title: Illegal Blockade – Medical Supplies Needed
description:
The illegal quantum blockade of ‹Location› has interrupted normal trade routes and essentials are in short supply. 

Crusader Security is looking for traders and haulers to provide much needed medical supplies to the station. 

Prices offered by the station administration will be adjusted to reflect the situation with the Nine Tails, and in addition, Crusader will provide a hazard bonus upon successful transfer of the medical supplies because of the increased risk. 

Thank you in advance for your support during these difficult times.

CONTRACT AUTHORIZED BY:
Director Sasha Rust
ID# 122L964G

title: Illegal Monitors Detected
description:
ABOUT THE JOB
At microTech, we aim to foster a contract experience that is collaborative, friendly and fun. We are looking for a detail-oriented pilot who brings an analytical mind to problem solving and deep knowledge of strategic combat solutions to complete this project on time and with few to no errors. 

RESPONSIBILITIES
* Scan the area to locate the MT Protection Services that have been preforming illegal surveillance while hidden in microTech controlled space. 
* These so-called "data skimmers" are equipped with security protocols that will attempt to upload their datastores when attacked.
* Destroy all the skimmers before the upload can complete.
 
LOCATION
‹Location›

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
* Equivalency degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 2 years of combined mercenary and security experience with an emphasis on combat piloting.
* Ability to procure a combat rated ship.
* Available for immediate deployment.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
* Experience with PDC Monitors.
* Strong scanning and demolition skills.

title: In the Wake of Disaster
description:
Fortune has shined upon us once again. I’ve just learned of a battle near ‹Location› that’s just transpired far from the prying eyes of any meddlesome comm arrays, and reinforcements from either of the forces involved have yet to be dispatched. This means that there is a window of opportunity for an enterprising soul to pick the graveyard clean.
 
I’d like to extend this opportunity to all my trusted contacts. Any and all interested parties can have the location… for the right price. Coordinates will be provided once you accept the contract and will remain available until you choose to terminate it.

Of course, speed will be of the essence as you will not only face potential competition from other salvagers, but also the looming possibility of reinforcements arriving to survey the battlefield. 

If you’re still hesitating, just remember, fortune favors the bold.

-cd

description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Destroy Server
APPROVAL CODE = VS-14

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

Our client has requested the immediate destruction of a group of servers located at a long-shuttered ASD research site. The servers in question contain information that our client considers extremely damaging and is eager to see the data completely eliminated.

Initial surveillance indicates the servers are within the facility’s <EM4>Energy Lab, located in the Research wing</EM4>. We’ve also picked up on a number of hostile forces, so be on alert.

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

title: Inmate Maintenance Opportunity
description:
Hello Guests,

We have recently been alerted that one of our Oxygen Dispensers has suffered a technical error. As you know these kiosks are vital to ensure that you have plenty of oxygen handy while participating in our Work Release Program.

We are looking for any available guest to reset the kiosk. That should reconnect the kiosk to the network and resolve the issue. The first guest who's able to complete this task will not only be compensated with merits, but also with the satisfaction that they're making the workplace safer for other guests.

Thank you.

We’ve been contracted to dramatically reduce the current population of these species to help avoid an environmental collapse. We need a dedicated and highly skilled exterminator to carry out this contract.     

You can better acquaint yourself with the creatures in question by referencing <EM4>"The Guide to Stanton Wildlife"</EM4> in your Journal.

Wanda Werkheiser
Contract Manager

title: Inter-Outpost Delivery at ‹Destination›
description:
Hey,

We’ve got an opportunity for any haulers interested in lending a hand or two to Citizens for Prosperity.

There’s a box that needs to be moved from <EM4>‹Location›</EM4> to <EM4>‹Destination›</EM4>. Shouldn’t take long, if you’re around the outpost and available. 

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

title: Inter-Outpost Delivery at ‹Destination› - Multiple Boxes
description:
Hi,

Citizens for Prosperity needs help moving supplies around one of our outposts. The boxes need to be picked up from <EM4>‹Location›</EM4> and taken to <EM4>‹Destination›</EM4>. 

Doesn’t sound too difficult, does it? Just make sure you’re wearing a comfy pair of shoes. Also, to make your life easier, I'd bring a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

title: Intercepted Supply Run
description:
Life is tough on the frontier, and every delivery to our settlers is important. We really can't afford to lose any more this year.

One of our key suppliers has been hit by a group of outlaws over at <EM4>‹Location›</EM4> and gone silent on us. I fear the worst, but if we can still recover the supplies they were transporting, it could make a huge difference.

Chances are the outlaws who attacked them are still lurking around there so be on your guard. Once you've dealt with them, grab the cargo and take it to the freight elevator at <EM4>‹Destination›</EM4>. Make sure you're flying a ship that can carry <EM4>32 SCU cargo containers</EM4> and bring a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> too.

Fly safe out there,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

title: Interdict XenoThreat Attack Force
description:
Multiple reports are coming in of XenoThreat ships massing at <EM4>‹Location›</EM4>
We're looking for contractors ready to take the fight to them. 

They want us to believe that they have right on their side. They want us to believe that they have overwhelming force. This is a chance to show them we know better.

I won't lie, this is more than just a simple security contract to me. I really hate those intolerant assholes and everything they stand for.

You with me?

Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

title: Interested in Building a Better Future?
description:
To all available contractors,

Rayari Incorporated is looking for independent contractors to provide additional support in our efforts to push the boundaries of science, agriculture, and medicine in the Empire and beyond. 

A research initiative at <EM4>‹Destination›</EM4> is in desperate need of resources, so we are looking for a reliable contractor to obtain and deliver these crucial components.

For more information on the materials in question, refer to "A Forager's Guide" in your Journal.

Rayari offers competitive wages along with the knowledge that you're building a better universe.

Let’s grow together,

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing

title: inventory clear out
description:
A client of mine‘s trying to negotiate a deal, but isn’t having much luck. The other party feels like they got all the leverage because they’re sitting comfortably on a pile of inventory. To help move the negotiations along, I’m gonna need you to head down to ‹Location› and destroy all the drugs on site. 

Now, I should probably tell you that the site’s being protected by some very serious people, so getting to the stash is going to be a bit tricky, but I trust you’ll find a way.

title: Investigate Headhunters Outpost
description:
Hey,

I’ve been tracking Headhunters activity at ‹Location›. Recently, they stocked it with supplies we believe were stolen from one of our cargo convoys. ‹Target Name› offered to go get our goods back but hasn’t checked in since. Really need to know what happened to them and if our supplies are there.

Think this is something you could handle? You’ll probably have to deal with Headhunters forces to get to the bottom of this. Also, any goods you grab should go to ‹Destination› once you’re out of there.

Thanks, 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

title: Investigate Missing Pilot and Cargo
description:
A local courier who has been working for Citizen for Prosperity, ‹Target Name›, was reported missing earlier this week. We believe that they may have been captured by members of XenoThreat who were after the encrypted data-drives and important cargo they were transporting for us.  

We would like you to go to ‹Location› to ascertain what has happened to ‹Target Name›, destroy any servers which may be housing the stolen data,  and deliver the recovered cargo to ‹Destination›.

It's a lot to ask, but I believe you're up to the challenge.
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

title: Investigate Wreckage Claim
description: ‹Contractor›

title: Jackpot
description:
Looking for a hauler to pick up some cargo for me. Thing is, there’s a catch.

The cargo’s in the back of an abandoned ship located at <EM4>‹Location›</EM4>. As you may have figured, this ain’t our cargo, but it sure as hell doesn’t deserve to go to anyone else. I’ll be damned if those CFP assholes get their hands on it before we do.

Be lucky as hell if we were the first to know about this, but I’d wager there’s gonna be more ships swarming around there than flies on a kopion carcass. If you got some pals you can trust, bring them along and ghost those assholes. And don’t forget your <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> of course.

You manage to get that cargo and bring it to the freight elevator at <EM4>‹Destination›</EM4>, I can get you a nice cut of the sale.

Stows out.

Hockrow Agency 
Case File #JD10285
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Summary: 
A client has requested that Hockrow compile a complete dossier on infamous scientist <EM4>Dr. Logan Jorrit</EM4>. Believed responsible for the incidents at Associated Science & Development’s Lazarus site, the client is eager to get a broader view of Dr. Logan and his research.

Contract Investigator Actions: 
Gain access to ASD’s shuttered <EM4>Onyx Facility</EM4> where Dr. Jorrit was formerly the Lead Scientist.  Once there, locate and <EM4>access the research lab’s personnel files</EM4> so that we can get an overview of what was going on there.

Additional Notes:
The QT beacon to the site was deactivated when the facility went dark so you'll have to fly the last leg manually.

While ASD has formally closed the facility, caution is still advised. Not only may the labs themselves be hazardous, but the surrounding area shows signs of recent visitors. Scavengers or squatters may be on site.

I've also managed to wrangle an employee ID code for you so as long as you're on the job, you'll be able to access the computers there. 

Additionally, Onyx Facility only has large hangars available, so plan your travel appropriately.

All your digging around Onyx has paid off. I’ve been able to confirm that Jorrit has been operating an off-the-record lab in the facility’s Site-B in order to conduct an experiment he calls “Project Hyperion.” I’ll send his <EM4>lab notes to your mobiGlas journal</EM4> once you’re underway, but the long and short of it is the bastard is trying to make Humans evolve or some nonsense like that.

The client wants the experimental data, so you’re going back to Onyx and do everything needed to get Project Hyperion up and running. 

Contract Investigator Actions:
Prep the experiment by collecting a <EM4>Reagent code from the Engineering wing</EM4> and a <EM4>Catalyst code from the Research wing</EM4>.

Need someone to take out a <EM4>‹Ambush Target›</EM4> and deal with the escort ships protecting it. Think you can get in that wreck, grab the blackbox, and get out? We’ll pay you for it.

But hey, your call. As long as it gets done.

-Bit Zeros

title: let's help each other
description:
Hey there. I heard you ended up in Klescher which is a real drag. But it might actually be a lucky day for both of us.

Long story short, I had somebody sneaking a datachip out of the prison, but they never got back to me. I know for a fact they haven’t left the facility, so I think something might have happened to them. While tragic, business must carry on. If you can get the chip and finish the job, I can clear your crimestat for you. What do you say?

Of course, I don't know exactly how far they got, but I can tell you that the prison's got a whole network of hidden tunnels my guy was planning on using to make his escape. My guess is his corpse is rotting away somewhere there.

Once you find the body, I’m hoping the chip will still be on him. When you’ve got it, finish escaping and get the data to me. There’s a spot nearby you can upload the chip’s contents. 

One warning though, you might want to watch out for Hurston Security. They've been a hassle lately, so I wouldn't be surprised if you ran into them.

When I've got the data I’ll wipe your crimestat and then, voila, you’ll be free and clear. What you do after that is entirely up to you.

title: Long Overdue
description:
Rough & Ready have been in business with ‹Target Name› for years but that relationship has taken a turn for the worse. For a while, we were supplying them with fuel on credit but when it came time to collect the coward went into hiding. If ‹Target Name› can’t pay with creds, guess they’re gonna pay with their life.

An associate just clocked ‹Target Name› at ‹Location›. I’d love for you to head there now to make the stingy bastard pay.

By the way, it looks like ‹Target Name› isn’t traveling alone, so I’d make sure you’re fully stocked before going after ‘em. 

- Smokey

title: Lookin' for Zeta-Prolanide
description:
Word is that a lot of Zeta-Prolanide has been stolen from ‹Location›.

If you happen to come across any, bring it over to Reclamation & Disposal Orinth and we'll make sure you get a good price.

And if not, you can abandon this offer, no hard feelings.

title: Looking for a Damn Hero
description:
Got ourselves in a real mess here. A Headhunters ship on an important mission got attacked near <EM4>‹Location›</EM4>. Can’t get too into the specifics but it’s absolutely vital that they survive. The People’s Alliance know this too because they’re throwing everything they can at ‘em.

Not gonna pull any punches. This is a serious-ass situation that many wouldn’t survive. If you do, I’ll sing your praises and make sure you’re paid well.   

-Stows

title: Looking for Closure
description: They said that I could find someone here to go to Gundo for me and grab a crate that belonged to my wife. If the name didn't ring a bell, that's the station where they had that big accident. My wife worked for Covalex and I know it's not really going to make losing her any easier, but I really just want Claudia's stuff back. I think about her photo collection or the necklace I gave her just sitting there in that cold dead station in some box marked 249 and it's not right. She deserves better. So how about it? You willing to go to Gundo and haul her crate back to ‹Destination›?

title: Looking For Trouble
enemyShips: Anvil F7C-R Hornet Tracker Mk I
Anvil F7C-S Hornet Ghost Mk I
description:
I’ve noticed an uptick in attacks on Headhunter ships and it's got me feelin' jumpy. Got an important resupply shipment that we can’t afford to lose, and need help determining what route to send it. I’ve strung together a few potential spots that I’d set up in if I was gonna hit ‘em. Any chance you could visit and clear out any lowlifes that may be hiding there? 

The route starts at the <EM4>location marker</EM4> on your HUD. After you scan it and clear whatever’s there, I’ll send you to a few other areas that could work. I’ve been hearing people have been rolling through these spots, so would be smart to <EM4>bring a friend</EM4> to watch your back.

You make it to the end and I'll give the main contractor a bonus <EM4>‹Scrip Amount› Council Scrip</EM4> as thanks. 

- Stows

description:

Head there with a crew of your own and a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> to take the goods away. Make sure they’re the best people you got. It’d be a mistake to underestimate these bastards.

Ghost them and bring my cargo back to the freight elevator at <EM4>‹Destination›</EM4> and I’ll make sure you’re seriously comp’d for this.

-Twitch

Citizens for Prosperity

title: My Dad's Stuff
description:
Hi,

I'm looking for someone to head to the Covalex Gundo station near Crusader and grab some items. I know this may sound like stealing, but it's my dad's stuff. You see, he was on Gundo station when it had its accident. My mom says that we need to wait until Covalex says so, but I don't think that's fair because I miss him so much. I would like something to remember him by and I don't want to wait any longer because I might start forgetting things. I'll pay you to get box 510 for me and take to ‹Destination› so I can have it.

Thank you very much,
Baylor Ward

title: My Deepest Condolences
description:
Whilst we pride ourselves on our efficiency and general cleanliness when it comes to our work, sometimes our contractors can get a little carried away themselves. Circumstances surrounding a former contractor’s death, and more importantly, the target, are somewhat unclear to us.

We’ll need you to travel to <EM4>‹Location›</EM4> and locate <EM4>‹Target Name›</EM4>’s body so we can deliver clear confirmation to our client. As for the former contractor… you needn’t concern yourself with them. Arrangements for disposal have already been made.

Sincerely,

Vaughn

title: Navy Patrol Training – Scenario #1
description:
If travelling to different star systems around the Empire, helping those in need, and protecting our borders sounds like a rewarding career to you, then maybe you’re ready to become a pilot in the UEE Navy.

The overall demand for naval pilots has increased in recent years which means there’s now more opportunity than ever before. However, to become a Navy pilot, you need to go through specialist training and gain many hours of flight experience.

To give you a small taste of what life as a combat pilot would be like, Gilly’s Flight School has partnered with the UEE Navy to offer a unique opportunity to take a special Patrol Training course that will run you through three scenarios covering a basic patrol. 

<EM4>SIGN UP NOW FOR SCENARIO #1 – Scanning a Patrol Point</EM4>

I believe that folks learn best by doing, so don’t expect a lot of hand holding out there. This is about throwing you into the deep end and giving you a chance to swim. You never know what you’re capable of until you’re given the chance.

As a bonus on completion of the scenario, the original contract holder will be awarded ‹Scrip Amount› MG Scrip. Plus, completing all three will get you a special keepsake.

Can’t wait to see you out there,
Instructor Gilly

ABOUT GILLY FLIGHT SCHOOL
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”

title: Navy Patrol Training – Scenario #2
description:
Congrats on completing part one of this three-part course.

For your next patrol scenario, things are going to become even more intense.

Be prepared to encounter some hostiles and dogfight them in a realistic combat scenario just like real Navy pilots do while out on patrol.

The hostile ships are all specially equipped rigs made specifically for training purposes and will be piloted by graduates of the flight school to provide an engaging and educational experience.

<EM4>SIGN UP NOW FOR SCENARIO #2 – Neutralizing a Hostile Threat</EM4>

As a bonus on completion of the scenario, the original contract holder will be awarded ‹Scrip Amount› MG Scrip.

Make sure you pick a ship ready for combat and I’ll see you out there,
Instructor Gilly

ABOUT GILLY FLIGHT SCHOOL
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”

title: Navy Patrol Training – Scenario #3
description:
Congrats on completing part two of this three-part course.

For your next and final lesson, you will learn how to assist a ship in distress just like real Navy pilots do while out on patrol. They will be under simulated attack by our specially trained hostile pilots and it will be up to you to neutralize them as quickly and effectively as possible.

<EM4>SIGN UP NOW FOR SCENARIO #3 – Ship in Distress</EM4>

As a bonus on completion of the scenario, the original contract holder will be awarded ‹Scrip Amount› MG Scrip and a special keepsake.

I know you’re going to do great out there,
Instructor Gilly

They've been on the run, so they're gonna be skittish. I'd approach with caution.
