title: Need a Hauler
description:
Hi, we need to move some cargo across the system and were wondering if you could help. I know this is outside your usual purview, but I'm low on options. This would also be a great way to show your committed to Citizens for Prosperity's greater mission here.

If you head to <EM4>Jackson's Swap</EM4>, there should be some cargo accessible via a freight elevator that we'll need you to take to another freight elevator at <EM4>Ruin Station above Pyro VI</EM4>.

Only thing to call out is that your ship must be able to handle <EM4>4 SCU cargo containers</EM4>. To make your life easier, be sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. Otherwise, it should be a simple run. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

title: Need a hitter
description:
So here's the deal, we got some small time dirtbags who think they're hotshots running out of a base near ‹Location›. I don't know what toxic shit they're drinking but they thought it'd be a good idea to step to some Headhunter Clips. Killed one, injured three more. So I'm looking to send someone there to blast their ambition right out of their skulls.

Head over and get it done. You'll get a nice bump of creds for it.

- Stows

title: need an out?
description:
Hi there. We haven’t had a chance to work together yet but I’m in a bit of a bind here and I could use another body. Not for nothing, of course. I’m all for a good quid pro quo.

One of my associates who was serving some time in Klescher was supposed to bring me a datachip, but then they went quiet. Now I’m assuming they’re dead, but here’s the deal: if you finish his job, I wipe your crimestat. Not bad, right?

Your predecessor was apparently planning on using some old tunnels to make his escape. He made it sound like they weren't exactly the easiest thing to access, but I trust you can figure it out. I'm guessing you'll find his body somewhere in there and if we’re lucky, he'll still have the chip on him.

Once you get it, finish getting out however you can. Then get the data to me. There’s a spot nearby you can upload the chip’s contents. You might want to watch out for Hurston Security, though. They've been a hassle lately, so I wouldn't be surprised if you ran into them. After I get the data and validate it, I’ll wipe your crimestat. 

Then you can go and enjoy your newfound freedom. If you do this right, maybe I’ll have more lucrative work for you down the line.

title: Need multiple CFP outposts retaken
description:
The outlaw presence here has become much bolder of late and a lot of people are getting hurt. We've recently lost several clusters around Shepherd's Rest. While we don't like to have to resort to violence, the board has acknowledged that these locations are crucial to establishing stability in the system and authorized the use of a security detail to retake them.

We're also aware that the embedded hostiles are being led by ‹Target Name› who's had a history of attacking CFP interests. The board would like ‹Target Name› dealt with to prevent future attacks.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

title: Need Resource for Research

requires.title: Interested in Building a Better Future?

description:
To all available contractors,

Our research team at at <EM4>‹Destination›</EM4> is working tirelessly on solving the current ‘Regen Crisis’ and addressing the issue of unstable imprints. Their work has produced promising results, but a lack of a key resource is impeding their ability to run further experiments. 

We’ve received word from our supplier that increased demand combined with lower mining yields means that we won’t receive our scheduled shipment for another few months. Our research team can’t wait that long, and we’re hoping you can help.      

The resource is hard to come by, but we have it on good authority that the old Hathor mining facilities were built in areas with a high concentration of the ore. Since Hathor went defunct not long after establishing their operations in- system, there’s a good chance that activating one of these mining lasers could provide you with what we need.

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing

title: Need Some Ore Mined
description:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Need Some Ore Mined

WORK BRIEF: 
Got a moment? Need someone to fly over to locate <EM4>‹Amount To Scan› of Aluminium, ‹Amount To Scan 2› of Iron and ‹Amount To Scan 3› of Ice</EM4> and mine at least <EM4>‹Amount To Scan› of Aluminium, ‹Amount To Scan 2› of Iron and ‹Amount To Scan 3› of Ice</EM4> <EM4>Asteroid</EM4>. We're updating our database for future mining expeditions. You can keep what you find, we just need the data. These should be pretty easy to find.

Also, if new to mining, <EM4>the United Resource Workers wrote a helpful journal that you should check out in your mobi.</EM4>

Let me know if you’re up for it.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon full area scan confirmation and extraction.

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

title: Need someone taken out

Got a crew that's been hitting Headhunter ships lately. Their leader's a real piece of work named ‹Target Name›. We've tracked them to  Remote Outpost near ‹Nearby Location›, so we're looking for someone to put them down for good.

This group likes to fight, but shouldn't be a problem for someone like you. 

Get over there and get it done.

Stows out.

title: Neutralize Dangerous Criminal Fleet
description:
A criminal fleet has taken up root in a sector that Citizens For Prosperity is trying to develop and all forward progress has stopped thanks to their violent actions. It is imperative to a long term goals that we find a way to neutralize this fleet before that cause any further damage.

You and your most trusted support ships will head to ‹Location› and neutralize any hostiles you find laying in wait there. They have been known to operate in smaller packs, so it's vital that you wait until all of the hostiles have been dealt with.

Your assistance is much appreciated,
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

description:
HURSTON DYNAMICS OUTSOURCING
CONTRACT: Neutralize Hostile Force
OUTSOURCE MANAGER: T. Dalik
RISK ASSESSMENT: High

Our security forces have been notified of an ongoing outlaw incursion at Exterior Zone 2, and we are in need of an independent operator capable of clearing out the hostile actors. 

According to onsite personnel, the outlaws are currently holed up near the Exterior Zone 2. Approach with caution and be prepared to use lethal force if the outlaws resist being removed.

Payment will only be authorized once the location has been effectively cleared.

** The information transmitted may contain confidential and/or privileged material. Any review, retransmission, dissemination, or other use of or taking action in reliance upon this information by persons or entities other than the intended recipient is prohibited. **

Thanks to the work of our Intelligence team, we've been able to track them down to <EM4>‹Location›</EM4>.

Head there as soon as you can and engage before they have a chance to leave the system. Based on our strategic analysis, we recommend a <EM4>well-armed and skilled fleet</EM4> will be necessary for the successful completion of this mission.

description:
Some competition has taken root at ‹Location› and they've really been gumming up the works for our operations in the area.

Now part of me sees some potential in the upstarts so I'm hoping to bring them into fold, but at the same time, I can't really afford to have them flying around causing trouble.

Instead, I want you to go and blow up their fuel tanks. That should keep them grounded long enough for me to talk some sense into their thick heads.

-Stows out

description:
I have a very specific task that requires my best people. 

Something unusual seems to have occurred over at <EM4>‹Location›</EM4>. One of our contractors seems to have gone rogue after completing their assignment, refusing to communicate with us, and indiscriminately attacking those they come across. Now, I have other methods for dealing with renegade assets but our client still requires confirmation of the original target’s death which we are unable to provide due to this pilot’s presence.

I need you to head to the location and identify that <EM4>‹Target Name›</EM4> is well and truly dead, preferably without being obliterated by this former, disgruntled contractor. As a fair warning, they were one of our most thorough, and ruthless employees, so extreme caution is advised. You will want to bring your most competent of allies to support you with this.

We at Rayari are stopping at nothing to halt the ongoing regeneration crisis, but to continue their efforts our scientists need a rare resource that the company's suppliers cannot obtain. 

Rayari is seeking an experienced contractor to gather <EM4>irradiated valakkar pearls</EM4>, which can be extracted from apex valakkar that have been extensively exposed to radiation. Narina Lerrem

Clinical Research Outsourcing

‹Target Name› and ‹Target Name 2›

As far as them putting up resistance, ‹Target Name› is known to bring along a friend to watch their back, and I suspect ‹Target Name 2› will do likewise.

title: Opportunity for Independent Cargo Hauler
description:
Earning such accolades as 'Imperial Finances' Top 10 Shipping Companies' and 'Delivery Digest's 2945's Most Trusted Transport,' Covalex is busier than ever. And that means more cargo going to more places. That's where you come in.  

Covalex is looking for dependable and industrious pilots to join our expanding family. Do you have access to a ship that can hold <EM4>1 SCU cargo containers</EM4>? Can you pass an Advocacy background check if required? Then a universe of opportunity is waiting for you. 

Simply complete an 'Evaluation Trial’ by picking up a shipment of <EM4>Quartz</EM4> from a freight elevator at <EM4>‹Location›</EM4> and successfully delivering it to a freight elevator at <EM4>‹Destination›</EM4>.

Upon satisfactory completion, you'll be eligible to become part of Covalex Shipping's vast network of independent transport specialists*.

By the way, we strongly encourage contractors to bring a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> along.   

Covalex Shipping  
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

*Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

Got a large scale order from the Crusader folks to help them fix up their platforms. Big order means a big payout.

When you're done collecting all the materials, take them to <EM4>Seraphim Station</EM4> and job's a good'un.

Ta very much,
Hal Grimsby
Contracts Manager

CORNERSTONE MAINTENANCE
"Building on the Foundations of our Past."

title: Orison Relief: Large Supply Haul
description:
Hey, it’s El.

Off the bat – this particular job’s a big deal, so if you’re looking to take this one on for us, make sure you’re confident in your ability to do a job well. 

We’ve been contracted by Crusader to deliver medical supplies to <EM4>Seraphim Station</EM4>. Pick up’s at <EM4>[Location|Target|Address]</EM4>. Bear in mind, this is gonna be a big one, so make sure bring a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> and a ship that can hold <EM4>16 SCU cargo containers</EM4> otherwise it might be a little rough.

I can’t stress the importance of this contract enough – lots of good people got hurt in those attacks, and it’s our responsibility to do what we can to help them in the aftermath. We owe the victims that much, at the very least.

Let’s do right by them,

Ella Tieno 
Jr. Logistics Coordinator 
Covalex Shipping   
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

title: Orison Relief: Medical Aid Delivery
description:
Hello,

Crusader has asked us here at Ling Family Hauling to aid their relief efforts, and it’s extremely important to us as a business and a family to do this right. The thought of what happened to the victims of Orison happening to anyone in my family… We owe it to the survivors to do everything in our power to help them.
The medical supplies Crusader needs are set to get picked up from <EM4>[Location|Target|Address]</EM4> and needs to be dropped at <EM4>August Dunlow Spaceport</EM4>. And be sure to bring a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to speed things along.

Thank you, 
Conni Ling
Shipment Coordinator
Ling Family Hauling

title: Orison Relief: Medium Fabrication Order
description:
Hullo,

Crusader have been in touch to say that the scale of the damage to their platforms is greater than they initially thought and they'll need more propulsors than they originally estimated for.

We're contracting out their request to anyone with an available Item Fabricator standing by. Though I guess you could source the propulsors some other way, but that's on you.

Once ready, deliver them to <EM4>August Dunlow Spaceport</EM4>. Payment sent on completion.

Ta very much,
Hal Grimsby
Contracts Manager

CORNERSTONE DEVELOPMENTS
"Building on the Foundations of our Past."

title: Orison Relief: Medium Materials Order
description:
Ey up,

We're still on the hunt for more materials to help Crusader after the Nine Tails attack. Need a bit more this time though. Will make sure you're compensated accordingly.

After you've got the materials, head to <EM4>August Dunlow Spaceport</EM4> and we'll get it sorted.

Ta very much,
Hal Grimsby
Contracts Manager

CORNERSTONE MAINTENANCE
"Building on the Foundations of our Past."

title: Orison Relief: Medium Supply Haul
description:
Hey, it’s El.

Crusader is still trying to make things right in Orison following the attack, so I’m hoping you’re free to keep assisting with the effort.

We been contracted to deliver relief supplies to <EM4>August Dunlow Spaceport</EM4>. Pick up’s at <EM4>[Location|Target|Address]</EM4>. 
Not too shabby a haul either, so make sure you’re in a ship that can hold <EM4>8 SCU cargo containers</EM4> and bring a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4>, or you’ll make us all look unprofessional.

I’m not kidding around with this job being important to get done right. Lotta people got hurt during the Nine Tails raid, and they’re relying on people like us to get them the help they need. So let’s do right by them, okay?

Ella Tieno 
Jr. Logistics Coordinator 
Covalex Shipping   
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

title: Orison Relief: Neutralize Nine Tails Reprisal
enemyNpcs: Squad C - Soldier or Tech x 2
Squad E - Soldier or Tech x 2
Squad F - Soldier or Tech x 1
description:
Some of the Nine Tails responsible for the attack on Orison have reportedly been sighted around <EM4>‹Location›</EM4> marshalling their forces. Crusader is concerned they’re planning another attack, so this is a job that needs doing well.

You’ll be tasked with infiltrating the site and neutralizing the Nine Tails however necessary before they can enact a retaliation attempt on Orison. As I’m sure you’re aware, these guys are bad news, so be careful they don’t get the better of you.

Good luck,

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

title: Orison Relief: Small Fabrication Order
description:
Now then,
 
After the Nine Tails attack, the folks at Crusader could do with more than just a helping hand. What they need are proper propulsors to help replace the ones damaged in the attacks.
 
We've attached a blueprint for the TH-01 Propulsor that you can access at an <EM4>Item Fabricator.</EM4> Just search for it on the fabricator's terminal and you'll be able to see what materials are needed. Up to you whether you go out and find those materials yourself or buy them from a trader. (And if you don't have a fabricator yet, you'll have to purchase one at a shop, unload it at a freight elevator, and then set it up in a hangar or ship's cargo bay.) 
 
Once you're done bring them to <EM4>August Dunlow Spaceport</EM4> and one of the team will sort out the rest.
 
Ta very much,
Hal Grimsby
Contracts Manager

CORNERSTONE DEVELOPMENTS
"Building on the Foundations of our Past."

title: Orison Relief: Small Materials Order
description:
Now then,

You might have heard about the recent attacks on the Orison platforms. Terrible stuff. The folks at Crusader are scrambling around trying to put it all back together and have contracted us to help.

To get them back on their feet what we need is construction materials. Can give you a decent pay packet for them too.

If you don't know already how to get construction materials, your best bet is to read United Resource Workers' <EM4>A Salvager's Guide to Material Collection</EM4>. That'll set you on the right path.

Once you've got the order ready, you'll need to drop it all off at <EM4>August Dunlow Spaceport</EM4>.

Ta very much,
Hal Grimsby
Contracts Manager

CORNERSTONE MAINTENANCE
"Building on the Foundations of our Past."

title: Orison Relief: Small Supply Haul
description:
Hey, it’s El.

Need a reliable contractor for a pretty important delivery today. I’m sure you’re aware of what went down in Orison, big commotion. Made my job about ten times harder.

Anyway, we’ve been contracted by Crusader to deliver some medical stuff to <EM4>August Dunlow Spaceport</EM4>. Pick up’s at <EM4>[Location|Target|Address]</EM4>. Shouldn’t be too heavy an order for this one, just make sure you’ve got a ship that can hold <EM4>1 SCU cargo containers</EM4> and a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4>, or you’ll really embarrass yourself when you get there.

Look, I’ll level with you. This job isn’t just hauling for hauling’s sake. Orison got pretty messed up by those Nine Tails, so anything we can do to help them out is probably the right thing to do.

Let’s get it done,

Ella Tieno 
Jr. Logistics Coordinator 
Covalex Shipping   
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

title: Orison Relief: Stop Nine Tails Regrouping
description:
Just got word that some of the Nine Tails involved in the recent assault on Orison are convening near <EM4>‹Location›</EM4> before launching their next attack. We need a capable fighter pilot to head them off and take care of them before they start wreaking havoc again.

To complicate matters, from what we know there’s a very high chance that they might have additional reinforcements inbound, so be sure the extra ships don’t take you by surprise.

All the best,

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

title: Orison Relief: Strike Nine Tails Squad
description:
Looking for a tough and competent pilot in the area willing to take on some of the outlaws responsible for the attack on Crusader. We’ve received word that a group of Nine Tails stragglers are hunkering down near <EM4>‹Location›</EM4> after they got pushed out of Orison, and Crusader Security wants our help dealing with them while they’re down. 

We’ve mapped out a good spot in the area to get the drop on them, so you’ll go there, wait quietly until they show up, and hit them before they know what’s happening. Hopefully this’ll send a message to the rest of them out there that their actions have consequences.

Good luck,

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

title: Our Version of The Truth
enemyShips: Anvil F7C-M Super Hornet Mk I
Anvil F7C-R Hornet Tracker Mk I
Anvil F7C-S Hornet Ghost Mk I
description:
I’m not gonna give you the whole backstory of what this person has done to us, but all you need to know is that some scumbag is trying to get a payout for a ship crash and the insurance company wants to see the blackbox recording to make sure everything is “above board”.

We’re not gonna let that happen though.

Snatch that blackbox at <EM4>‹Location›</EM4> and bring it to us instead so we can do some “creative editing” on the recording.

Apparently, this area is a bit of a hot zone. Probably why they staged the accident there. You should probably bring some backup so you don’t get ghosted before you can bring the blackbox to us at <EM4>[Destination|Target|Address]</EM4>.

-Bit Zeros

title: Oust Claimjumpers
description:
POSTING: Security / Mercenary 
LOCATION: ‹Lagrange Location›
WORK EXPERIENCE: Combat Pilot (Military Experience a Plus)
TERMS*: 
A local Stanton independent mining team was working ‹Location› as Shubin Interstellar contractors when a hostile force attacked and took over the site. We believe that the perpetrators are still at the claim using the equipment left behind to harvest the valuable ore there for themselves.

Among the equipment lost were a handful of orbital sentries that had unfortunately not yet been fully deployed at the time of the attack. Long range scans of the claim have led us to conclude that the outlaws have activated the orbital sentries and are using them to protect their illegal operations.

To reclaim the site, we are seeking contractors to go to ‹Location›, destroy the orbital sentries, and clear the site of hostile miners. Efficiency is strongly recommended as there is a high risk they will call for reinforcements once they discover they’re being evicted. 

*Shubin Interstellar is an equal opportunity contractor. By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

title: Out of Detatrine – Large Resupply
description:
Kicking the crap out of those Frontier Fighter bastards seriously depleted our supplies and now our stash of detatrine is practically out of stock. 

That’s why you’re going to put together a full fleet to do a detatrine resupply run to<EM4> ‹Destination›. </EM4>

Not sure if you’re familiar with it, but the chemical’s what we use to make our batches of sludge. We can’t really afford to let our sales of the stuff dry up right now. Not when we need credits so bad.

The good news is that <EM4>depots</EM4> across the system are offering detatrine and rock-bottom prices. Hell if I know why they’re doing it, all I know is that everyone with a lick of sense is trying to get their hands on the stuff so be ready for fierce competition. 

I’m trustin’ you to get it done,
Stows

You’re gonna go down to ‹Location› and destroy all the drugs on site. 

Of course, if someone does wanna pick a fight with you, feel free to defend yourself, but getting rid of the product is the most important thing.

title: Outlaw attack at ‹Location›
description:
Several CFP clusters near ‹Location› just got hit by a group of outlaws led by ‹Target Name›. We're looking for any available combat specialists to help retake the outposts.

I can provide the locations upon acceptance but we need to clear out the main outpost and satellite installations from all hostile forces and take out ‹Target Name› as it's unlikely that they will not cease their hostilities if they escape.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

title: Outsmarting our Enemies
description:
We've heard news that a new gang are planning an attack on a place over at <EM4>‹Location›</EM4>. They figure if they can take out the fuel supplies there then it's theirs for the taking.

But little do they know that we're gonna send you in first to blow the fuel tanks so we can claim the place before they do. If it all goes to plan, we can clear the location out and stick it to that gang at the same time. Two birds, one stone.

Only problem is this place is armed to the teeth. Bring a crew and get those fuel tanks out of action. We'll take care of the rest.

-Stows out

title: Overaggressive Kopions Need Removing
description:
Citizens for Prosperity recently reported to us that one of their scouts was injured by kopions during a routine exploration mission. According to them, this isn't the first time this particular pack has posed a problem, so they've requested our services to clear out the area. The report shows they were last seen at <EM4>‹Location›</EM4>.

This behavior is typical of kopions looking to expand their territory, so it is highly likely that you will be dealing with more kopions than initially observed. Caution is advised. 

Best,

Wanda Werkheiser
Contract Manager
Highpoint Wilderness Specialists

title: Overdrive Initative: Attack on XenoThreat

requires.title: Overdrive Initative: Xenothreat Ambush - Support Needed

description:
Attention, Naval forces have regrouped for the final assault that XenoThreat have been planning. The Navy has officially requested any CDF volunteers to help provide combat support in this final push to secure our system. This will include volunteers outside of those who have participated in the Overdrive Initiative.

SAIC Rowena Dulli from the Advocacy is the official attaché to the CDF and will be running the operation.

If successful, this will complete this Overdrive Initiative series and you will receive temporary access to the F7A Hornets or a free upgrade if you currently own an F7C.

title: Overdrive Initative: Xenothreat Ambush - Support Needed
description:
Attention CDF volunteers, XenoThreat finally launched their attack against Jericho Station at the Pyro Gateway in Stanton.

The Navy has requested CDF forces to help combat XenoThreat forces in the area and/or recover supplies from the wreckage and safely deliver them to Jericho station. 

The Navy has organized a community stipend to handle the distribution of payment. This will be distributed among all CDF volunteers at assigned intervals. An indicator will appear on your HUD to measure these payouts.

Please note that the supplies are highly volatile if not handled correctly. Use caution while transporting these materials:
* Zeta-Prolanide degrades over time until breaking down completely.
* AcryliPlex Composite becomes explosively unstable if damaged.
* Diluthermex releases a destructive energy pulse if exposed to quantum travel.

SAIC Rowena Dulli from the Advocacy is the official attaché to the CDF and will be running the operation.

title: Overdrive Initiative: EMERGENCY AT KAREAH
description:
Attention all CDF volunteers, we received a distress call from Security Post Kareah. It turns out XenoThreat used the comm arrays as a distraction to lure law enforcement away so they could launch an attack on the station.

We've learned that they're attempting to access their systems, so all volunteers must immediately divert to retake Kareah and clear out all XenoThreat forces.

As a reminder, the military has generously donated some old F7A Hornets for CDF members who see this initiative through to the end.

title: Overdrive Initiative: INTEL RAID
description:
We've received tips that XenoThreat's intending to launch another attack on Stanton system. The CDF has petitioned the Advocacy to create a new initiative called Operation Overdrive to stop this attack before it happens. 

The CDF is dispatching volunteers to infiltrate and obtain any intel that could give insight into what they're planning. Needless to say, expect heavy resistance from any XenoThreat on site.

As an added incentive, the military has generously donated some old F7A Hornets for CDF members who see this initiative through to the end.

title: Overdrive Initiative: PRIORITY TARGETS
description:
Our analysts have examined the intel seized from those XenoThreat recon teams but the data appears to be locked behind a sophisticated encryption system and requires a custom cryptokey to access.

We've managed to locate several XenoThreat lieutenants operating in the system, you are to find and engage the suspects and see if they are in possession of a cryptokey that will allows us to access the intel.

As a reminder, the military has generously donated some old F7A Hornets for CDF members who see this initiative through to the end.

title: Overdrive Initiative: Reward
description:
Thank you for your diligence on this Overdrive Initiative. 

As promised, we've approved you for an upgrade from a civilian F7C mk ii to a military grade F7A mk ii if you have one.

In addition, you've been given a temporary rental of a military F7A mk ii that you can access in your ASOP.

_________________

To upgrade, visit the RSI website to apply the token, then restart the game and access the ship.

title: Overdrive Initiative: SUPPLY REQUEST
description:
Attention CDF volunteers, XenoThreat's gone off the grid. We suspect that they have gone dark in order to prep for the final phase of their plan. 

History has proven that XenoThreat like to fight so it stands to reason that this might be an attack of some kind so we're calling on volunteers to deliver supplies to the Gateway station near the Stanton-Pyro jump point to shore up for a potential assault.

As a reminder, the military has generously donated some old F7A Hornets for CDF members who see this initiative through to the end.

title: Overdrive Initiative: XENOTHREAT INCURSION
description: <= UNINITIALIZED =>

title: Overdrive Initiative: XENOTHREAT INCURSION
description:
Waves of XenoThreat ships have been pushing into Stanton system and attacking random civilians. We can't tell if this is an isolated attack or a reaction to our recent initiatives, but we need them stopped.

As a reminder, the military has generously donated some old F7A Hornets for CDF members who see this initiative through to the end.

title: Overdrive Initiative: XENOTHREAT SURVEILLANCE
description:
One of the suspects captured during the recent attacks revealed that XenoThreat is looking to remotely access a number of comm arrays around the system.

Having XenoThreat listening into comms is extremely dangerous for the people living here, so the CDF has been enlisted to reset the comm array, then defend it from any XenoThreat Vanguards that will attempt to reconnect to the servers. 

Once those Vanguards have been defeated, clear out any remaining hostile ships in the area.

As a reminder, the military has generously donated some old F7A Hornets for CDF members who see this initiative through to the end.

title: Overpopulated Kopions Need Exterminating
description:
Highpoint Wilderness needs someone to exterminate an overpopulated pack of kopions that's threatening one of CFP's settlements. This pack can be found at <EM4>‹Location›</EM4>. Remember to exhibit caution when approaching them and arm yourself accordingly.

Best,

Wanda Werkheiser
Contract Manager
Highpoint Wilderness Specialists

title: Ownership Reassignment
description:
All right,

Over at ‹Location› there a few certain things they have in their possession that need to be liberated. Sure there may be a few guards or concerned individuals you’ll have to deal with, but for the most part it’s a relatively straight forward transaction – grab the stuff from the ‹Location› and take it to us at ‹Destination›. 

Sometimes simple is best.

-Bit Zeros

title: Pack of Kopions Threatening CFP
description:
Highpoint Wilderness is seeking a contractor to cull a pack of kopions that are threatening to overrun one of Citizens for Prosperity's outposts. After an initial assessment, it has been decided that relocation is impossible and a culling of them is the only viable option. If you're interested, head to <EM4>‹Location›</EM4>  and once we've received confirmation that the task is complete we will send payment.

Best,

Wanda Werkheiser
Contract Manager
Highpoint Wilderness Specialists

title: Package Delivery for Ling
description:
Hey,

We need you to grab a delivery for us over at <EM4>‹Location›</EM4> and then take it to <EM4>‹Destination›</EM4>.

I was originally going to send my brother Ricki to handle this, but he said the area’s too dangerous. Guess there’s been a bunch of security warnings around there, but as long as you’re careful and bring some guns or whatever, I’m sure you’ll be fine. You probably won’t even run into anything. 

Thanks, 
Conni Ling
Shipment Coordinator
Ling Family Hauling

title: Patrol Dangerous Outlaw Sector
enemyShips: Anvil F7C-R Hornet Tracker Mk I
Anvil F7C-S Hornet Ghost Mk I
description:
We’ve identified a sector that’s been increasingly riddled with outlaw attacks and we think that if we begin to actively patrol the area we can turn things around. We’d recommend gathering at least <EM4>two wingmen</EM4> to head out there in combat-ready ships and confront any hostile forces you might encounter.

Once you’ve accepted this contract, make your way to the <EM4>location marker</EM4> on your HUD and scan the waypoints along the route. After all of them have been secured, the main contractor will get a bonus of <EM4>‹Scrip Amount› MG Scrip.</EM4>

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

title: Patrol Dangerous Sector
enemyShips: Anvil F7C-R Hornet Tracker Mk I
Anvil F7C-S Hornet Ghost Mk I
description:
MISSION SPECS

Area of Operation: Nyx System
Hostile Forces: Outlaws
Equipment Specs: Combat-rated Ships
Briefing: InterSec has received intelligence that outlaws are planning to launch an attack on a target within the UEE. In an effort to prevent this from happening, we need a contractor to patrol a sector we believe these outlaws are using to prepare for their attack.

Outlaw activity in this sector is higher than normal, so InterSec recommends that you <EM4>bring backup</EM4>. When ready, dispatch to the <EM4>location marker</EM4> on your HUD and scan the waypoints along the route. Once you've confirmed that the entire sector is clear, the main contractor will receive a bonus of <EM4>‹Scrip Amount› MG Scrip.</EM4> 

Respectfully,

Deacon Tobin
Operations Manager
InterSec Defense Solutions

This communication consists of a non-binding offer that upon acceptance may be immediately terminated by either party without any given notice. All operations are conducted at the contractor’s own personal risk and must adhere to system law where applicable.

title: Patrol Dangerous Travel Lanes
enemyShips: Anvil F7C-R Hornet Tracker Mk I
Anvil F7C-S Hornet Ghost Mk I
description:
Outlaws have been increasing their activity along one of the more popular routes in the system and we’re hoping to provide a deterrent before the problem gets out of hand. As such, we’d like you to head out there in a combat-ready ship and deal with any hostiles you might encounter.

Once you’ve accepted this contract, make your way to the <EM4>location marker</EM4> on your HUD and scan the waypoints along the route. After all of them have been secured, the main contractor will get a bonus of <EM4>‹Scrip Amount› MG Scrip.</EM4>

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher

title: Patrol Extremely Dangerous Sector

Area of Operation: Nyx System
Hostile Forces: Outlaws
Equipment Specs: Combat-rated Ships
Briefing: InterSec has been tracking increased outlaw activity in certain sectors of the system. This activity in conjunction with other intelligence leads us to believe that outlaws are planning an attack on elements traveling from the UEE. We're aiming to patrol these sectors and disrupt any plans before they can be put into action.

Currently, we need someone who can help patrol a highly dangerous sector. Once you've accepted the mission, you can proceed to the <EM4>location marker</EM4> on your HUD. title: Payback
description:
XenoThreat recently hit a Headhunters' stronghold. I’ll spare you the details, but they did some truly heinous shit to our crew. We’ve identified the leader of the op as ‹Target Name› and are looking for a little payback. We don’t care what you do to get the job done. Only that ‹Target Name› is dead. 

A source just told us that you can track down this XenoThreat scum over at ‹Location›. This sicko’s a pro and never travels alone, so don’t expect taking them out to be a walk in the park.  

Stows out.

title: Peregrine Wikelo Mod

rewardItems.name: Aegis Sabre Peregrine Wikelo Speedy Special

description: Wikelo not want to race but can still make fast ship faster. If you want, bring me things, and go faster.

title: Permanently Delete
description:
The slimy little cretins over at Shipping Area have been selling us trash data all while trying to double deal. Can’t let it stand.

We want you to go teach them one final lesson and wipe out all the cowards you can find. Last I heard is they were holed up over near the Shipping Area. 

Spill their blood, and we’ll fill your wallet. 

-Bit Zeros

title: Personal Effects
description:
Hi,

I'll totally understand if you don't want to help with this, but if you can it would be amazing.

See, my boyfriend passed away during the Covalex Gundo tragedy. They said I would get all of Scott's stuff back once the investigation was complete, but as far as I know, it's been done for a while now and they still haven't given any indication of when I can get his property. It's been hard enough dealing with all this, and knowing that a package is going to show up in a month or two and rip open all these wounds, it's just too much. I would prefer to deal with it now and get it over with. If you could find a way to get his personal effects (Employee ID# 104) and drop them off at ‹Destination›, I'd be very grateful.

Thanks for your help,
Anya

title: Personal Transport
description: ‹Initiator Name› is requesting transportation from ‹Initiator Location› to ‹Selected Destination›. Upon the successful completion of this service, you will be paid ‹Payment Amount› aUEC.

title: Personnel and Data Captured by XenoThreat
description:
One of our most trusted datarunners, ‹Target Name›, has found themselves the victim of a XenoThreat assault. Now both they and the data they were ferrying have been captured and taken to ‹Location›. 

I am charging you with heading there to ascertain what happened to ‹Target Name› and to destroy data servers which may be housing the stolen information.

Even if the worst has happened, I think they would want us to make sure they data they were charged with protecting isn't used for nefarious gains.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

title: Pest Control
description:
A client has contacted us about resolving a <EM4>‹Creature›</EM4> infestation issue before it gets any worse. Several locations around <EM4>The cave can only be accessed on foot.</EM4> are currently beset by the creatures. There’s a growing concern that if this goes on for too much longer, then the natural habit will be ravaged beyond repair. Are you available to take care of this issue?

You can refer to <EM4>"The Guide to Stanton Wildlife"</EM4> in your Journal for more specific information on the targeted creature.

Best,

Wanda Werkheiser

title: Pick Up and Drop Off
description:
Need someone solid to head to <EM4>‹Location›</EM4> and finish a delivery for me. The last contractor got themselves perished and now my stash is sitting in the back of their ship.

The scavs that took out my pilot might be there too, so stay alert. Take my package to <EM4>[Destination|Target|Address]</EM4> and I’ll pay you for your time.

-Twitch

title: Pick Up, Put Down
description:
Someone of interest to us recently kicked the bucket (not our fault) over at <EM4>‹Location›</EM4> and we’re pretty curious what happened. We need you to grab the blackbox from the ship and drop it off at <EM4>[Destination|Target|Address]</EM4>.

This is a shipwreck by the way, so chances are some scavs will be around there too. But don’t worry, that’s been factored into your pay too.

-Bit Zeros

title: Precision Strike on ‹Target Name›
description:
Got a line on a bounty named <EM4>‹Target Name›</EM4>. Someone spotted them along with known criminal accomplices at <EM4>‹Location›</EM4>. Need you to get there before they get going. 

<EM4>‹Target Name›</EM4> has a reputation for only showing their face in places with civs. Really need you to take down this bounty without there being any civilian collateral damage. Foxwell can’t afford to be caught in the shitstorm that would erupt over the loss of innocent life. 

Eugene Walton
Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

title: Preemptive Strike
description:
Headhunters got word there’s a XenoThreat op in the works that's targeting one of our crews. We don’t have precise details about the plan but we know that ‹Target Name› is organizing it. Instead of sitting back and waiting for something to happen, we’ve decided to be proactive. 

‹Target Name› was just spotted with others around ‹Location›. We can’t mobilize anyone fast enough to get there. I want you to rush there and deliver a preemptive strike.   

Stows out.

title: Price of Business
description:
Not sure if you’d had the pleasure of dealing with the Rough & Ready, but the gang is laser focused on cornering the fuel market in Pyro. Smart play, but one we can’t let happen without them providing us some concessions. Since they’re currently not interested in negotiating, we’re forced to show them what happens to those who oppose us.

We’ve identified ‹Pickup 1› as a prime target for such an attack. We also know they recently received some supplies that should be a fitting price for their obstinance. Once inside the station, do whatever you need to do to confiscate the ‹item›. We’ll send payment once you’ve delivered them to ‹Dropoff 1›.      

Comm. Spec. Engler

They're a mean bastard, so bring some friends but make sure they end up dead.

description:
Hey,

Northrock recently received intel that a bounty who disappeared from Stanton is back. <EM4>‹Target Name›</EM4> has been spotted at <EM4>‹Location›</EM4>. Surveillance of the orbital platform indicates that <EM4>‹Target Name›</EM4> is directing the operation there. Getting to ‘em won’t be easy, but absolutely essential.   

We’re determined to not let them get away again. That’s why we’re giving anyone interested the opportunity to apprehend this target. Just be prepared to face fierce resistance. 

Best of luck,

Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

title: Pro Tem Escapee Bounty Contract
description:
Hey There,

My name is Braden Corchado and I'm a logistics officer for Northrock Service Group, the leading independently-owned security firm operating in the Stanton system. I may have reached out already, but we try to make it a point of approaching anyone who meets our high standards and encouraging them to complete a pro tem contract. 

You can't do much better than become a Northrock contractor. We have a solid reputation for offering challenging and interesting work at a higher rate of pay then many of our competitors in system. 

Now, to get approved, you will need to apprehend one ‹Target Name›. They have recently escaped from the detention center and your job will be to track them down before they can disappear completely off the grid. 

A little hint is that it's safe to assume that the target is going to go try to clear their record. I recommend triangulating your search between the detention center they escaped from and locations where they can hack into the record system.

Get this done and we'll see about getting you more work.

Hope to hear from you soon, 

Braden Corchado

title: Protect ‹Location› from XenoThreat Incursion
description:
Urgent!

XenoThreat is mobilizing for a massive incursion to wipe ‹Location› off the map. You’re their only hope of enduring this assault and protecting them from XenoThreat’s cruelty.

I know I’m asking you to put yourself in the line of fire, but this system won’t change unless people like you are brave enough to take on these dangers. No amount of credits could measure up to how much good you’d be doing by stepping in.

If you’re willing and able to take on this mission, make sure to take some allies with you. XenoThreat will certainly send in stronger reinforcements once they realize they’re taking losses.

title: QV Breaker Station Mining Rights (Exclusive)
description:
CONTRACT: Mining Rights Transfer
LOCATION: Nyx

DETAILS:
Shubin Interstellar prospectors have recently discovered the location of an abandoned QV Planetary Service Breaker Station near the Keeger belt. These stations were originally used by the defunct company to harvest valuable resources from inside asteroids but knowledge of their exact locations has been lost over the years. 

While this particular station is offline, our scout team believes that it could be made functional again with the necessary repairs. Additionally, if it was brought back online, there's already a resource-heavy asteroid in place ready to be cracked by the station's mining laser. 

Unfortunately, with all the various challenges that come with operating in Nyx, Shubin doesn't currently have the available bandwidth to handle the aforementioned repairs ourselves. This however has created an opportunity for an interested independent mining operation such as yourself. 

<EM4>TERMS*: </EM4>
We are making available the <EM4>exclusive mining rights</EM4> to this QV Breaker Station. Upon purchase, we will provide the coordinates of the station to only you and your crew. Your team will then be free to head there with a <EM4>mining vessel</EM4>, restore the <EM4>station's mining laser</EM4> to an operational status, crack the asteroid, and <EM4>harvest the resources</EM4> inside. 

Please note that while we guarantee that these coordinates will be exclusive to you, we cannot assure that other interested parties, such as outlaws, may not discover the station's location on their own. Caution is advised. 

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

• 2 years of combined mercenary and/or security experience.
• Access to combat equipment and mode of transport.
• Available for immediate deployment.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
• Experience with rapid hostility de-escalation techniques.

title: Remove Upstart Gang From Sector
enemyShips: Anvil F7C-M Super Hornet Mk I
description:
It feels that whenever we start to make real progress in the system, the outlaws are there to push one step back. We had recently cleared out ‹Location› only to learn that a new outlaw gang has taken root there, using it as a launching point for various criminal enterprises. 

Since we can't afford to let this rot spread, you and a few support ships are being charged with heading there to clear out all the gang's packs. After you deal with one pack, be sure to wait until all of the hostile packs have been dealt with.

Know that you are helping to make a real difference,
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

title: Repel Raiders
description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Defend Location
APPROVAL CODE = ‹Approval Code›

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

There’s a serious problem brewing for one of our clients at <EM4>‹Location›</EM4>. They’ve been warned that a highly skilled outlaw crew has their sights set on overrunning and occupying that location. We’ve been hired to make sure that doesn’t happen. 

Need a contractor to deploy to the location immediately. Based on the intel provided by the client, this won’t be a walk in the park. We strongly advise you to bring allies and plenty of supplies to help ward of the impending attack.   

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

title: Repossess Supplies
description:
As much as XenoThreat has strived to make Pyro a pure haven for Humans, not everyone is aligned with our goals. Chief among them is the Headhunters, who have debased themselves by hiring an alien hauler to deliver supplies to them. We missed the chance to hit that shipment, but still want to send the message that working with aliens in any capacity will not be tolerated in this system. 

That shipment was delivered to ‹Pickup 1›. We want someone to hit the outpost, claim the ‹item›, and take it to ‹Dropoff 1› so we can properly dispose of it. 

You up for keeping Pyro free from alien influence?

Comm. Spec. Engler

title: Reprisal Attack
description:
A squad of ships recently shanked one of our convoys, and ten credits says they’re gonna try and do it again. Looking for someone to launch a reprisal attack before that can happen.  

We’ve ID’d the idiots as consisting of several large craft and a sizable escort. We believe the leader is flying a <EM4>‹Ambush Target›</EM4> and set that ship as the primary target. Since it’s a sizable and aggressive squad, a surprise attack seems like a smart play. They often pass by <EM4>Asteroid Mining Base</EM4>, which has an emission cloud to hide in. Be smart and patient then strike when the time is right. 

Unless you fancy yourself a real ace, it’s probably best to bring some friends. Maybe you can entice folks by letting them know they can pick through the wreckage for valuables once the deed is done.

And on top of that, I'll give the main contractor a bonus <EM4>‹Scrip Amount› Council Scrip</EM4> to sweeten the pot.

Stows out.

title: Reputation Management
description:
Some assholes are refusing to pay us what we’re owed. Problem is, these idiots are bragging about it. Had they kept it quiet, we could’ve taken care of this more surgically, but now we need to send a message.

The fools are operating from ‹Location›. We need them all gone. Make it as loud as you can. We’ll send your payment once everyone’s taken care of.

- Stows out.

description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Clear Location
APPROVAL CODE = ‹Approval Code›

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

Got an emergency request from Associated Science & Development for any available operators to report to ‹Location› and deal with some hostiles who have overtaken one of their facilities. 

Once on site, you will need to engage and eliminate any hostile elements. ASD has indicated that this facility provides shuttle services to one of their embedded research centers but were very clear that you are not authorized to travel there. Trespassers will be shot and you will be no exception, so stick to the prescribed AO.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

title: Rescue Incomplete Ling Delivery

requires.title: Cargo Hauling Opportunity with Ling Hauling

description:
Hi,

Got a relatively straightforward one for you if you're interested.

One of our pilot ignored a maintenance warning and sure enough, a couple of hours later their ship broke down over at <EM4>‹Location›</EM4>. They're on their way back to the office now but we could do with a reliable hauler whose got a ship big enough to transport <EM4>32 SCU cargo containers</EM4> to complete the haul for us.

Think you could help us out? You just need to pick up the stranded shipment and deliver it to the freight elevator at <EM4>‹Destination›</EM4>.  And I probably don't have to say this, but a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> would probably be handy to have along.

Thanks,  
Reyes Ling 
Cargo Logistics Coordinator 
Ling Family Hauling 

Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.

title: Respond to Distress Beacon
enemyShips: Anvil F7C-M Super Hornet Mk I
Anvil F7C-R Hornet Tracker Mk I
Anvil F7C-S Hornet Ghost Mk I
description:
A Citizens for Prosperity convoy on a resupply run dropped a distress beacon near <EM4>‹Location›</EM4>. They’re not answering any comms, so I assume the situation is serious. That convoy has some skilled pilots, so if they’re not responding then they definitely need the help.

We’ll compensate you to support that convoy.  

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

title: Restore Order at ‹Defend Location Wrapper Location›
enemyShips: Anvil F7C-R Hornet Tracker Mk I
Anvil F7C-S Hornet Ghost Mk I
Anvil F7C-M Super Hornet Mk I

requires.title: Yellow Level Contract: Stand Up to Aggressors
Yellow Level Contract: Defend ‹Defend Location Wrapper Location›
Orange Level Contract: Ship Protection Needed
Orange Level Contract: Protect Our Client’s Interests
Help Headhunters at ‹Defend Location Wrapper Location›
Red Level Contract: Save Ships at ‹Defend Location Wrapper Location›
Stop Attack at ‹Defend Location Wrapper Location›

description:
Our crew at <EM4>‹Defend Location Wrapper Location›</EM4> needs help. Enemy ships are swarming the area and attacking anything and everything they can find. That’d be bad enough as is, but this site has some absolutely crucial gear and personnel that we can’t have destroyed or compromised. 

Considering the size and scale of the attack, you’re gonna need a fully supplied ship and some reliable wingmen. Gather your crew, fly out to the site, and I’ll send you specifics on where you’re needed most.

To prove just how serious we are about getting this done right, the main contractor will earn a bonus <EM4>‹Scrip Amount› Council Scrip</EM4> for making sure absolutely nothing goes wrong.

- Stow

title: Retake Platforms From Nine Tails
description:
Glad to have you undertaking this operation for Northrock. Here is the full brief:

Your priority is to <EM4>disable all three Identify Friend or Foe Inverters</EM4> that are blocking Crusader Security from accessing the airspace around these platforms. Once the inverters are offline, Crusader Security will be able to fly their ships in and resecure the platforms. In the meanwhile, the platforms are connected by a series of shuttles unaffected by the inverters and will serve as your main form of transport between them.

Be aware that you will meet heavy resistance as you progress. Crusader has tried multiple times to deal with this incursion themselves but have thus far been unsuccessful. However, we believe a small strike team will prove more effective in dealing with the Nine Tails forces. 

Additionally, in the spirit of full cooperation, Crusader has given you carte blanche to utilize any of the resources you discover that may prove helpful to the mission. 

Best of luck,
Adrienne Du-Buisson
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

title: Retaking Outposts from Headhunters
description:
Citizens for Prosperity is looking for any available security operatives to retake several former CFP installations near ‹Location› from Headhunter control. These clusters were violently taken from us by ‹Target Name› and resulted in the deaths of many volunteers.

Bringing these outposts back under our control will help provide more stability to the system. Reports indicate that ‹Target Name› tends to hide behind their rank and file, so they will likely appear once you've cleared out most of the hostiles.

XenoThreat are trained and motivated so they will not give up easily.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

title: Retrieval Op
description:
Here's the deal – a client of ours (who should have spent the extra credits for a Northrock escort) had one of their ships attacked and now they need us to run point on a retrieval op for an important package that was stolen.

Thankfully, we caught a break and were able to track down the people responsible to <EM4>‹Pickup 1›</EM4>. We need you to head there and recover the package. You'll be able to ID it by its serial number: <EM4>#‹Item 1›</EM4>.

I expect that the outlaws are going to put up a fight, but just remember that they aren't the priority.

Once you got the package, fly it back to the client at <EM4>‹Dropoff 1›</EM4>. 

One last thing, make sure you bring a ship that has enough room for some cargo. Don't want you getting all the way there in your Gladius or whatever only to have to turn back.

Do us proud,

Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

*RETRIEVAL OPERATION SUMMARY*
* Recover Package <EM4>#‹Item 1›</EM4> from <EM4>‹Pickup 1›</EM4>
* Deliver to <EM4>‹Dropoff 1›</EM4>

title: Retrieval Op
description:
You got a ship and <EM4>a heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4>? Good. I’ve got work for you.

Don’t know how they knew we were coming, but one of my haulers got jumped over at <EM4>‹Location›</EM4>. The pilot’s gone silent so I assume they’ve been ghosted, but the cargo tracker is stationary for now.

Expect the bastards who took out my pilot to still be around, so bring backup. Get the cargo and get out, don’t need to risk anymore good haulers on this mess.

Get the goods to the freight elevator to <EM4>‹Destination›</EM4> and I’ll send your payment.

-Twitch

title: Retrieve Additional Smuggler Intel
description:
MISSION SPECS

Area of Operation: Nyx System
Hostile Forces: Outlaws present and armed
Equipment Specs: Combat-rated Ship, Personal Arms
Briefing: InterSec needs your services once again.

The intel you previously gathered has been invaluable in identifying several prominent buyers of the illegally-obtained Vanduul parts. However, since then the Shattered Blade have continued their operations and the UEE is requesting that we <EM4>update our intel.</EM4>

We believe more information can be retrieved from the storage facilities located at the old <EM4>QV Logistics station.</EM4>

The operation parameters haven’t changed since your last mission: find the <EM4>encrypted data</EM4> and use the <EM4>decryption key</EM4> to decipher and upload the list to us. The Shattered Blade will have reinforced the area since the last time, so expect resistance.

Good luck. We’ll be in touch.

Respectfully,

Deacon Tobin
Operations Manager
InterSec Defense Solutions

This communication consists of confidential information solely intended for the recipient. Please disregard if received in error and notify sender. All operations are conducted at the contractor’s own personal risk and must adhere to UEE and system law where applicable.

title: Retrieve Supplies
description:
Hi,

It appears an electrical issue caused us to lose track of a ‹Ship› carrying medical supplies. Thankfully, I received word that the ship was found at ‹Location›. We really need someone to get out there and recover the supplies onboard before someone else does. Those provisions are desperately needed at Canard View. Any chance you could grab them and complete the delivery? 

Makes me nervous seeing that the ship is at a lagrange point. Lots of folks scour them for stuff like this. Would be smart to come prepared to defend yourself if someone else comes looking to steal it.

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you.    

Thanks,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

title: Return Goods
description:
Just got a frantic comm from a ‹Ship› that cut out quite dramatically. Seems like they were dumb enough to get lured into a trap, even though I made it damn clear that getting those goods to Last Landings was all they should worry about.   
 
Well, it looks like they failed. Trackers hidden in the cargo now show it at ‹Location›. Time to send in backup to reclaim our goods and teach a lesson to those who took it. You interested in delivering that message then delivering the goods?

- Stows

title: Revenge 01 (WIP)
description: Mission description (WIP)

title: Ripe for Retribution
description:
Some interesting information just fell into my lap. Guess the notorious XenoThreat leader ‹Target Name› is holed up at ‹location› working on some big op for them. Perfect opportunity to kill the piece of shit once and for all.

Thing is, the Xenos have their eyes all over Headhunter operations at the moment. There’s no way we can mobilize and deploy a crew without ‹Target Name› getting tipped off. So I’m offering you the chance to make Pyro a better place and earn some creds at the same time.

If interested, I suggest gearing up and finding some backup before heading out. You'll only get paid if you take out ‹Target Name›, but don’t hesitate to kill any other little XenoThugs that might be hiding there with ‘em.  

Stows out.

title: Ripe for the Taking
description:
Got some good news for you. As we speak, there’s an automated facility that is churning out package after package of primo product that’s pretty much ripe for the taking.

All you have to do is swoop down there, deal with a thug or two, grab whatever you can, and sell it for a huge profit. Shouldn’t be a problem at all. And there are plenty of people around who would pay good creds to take product like that off your hands.

Speaking of credits, I’m not gonna just give out the coordinates of this facility out of the kindness of my heart. I think it’s only fair to ask a finder’s fee for info this good.

I wouldn’t wait too long. Not sure how long the site will be left running.

-Ruto

title: Risky ‹Ship› Salvage Job
description:
We’ve got our eye on a ‹ship› near ‹location› that’s ripe for salvaging. We’re too busy to snag it ourselves, so why not spread the wealth, right?

If you send us some credits, we’ll send you the ship’s exact coordinates. Don’t take too long to think it over, though. You’ve probably got about ‹timer› minutes until security gets there to check out the wreck. Could be more, could be less.

You could either tow it somewhere else first, or you could try to scrap what you can onsite before security shows. Don’t care which as long as you get it taken care of. And once you've salvaged everything you want, just go ahead and abandon this contract to clear your map. Helps keep everything nice and tidy.

title: Rookie Hauler Needed for Direct Bulk Shipment
enemyShips: Anvil F7C-R Hornet Tracker Mk I
description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

Have a run here that could become a lucrative regular thing if we can pull it off.  This’ll take you into Pyro, so you’ll have to be ready to tangle with some of the locals. 

You’ll need to grab the stuff from <EM4>Baijini Point</EM4>, make the jump to Pyro, and then get to <EM4>Ruin Station above Pyro VI</EM4>. 

All you need to do is bring a ship with space for <EM4>24 SCU cargo containers</EM4>, a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4>, and be ready to do some damage if someone picks a fight with you.

title: Rookie Hauler Needed for Direct Small Shipment
description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------  

Need a pilot for a straightforward haul going from the freight elevator at <EM4>Bueno Ravine</EM4> to <EM4>‹Destination›</EM4>. Should be easy enough as long as you got a ship that can handle containers up to <EM4>4 SCU</EM4> in size. 

Credits don't come much easier than this. Just be careful as the route's not exactly in the safest of sectors. And don't forget to pack a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to bring along.

title: Rookie Hauler Needed for Large Shipment
enemyShips: Anvil F7C-R Hornet Tracker Mk I
description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

CFP has an urgent request for a pilot with combat experience. A few of their settlements are under immediate threat and may soon be under attack, so they need supplies ASAP. 

If you're confident that you can navigate a potential combat zone, please head to <EM4>‹Location›</EM4>, grab the cargo, and bring it to these locations:

DROP OFF LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)

- Freight elevator at <EM4>‹Destination›</EM4>
- Freight elevator at <EM4>‹Destination 1›</EM4>

You'll need enough room for <EM4>16 SCU cargo containers</EM4>, and your own <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to get everything loaded and unloaded.

Keep in mind that it's always best to run if someone tries to ambush you. But if you get cornered, don't hesitate to defend yourself.

title: Rookie Hauler Needed for Medium Shipment
description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

title: Running the Gauntlet
description:
The CDF has partnered with Anvil Aerospace to find the most capable operatives in the system. 

If you find one of these Platinum certifications, you can redeem the ticket at a ship kiosk at New Deal, Astro Armada or Crusader Showroom for a free F8C.

Good luck.

title: Seize the Data
description:
Been hunting down a particular parcel of data and right when I get a break the ship gets attacked by this converted Nine Tails Reclaimer called the Black Kite. I tried to hack into the servers on the Black Kite to see if they copied the data, but couldn't find a way to remotely get past their encryption protocols without the physical key.

That's where you come in. I need someone to breach their ship, get a hold of their decryption key, and decrypt the server so I can remotely pull down what I need.

You're smart enough to know who we're dealing with here, so plan accordingly. Since it's gonna ruffle some powerful feathers, let's not leave anything to chance. Destroy the Black Kite when you're done to cover both our asses.

description:
We had this kid named ‹Target Name› volunteer to go take out some XenoThreat near Remote Outpost near ‹Nearby Location›. Everything we knew about the place said it was gonna be too much for ‹Target Name› to handle, but they were real keen on boosting their standing with the Headhunters and thought this would do it, so they went alone.

Haven't heard anything but XenoThreat comms coming out of that place since. If you want to go and knock it over, we'll pay you instead. If you can find out what happened to ‹Target Name› that would be a bonus.

Stows out.

description:
This is a fairly straightforward job. We got some assholes at ‹Location› who have been thinking they're better than they are. Go and shut off their power to remind them that Headhunters are in charge.

-Stows out

title: Shutdown CFP’s Comms
description:
CFP think they’re safe over at <EM4>‹Location›</EM4> but we got big plans for them. You’re gonna pave the way for us by heading there and shutting down their comm towers.

There should be a <EM4>control terminal at the top</EM4> that you can use to shut the tower down. You get that sorted and they won’t be able to call for backup. Then we can show those skags who this system belongs to.

Most outposts use the same system, so this’ll come in handy next time you want to make sure reinforcements don’t mess with you.

Stows out.

title: Shutdown Xenothreat Comm Towers
description:
Citizens for Prosperity are eager to help the people of Pyro, and it starts with freeing them from the grasp of XenoThreat.

We’re preparing a team to infiltrate one of their outposts, but we need someone to go in ahead to take out their communication towers first. Once those towers are offline, they won’t be able to call for reinforcements and we can proceed with our plan.

Head to <EM4>Last Ditch</EM4> and find the towers. At the <EM4>top is a control panel</EM4> that can be used to disable them.

Also, it’s worth noting that most outposts use a similar system, so you’ll know how to disable the comms towers rather than risk fighting reinforcement dropships when you’re doing other jobs.

Good luck,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

title: Silence the Xenothreat
description:
We’re making a play to hit some XenoThreat assholes where it hurts but need to be smart about it. That’s why we’re sending you in first to take out their comm towers so they can’t call for backup. You do that and we can be in and out before they know it.

Head to <EM4>Last Ditch</EM4> and climb the comm towers there. Should be a <EM4>control panel at the top</EM4> you can use to switch them off.

In fact, same goes for most other outposts. Rather than having to deal with reinforcements, you can just turn off the comm towers. But hey, if you wanna ring the bell to ghost a few more Xenothreat I ain’t complaining.

Stows out.

They might roll through solo or with some friends. All would be single-seaters but they can hold their own in a dogfight. We’ll drop some forces in the region who can provide support once the fun starts.

One of our prospecting teams recently confirmed that the asteroids which house QV Breaker Stations throughout Nyx's Keeger Belt contain a rare ore type, Sadaryx.

However, owing to the difficulty in access these stations and the inherent risks involved, we are seeking external mining crews to handle the extraction.

We do not have a confirmed location of where the Sadaryx deposits are located within the station, but would recommend starting with the cave sections where minerals naturally form. If you get really lucky, you may even find some crystals in storage that were mined by the old QV work crews.

title: Special Recovery Operation
description:
I wouldn't normally ask someone to do something so risky, but these are exceptional circumstances.

Our pilot was transporting some vital cargo when they were targeted by a group of outlaws. Under no circumstances can we allow them to get their hands on the cargo.

With the size of the hostile force who attacked, you won't be able to do this on your own, you'll need to bring a skilled crew with you to  <EM4>‹Location›</EM4> in order to  take out these outlaws and get the cargo back. Make sure at least one of you has a ship that can store <EM4>32 SCU cargo containers</EM4> and a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4>.

If by some miracle you can get that cargo back, take it to the freight elevator located at <EM4>‹Destination›</EM4>.

It's a lot to ask, but if you can pull this off you'll have my and the whole organizations appreciation.

Best of luck,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

title: Spirit Cargo mod
description: Wikelo love useful cargo ship. Spirit is very useful. If you want one, can make for you. Just bring me things and I will do. Bye.

title: Squash Spying Op
description:
Recently made an interesting discovery that someone set up a handful of orbital sentries at ‹location›. Guess they’re trying to grab some info about our operations there. They even have a few ships guarding to make sure nothing happens to them. 

Of course, we want these bastards gone, but I’m worried that getting rid of it ourselves would be bad for business. That’s why we’re looking for a little ‘plausible deniability’. Someone from outside of R&R to eliminate the problem, so whoever is behind it can’t directly tie the attack back to us. I know this won’t be a walk in the park, especially with those guards lurking. Who knows how many reinforcements they have at the ready? But if you manage to get it done, we’re prepared to see you paid right. 

Think you’ve got the skills to pull this off? 

- Smokey

title: Stand Our Ground
enemyShips: Anvil F7C-R Hornet Tracker Mk I
Anvil F7C-S Hornet Ghost Mk I
description:
We’re getting pushback from folks who don’t seem happy that we’re here. Folks have gotten keen to our haunts and started sending out squads to hit our ships. You down to visit a few of those spots to show that we won’t be scared off? 

If so, start by seeing what’s around the <EM4>location marker</EM4> on your HUD. From there I’ll guide you to a few other hotspots that we need checked. Better get your shit in order before heading out. I'd recommend loading up on ammo and convincing <EM4>two friends</EM4> to join the patrol.

You do this for the Headhunters and I'll see to it that the main contractor gets a bonus of <EM4>‹Scrip Amount› Council Scrip</EM4>. 

Stows out.

But thankfully our trackers are reporting the shipment's static for the moment, waiting to be picked up. If we play our cards right, there's still time to resolve this.

The abandoned ship is located at <EM4>‹Location›</EM4> and will need a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> to transport the goods. A ship that can handle <EM4>32 SCU cargo containers</EM4> is a necessity, and expect contact from whatever outlaws this double-crossing pilot was hoping to sell to.

title: Steal Subsidies
description:
Leave it to the lying UEE to say they’re not involved with the operations of Citizens for Prosperity simply because they “donate” supplies to a tertiary aid organization who then immediately delivers it right to them. 

We just got word that one of these government aid shipments was dropped off at a Citizens for Prosperity aligned outpost. That’s why we’ll pay you to raid ‹Pickup 1› and claim the ‹item› for the cause. Once you deliver everything to ‹Dropoff 1› we can redistribute the shipment to help in our fight. Nothing better than using the enemies resources against them. 

But don’t think they’ll just hand the stuff over to you. Even though Citizens for Prosperity are supposedly here to bring peace, you best be prepared to go toe to toe with ‘em. 

Comm. Spec. Engler

title: Still Looking for Work?

requires.title: Exciting New Opportunities with Foxwell Enforcement

description:
Due to a corporate restructuring, Foxwell has some new vacancies that need to be filled immediately. Foxwell knows you’ve previously expressed interest in this line of work, and we’re wondering if you would want to take another crack at a contract.

One of our clients needs support at <EM4>‹Location›</EM4> where their security forces are struggling to handle an outlaw incursion. Head there and help the local forces get rid of the problem before it’s too late. 

Successfully complete this contract, and Foxwell would be happy to send more work your way.

Eugene Walton
Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

title: Stock Taking
description:
I won’t bore you with the details, all you need to know is: one of our haulers got attacked and now our goods are sitting in a freight elevator at <EM4>‹Location›</EM4>. 

Up to you how you get the goods out, but if you happen to ghost a few of our rivals in the process, I ain’t complaining. Once you’ve got the stuff take it to the freight elevator at <EM4>Grim HEX</EM4>, then we can sort your payment. 

A <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> would also be smart to bring along. 

Stows out.

title: Stolen Supplies
description:
Hey,

We could use your help.

A local we work with was completing a delivery for us, but unfortunately, she ran into some outlaws and had to surrender her ‹Item›. Silver lining is the outlaws didn’t notice the trackers we placed in the cargo and now we know they’ve taken their haul to ‹Location›. 

We’d like you to recover the packages for us and finish delivering them to ‹Destination›. I don’t imagine the outlaws will give them up willingly, but I wouldn’t ask you to put yourself in harm’s way if these supplies weren’t of critical importance.

Also, to make your life easier, I'd suggest you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

So, what do you say?

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Briefing:

InterSec Defense Solutions

title: Strategic Detatrine Reserve – Large Resupply
description:
Following the brutal attack on Pyro and our efforts to combat the vigilante group the Frontier Fighters, our strategic reserves across the system are at an all-time low. Citizens for Prosperity are eager to replenish our stocks before we reach a point of desperation. 

To that end, we were hoping that you would recruit a full fleet to resupply<EM4> ‹Destination› with detatrine. </EM4>

This rare chemical compound is a key ingredient in several vital medical supplies, so it is important that replace what we used up treating local civilians and CFP members injured in the wake of the Frontier Fighter assault.

Normally we would direct you to reputable sources to acquire detatrine, but our contacts have informed us that several <EM4>depots</EM4> around the system have suddenly decided to sell the chemical at a significantly reduced price. In fact, it’s inexpensive enough that I suspect it will draw some unwanted attention. If you decide to seek out this potentially deadly deal, please do so with caution.

Your support of our efforts is much appreciated,

Lima Endicott

In fact, it’s inexpensive enough that I suspect it will draw some unwanted attention. If you decide to seek out this potentially deadly deal, please do so with caution.

Your support of our efforts is much appreciated,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

title: Strategic Resource Reserve – Large Resupply
description:
Following the brutal attack on Pyro and our efforts to combat the vigilante group the Frontier Fighters, our strategic reserves across the system are at an all-time low. Citizens for Prosperity are eager to replenish our stocks before we reach a point of desperation. 

To that end, we were hoping that you would recruit a full fleet to deliver the supplies to <EM4> Pyro Gateway. </EM4> We have arranged shipment to Pyro from there.

I leave it up to you to decide how best to procure and refine the resources, but Daymar or Aberdeen might be good places to start mining.

Your support of our efforts is much appreciated,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
