title: Stuck Ling Shipment Pending Delivery

requires.title: Cargo Hauling Opportunity with Ling Hauling

description:
Hey,

Just our luck that we land one of the biggest contracts of our life and our hauler's engines seize up. They've tried their best to fix it but seems like it's just not happening.

Can you fly out to <EM4>‹Location›</EM4> and grab the cargo for us? It's really important that we show our client that we're just as reliable as the other big players out there.

Just so you know this is a large shipment. You'll need a ship that can handle <EM4>32 SCU cargo containers</EM4> and a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> to move it all. Once you've transferred it to your ship, deliver it to the freight elevator at <EM4>‹Destination›</EM4> and we'll send confirmation to the client.

Considering the circumstances, we're paying above market rates to whoever can complete this.

Thanks,  
Reyes Ling 
Cargo Logistics Coordinator 
Ling Family Hauling 

Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.

title: Suit Up Take Off
description: Ships have big windows. Everyone can see you flying. You should look the best. Wikelo has very good flight suit for you. Do trade, bring me what I need and Wikelo give suit. Give blueprint as well if you do not have.

title: Supply Line Sabotage
description:
The armchair “activists” of Citizens for Prosperity continue to try to spread their influence throughout the system. With your assistance, there is an opportunity to sever their operations at the roots.

The group is using ‹location› to distribute supplies to independents scattered around the planet. If we destroy the ‹ship› located there, their network will fall.

Bombardment would send a clear message, but I’ll leave it to you to decide the means of destruction.

Comm. Spec. Engler

title: Supply Order: Sadaryx Focus Lenses

requires.title: Small Purchase Order: Hand Mined Materials

description:
CONTRACT: Manufacturing Order
LOCATION: Nyx

DETAILS:
If you happen to have any other work bringing you to one of the QV Breaker Stations in the Keeger Belt, Shubin Interstellar would be highly interested in contracting you to obtaining a supply of hard-to-source mining laser focus lenses.

<EM4>TERMS*:</EM4>
While there may be some focus lenses that can be recovered from the QV Breaker Station's storage, you must likely will need to manufacture them using <EM4>Sadaryx crystals</EM4> and the on-site lens fabricator. While the ore is rare, these Breaker Stations typically have sadaryx veins that can be mined directly with a <EM4>Multi-Tool with a Mining Attachment</EM4>.

Deliver the procured lenses to the freight elevator located at <EM4>‹Destination›</EM4> for processing.

Contractors have reported that these stations may have been infiltrated by outlaws, so caution is advised.

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

title: Supply Re-Up - ‹Reward›
description: ‹Contractor›

title: Support Client Under Attack
description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Defend Ship
APPROVAL CODE = ‹Approval Code›

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

One of our clients got the brilliant idea to test their dogfighting skills in a real world scenario. Doesn’t sound like it’s going well, because they comm’d us asking for some support. 

Head to <EM4>‹Location›</EM4> and help clean up the mess they created.

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

title: Support Security Forces and Secure Confidential Materials
description:
Reports indicate that our security staff at ‹location› have been wiped out by a group of Nine Tails, who are attempting to steal confidential materials that were recently delivered to the facility. Crusader Security needs an experienced contractor to expel the hostiles and secure these boxes. 

Based on the initial reports, we strongly recommend that you come well-equipped and consider bringing back-up. For security purposes, the confidential materials were transported there as part of a consignment with other boxes and locked in an automated vault. The retrieval codes to access the confidential materials are stored on datapads held by high-ranking security staff, but we don’t know who has them now. Odds are that the Nine Tails will be looking for them too.  

When you have all the confidential materials, deliver them to ‹dropoff 1› to receive payment. 

CONTRACT AUTHORIZED BY: 
Liaison Officer Bautista 
ID# 948J030K

title: Surprise Party
description:
Some numskull flying a <EM4>‹Ambush Target›</EM4> was caught spying on our ops. We ran ‘em off with a warning only to spot ‘em doing the same shit someplace else. Since they didn’t get the message, seems we gotta send a stronger one.    

There’s an emission cloud near <EM4>Asteroid Mining Base</EM4> that they fly by frequently. Primo place to power down, hide, and launch a surprise attack. Sometimes they fly solo, sometimes there’s other single-seaters with them. It’ll be all you for that first hit, but we’ll put some support ships nearby to help finish the job. 

And if you needed some extra motivation, there's a bonus of <EM4>‹Scrip Amount› Council Scrip</EM4> for the main contractor at the end of the job. 

Stows out.

title: Surveillance Termination
description:
It seems our struggle to free Humanity has got the government lapdogs back on Earth feeling nervous. Recent scans discovered an orbital sentry at ‹location› that we believe is part of an UEE espionage campaign. Good credits says they’re handing the data direct to the slinks themselves. 

Only one sentry has been detected so far, but who knows how big the operation will grow if it’s not taken off-line. Shouldn’t be too much trouble for a skilled merc. If that sounds like you, payment will be sent promptly once the sentry is destroyed. Plus, XenoThreat will remember that you’re someone willing to fight for what’s right.

Comm. Spec. Engler

title: Suspect Apprehension Certification
description:
Hi,

Hope you don't mind, but I was made aware of your Bounty Hunters Guild status and wanted to reach out and see if you'd be interested in contracting with Northrock Service Group, one of the top rated private security firms in the system.

If you are, the first step would be to complete a pro tem suspect apprehension. It's less of an evaluation and more of a chance to make sure that we can have a good working relationship. 

The suspect you would be after is known as <EM4>‹Target Name›</EM4>. They are known to be particularly elusive so you may have your work cut out for you.

Hope to hear from you soon, 

Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

title: Suspect Apprehension Certification
description:
--------------------------------------------------------
----------------- BOUNTY CONTRACT -----------------
--------------------------------------------------------

BOUNTY HUNTERS GUILD
PROCESSING & DISTRIBUTION

The Bounty Hunters Guild has authorized an official bounty.

NAME: ‹Target Name› 
SYSTEM: Unknown
RISK ASSESSMENT: High
LAST KNOWN LOCATION: Unknown
KNOWN AFFILIATIONS: <None>
NOTES: Upon the recommendation of one our members, the Bounty Hunters Guild would like to offer you the chance to earn your Suspect Apprehension Certification.

This would signify that you are qualified to track and apprehend wanted suspects who have proven to be more elusive than typical bounties. They often have advanced piloting skills, difficult to predict behavior, and more resources than your average target, making them a real challenge.

To successfully complete this certification process, you must apprehend wanted suspect <EM4>‹Target Name›</EM4>.

BOUNTY HUNTERS GUILD
In Pursuit of Justice

The Bounty Hunters Guild is a security service sanctioned by the Mercenary Guild and authorized to operate in both the UEE and beyond in accordance with Xenotrade Authority Acts.

title: Sweep and Clear Location
enemyNpcs: Squad C - Soldier or Tech x 2
Squad E - Soldier or Tech x 2
Squad F - Soldier or Tech x 1
description:
Looking for someone willing to take out the trash at <EM4>‹Location›</EM4>. Guess a gang has settled in without the permission of the owners. So they’ve hired us to get them out whatever way we see fit. 

I’d bring plenty of ammo, if I were you. Doubt they’ll want to leave willingly. 

Eugene Walton
Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

title: Sweep and clear some CFP haunts
description:
Got word from my Judge that we're to take back some of the outposts that CFP have taken over. They're a little pissed that CFP's getting as much of a foothold in the system as they are and think it's making the Headhunters look weak.

Found a couple candidates near ‹Location› that could use a sweep. Icing on the cake is that the head of security there is ‹Target Name›. Not sure if you've heard of 'em, but they shot up a handful of Clips last month, so it's a win-win. Get some territory back and punch out someone who could really stand to get got.

Stows out.

title: Tactical Strike
enemyShips: Anvil F7C-M Super Hornet Mk I
Anvil F7C-R Hornet Tracker Mk I
Anvil F7C-S Hornet Ghost Mk I
description:
Some folks don’t seem happy with us. Got word that several sub-capital ships and a number of escorts are targeting our ops. Figured the best way to keep ‘em from causing us trouble is to hit them before they hit us. 

We got eyes on a <EM4>‹Ambush Target›</EM4> that’s part of this squad, and it looks like they regularly pass by <EM4>‹Location›</EM4>, a spot tailor made for a surprise attack. A nearby emission cloud can hide you and anyone you bring along for muscle.

No sugarcoating it. This ain’t gonna be easy. But the payoff should make it worth your while. Finish the job and the main contractor gets a bonus <EM4>‹Scrip Amount› Council Scrip</EM4>. 

Plus, who knows what kinda good stuff you’ll find floating in all that wreckage.

Stows out.

title: Tactical Strike Group Needed
description:
MISSION SPECS

Area of Operation: Nyx System 
Hostile Forces: Shattered Blade
Equipment Specs: Strike Group
Briefing: 
We've received word that a People's Alliance security ship called Tranquility stumbled across  Shattered Blade hiding out in an old QV Extraction station. Details are sketchy but will connect you with local assets once on site. 

Intersec is looking for a team to intervene and protect the Tranquility and their personnel. Based on discussions with the Tranquility's captain, you will <EM4>need  ballistic and ordnance to break down the defenses of the station</EM4> and ultimately <EM4>get boots on the ground to save their pilot</EM4>.

<EM4>Recruiting additional ships</EM4> to support you in this mission is absolutely critical. You will <EM4>need a variety of ship types</EM4> to balance multiple combat zones in space and on the ground.

Respectfully,   

Deacon Tobin 
Operations Manager 
InterSec Defense Solutions  

This communication consists of confidential information solely intended for the recipient. Please disregard if received in error and notify the sender. All operations are conducted at the contractor’s own personal risk and must adhere to UEE and system law where applicable.

title: Take Out Citizens for Prosperity Fuel Supply
description:
It seems like I can't go a day without waking up to one of my people bitchin' and moanin' about how hard Citizens for Prosperity is making their life. 

Eventually we're going wipe those do-gooders out of the system, but for now I'll settle for some peace and quiet. 

Go to Remote Outpost near ‹Nearby Location› and destroy the fuel stores CFP have got there. That should at least keep them out of our business for a bit.

-Stows out

title: Take Outlaws at Rustville Offline
description:
We have gotten word that the outlaws at Rustville have begun recruiting with the hopes of launching a raid against Citizens for Prosperity. 

In order to deescalate the situation before it gets out of hand, we would like you to disable their power generators and halt their expansion. 

Pull this off and it could save a lot of lives.
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

title: Take What's Theirs - ‹Reward›
description: ‹Contractor›

title: Taking back from the Headhunters
description:
We are currently looking for any qualified and available security operatives to head out to Remote Outpost near ‹Nearby Location› and reclaim a CFP installation that had been taken by Headhunters. 

The group that's currently occupying the outpost is being led by ‹Target Name›, a Headhunter of some note who's had a history of aggression against locals and CFP volunteers.

We need all Headhunters secured and ‹Target Name› taken out.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

title: Taking Back Our Goods
description:
Some upstarts hit my hauling crew on their way to do a delivery. Our tracker is telling us that our ship’s still located at <EM4>‹Location›</EM4> so I need you to head over there and get the cargo. You’ll need <EM4>a heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> to lug the goods from the ship.

I’d bet that whoever attacked us is still there waiting. Arm up, bring your crew, and if you can, give them one from me.

Once you’ve taken back our goods, drop it off at the freight elevator located at <EM4>‹Destination›</EM4>.

-Twitch

title: Taking down a XenoThreat Hideout
description:
Got a juicy assignment for any big-time enforcers who want to clear a big payday. Over at ‹Location› we got some XenoThreat turf run by a real bastard named ‹Target Name›. Now if you've been in the system long enough, you've probably either heard of ‹Target Name› or at least seen their work. Skag has a tendency to leaves bodies wherever they go.

Anyway, Judge wants this area swept clean, that means you gotta hit all three clusters and kill every XenoThreat dirt you find. Kill enough and ‹Target Name› won't be able to hide.

Take them all out and have one on us.

Stows out.

title: Taking out some XenoThreat trash
description:
Just got clearance from my Judge to start banging back against XenoThreat. Been eyeballing some spots under their control near ‹Location›.

I'll give you the targets to hit, you kill everyone you find. Hell, I'd love to go myself, sounds like fun.

-Stows

title: Taking what’s ours
description:
Managed to intercept a ship carrying some goods over at <EM4>‹Location›</EM4> but we hit a snag - our guys didn’t have enough space in their ships to store it. You wanna make some quick creds? Head over there and grab the stuff. Could be a few scavs there by now so be on your guard.

Just don’t forget to bring a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> as that shit’s heavy.

When you’re done, drop it off at the freight elevator at <EM4>‹Destination›</EM4> and we’ll take care of the rest.

Stows out.

title: Taking XenoThreat Turf
description:
Need some good soldiers with a taste for violence to hit some XenoThreat hideouts located around ‹Location›. I'll get you the specifics if you're down, but you'll have to wipe out two separate clusters of hideouts. 

We've also gotten word that ‹Target Name› is lurking around down there. If you take out enough XenoThreat dirtbags, they'll pop they're head up. 

When they do, put a round in it.

Stows out.

title: Target at ‹Location›
description:
There's a nest that needs to be taken out around ‹Location› that has been taken over by some squatters. We don't care about most of them, but word's gotten back to us that they're sheltering ‹Target Name› who has a long history of stealing Headhunter loot. Time's come to take them out.

Word is that ‹Target Name› is in a ship, but may rely on the base's defenses to protect them, so be careful. You kill 'em, you get paid. 

You know, the usual.

Stows out.

title: Target takedown for a fast track in
description:
So here's the deal, Headhunters are looking to expand their talent pool and have a few openings for anyone who's got the stones.

There's a real piece of work named ‹Target Name› who thinks they've been really clever pinching cargo off of haulers moving through the system. We asked for a cut of their profits as a licensing tax to continue operating. When ‹Target Name› responded, they were very disrespectful.

We've tracked their ship to ‹Location› and need them taken out. You should know, they're being smart and sticking close to some allies so they won't be alone.

Do this and we'll consider you for future Headhunter work.

Stows out.

title: Target: XenoThreat Attack Group
description:
We have a fix on a XenoThreat Idris with fighter support at <EM4>‹Location›</EM4>. Their comms discipline's lousy. According to the radio chatter, the Commander's on board the Idris. Can't remember the last time we had such a strong fix on him. This could be a chance to decapitate the whole operation. 

Want in?

Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

title: Teach Citizens for Prosperity A Lesson
description:
Every day it seems like Citizens for Prosperity is out here trying to snatch up more people for their shitty little cause and make life more difficult for hardworkin' folks like ourselves. 

I figure they could use a reminder about who really is in charge here. Head to ‹Location› and really mess the place up. 

Nothing like a bit of property damage to get a point across.

-Stows out

title: Terminate UEE Threat: ‹Target Name›
description:
MISSION SPECS

Area of Operation: ‹Location›
Hostile Forces: Outlaws
Equipment Specs: Heavy Gun-Ship
Briefing: An outlaw fleet lead by <EM4>‹Target Name›</EM4> has been planning a major strike against vital UEE infrastructure. InterSec has been tasked with dealing with this threat before their attack can be launched.

Gather a suitable amount of support craft and head to the engagement site. There you will have to engage with various squadrons before their leader will deem the situation dire enough to directly lead their forces. It is critical that they be neutralized in order to ensure the attack is stopped.

Respectfully, 

Deacon Tobin 
Operations Manager 
InterSec Defense Solutions  

This communication consists of a non-binding offer that upon acceptance may be immediately terminated by either party without any given notice. All operations are conducted at the contractor’s own personal risk and must adhere to system law where applicable.

title: Terrorist ‹Target Name› to be Neutralized
description:
MISSION SPECS

Area of Operation: Nyx System
Hostile Forces: Outlaws
Equipment Specs: Combat-rated Ships
Briefing: InterSec has identified more outlaws who are planning an operation against UEE interests from within Nyx. Your mission will be to neutralize this potential threat before they can enact their plans.

Travel to <EM4>‹Location›</EM4> and dispatch the leader of these outlaws, <EM4>‹Target Name›</EM4> without hesitation. We have scouted a small number of ships, but our report suggest these are competent pilots - <EM4>bringing back up is advised.</EM4>

Remember that eliminating these outlaws not only serves the people of Nyx, but the UEE too.

Respectfully,

Deacon Tobin
Operations Manager
InterSec Defense Solutions

This communication consists of a non-binding offer that upon acceptance may be immediately terminated by either party without any given notice. All operations are conducted at the contractor’s own personal risk and must adhere to system law where applicable.

title: Test Armor
description: Bring me armor and other things and I give you special test armor. First version. Very special. Bring and I give. Bye.

title: Test Your Mettle
description:
Heahunters are on the lookout for motivated and competent contractors who can be trusted to do a wide range of work supporting our operations. If you think you have what it takes, I’ve got a mission here that’ll test your skills in several ways. 

A ‹Ship› transporting cargo for us is currently under attack at ‹Location›. Don’t think it’s looking good for our ship, but that cargo is too important to let fall into someone else’s hands. Need you to head to the location and deal with the attackers before they get away, then collect our cargo and take it to ‹Destination›. 

If you can handle this, then there'll be lots more work I can send your way.  

Stows out.

title: The Price of Freedom
description:
Here’s the deal - A couple of long timers got snagged pulling a job for me and I want you to spring them. 

A friendly mechanic has arranged for their prison transport to run into some trouble en route, venting the front door and bringing the ship to a halt. You’re gonna go, dispatch any security escorting the transport, find the prisoner manifest aboard, and use it to locate my crew’s cryopods.

The popsicles I’m after are ‹Name Save 2›, ‹Name Kill 1›, ‹Name Save 3›, and ‹Name Save 1›. All have been loyal and deserve better than rotting in jail.

At least I think they've been loyal... I'm still wondering how they got pinched in the first place. I can't shake the feeling that one of them may have been doubling dealing. Tell you what, if you find any proof that one of my crew has been working with the Advocacy, liquidate their cryopod and I’ll see you get a bonus. 

Once you've activated the right pods and my people are starting to thaw, get the hell out of there and let the retrieval team handle the rest. This last bit is important. See, once they’re defrosted, they're gonna be sent off to retirement. No sense in them knowing any more about my business than they already do, i.e. I don’t want these lunks seeing your face or even knowing you exist. 

Once you’re back on your way, I’ll send you a hefty pile of well deserved creds.

Now just in case you’re getting any ideas along the lines of “Why don’t I just free everyone?” or “Wouldn’t it be easier to shut them all up permanently?” Forget it. The politics of this whole thing is more complicated than you need to know. Just trust me when I say that if any extra prisoners get freed or die without me ordering it, you’ll be the one who pays. Want all your money? Do what you’re told and that’s it. 

-Twitch

title: Time to Teach a Lesson
description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Ship Ambush
APPROVAL CODE = ‹Approval Code›

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

A client of ours has been receiving anonymous threats in an attempt to blackmail them, and after a bit of leg work on our part, we’ve managed to trace it back to an individual who pilots a particular <EM4>‹Ambush Target›</EM4>. The client wants us to take care of this blackmailer before they have a chance to make good. 

Based on our assessment, the target shouldn’t be too difficult to handle. They fly by <EM4>Asteroid Mining Base</EM4> on the regular, which has an <EM4>emission cloud</EM4> that’s an ideal spot to power down your ship and lie in wait. Sometimes the target is alone but they often travel with other single-seat ships as protection. Best be strategic when you launch your ambush or the <EM4>‹Ambush Target›</EM4> could have a chance to get away. We don’t want to lose this one. We’ll alert other contractors in the area of the ambush so they can come help once it pops off.     

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract. The client has also added a bonus payment of <EM4>‹Scrip Amount› MG Scrip</EM4> for the main contractor.

This contract is non-negotiable.

A double hit can sound complicated, but if you hire some additional guns it shouldn't be all that hard to do two hits simultaneously.

Make sure you find folks who have skills as I have it on good authority that each'll be flying with some escorts for "protection."

title: Too Smart For Our Own Good
description:
We were a little too smart with this one and it’s kinda backfired. Sometimes you gotta dream big, you know? Anyway. we were looking to move some encrypted data to one of our data havens and decided to hide it in a ship’s blackbox. They filled the ship with “valuable” stuff as a decoy in case it got attacked. The plan worked a little too well and the cargo might have attracted the wrong kind of attention. They stole all the cargo but missed the blackbox. Bad news is the ship is now swarming with outlaws.

The data on that blackbox is useless to them, but we need it. If you can get it back for us, we can give you a nice cut from what we make. Seems like a fair deal, right?

Head to <EM4>‹Location›</EM4> and after you’ve done your thing take the flight recorder to <EM4>[Destination|Target|Address]</EM4>.

-Bit Zeros

description:
Some of my people were involved with a raid over at ‹Location›. Most of them got out clean, but after the dust settled nobody is sure of what happened to ‹Target Name›.

A lot of other gangs would just leave the poor bastard to rot, but that’s not the way the Headhunters do things. I want to know for sure if ‹Target Name› is alive or dead and I’m willing to pay you good credits to find out.

Just be careful when you get there because I bet the assholes who live there are still gunning for a fight.

title: Track Down ‹Target Name›
description:
A few days back I dispatched ‹Target Name› to scope out a cave system for potential use as a storehouse. Haven't heard from them since. 

My gut tells me they ran into trouble. The local wildlife isn't known for being friendly, and ‹Target Name› isn't exactly known for being cautious. If you're in need of some creds, I'm offering some up for anyone who can get in there and figure out what happened. 

Stows out.

Eugene Walton
Foxwell Enforcement

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

title: Track Down Gang Member
description:
XenoThreat has placed a kill order on ‹Target Name›. As a Clips level member of the Headhunters gang, ‹Target Name› has led operations that have targeted XenoThreat operatives, missions, and infrastructure. For these transgressions, XenoThreat will pay anyone who successfully tracks down and assassinates ‹Target Name›.  

LOCATION UPDATE: ‹Target Name› was seen near ‹Location› not too long ago.  If you decide to accept this contract, you should head to the coordinates immediately. ‹Target Name› knows we’re looking for ‘em and has been traveling with an escort recently. Don’t be surprised if they’re not alone.

Comm. Spec. Engler

description:

LOCATION UPDATE: Recent scans identified ‹Target Name› traveling with other ships near ‹Location›. 

Comm. Spec. Engler

title: Track Down Traitor

title: Trigger A Trap
description:
Some asshole going by the name ‹Target Name› has been running a scheme where their cargo ship requests refueling services only to ambush our ships when they get there. Even loaded the damn thing up with real cargo to make sure it passes scans. We’ve spread the word so nobody in Rough & Ready will fall for the trap again, but I want this skag punished. 

I think ‹Target Name› knows a lot of our people on sight, so I’m guessing it’ll be better to pay you to take care of it. Heard that they were spotted around ‹Location›. Head there now and take care of that cargo ship and anyone protecting it once and for all. 

- Smokey

title: Turf War
description:
One of our Judges caught wind of XenoThreat trying to move in on our territory. Seems like they’re trying to take over Shadowfall. We don’t want to let those psychos get any more of a foothold in system than they already have, so we’re putting some creds on the line to get ‘em to back off.

We want you to come down on them hard. Don’t let up till the whole place is a graveyard. We’ll send your payment once the bodies are ready to bury.

- Stows out.

title: Turn Things to Favor
description:
Maybe Wikelo not have something you want made (that strange, but okay). Old souli would give out <EM4>favors</EM4>, very good way to prove that you do work for me. Collect enough and trade when I have something you want.

Bring things to <EM4>‹destination›</EM4> and will trade for favor.

Bye.

title: twice the headache
description:
Have another pair that needs simultaneous deathing. Seems to be getting more and more popular as a murder option. 

This time it's ‹Target Name› and ‹Target Name 2›. Both are supposed to be pretty skilled operators and they won't be flying alone. 

I'd make sure whoever you get to help you on this one can handle a fight.

title: Two Birds, One Stone
description:
An informant passed along some interesting news. XenoThreat are about to do a massive ammo resupply run for their forces, and in preparation, they’ve brought all that cargo to ‹Location›. Seems like a prime time to strike. You interested in killing a bunch of Xenos and then stealing their ammo for us?    

If so, get your shit in order and then clear that base. Once done, grab all the ammo and bring it to Last Landings. You’ll get paid well, and I’m sure we’ll find something fun to do with all that ammo. 

Stows out.

title: two for the price of two
description:
‹Target Name› and ‹Target Name 2›. I think they may be related? Or dating? Doesn't really matter, someone wants them killed. 

I've arranged it so that you can hit them when they're not flying together. Safer for you this way. They are both serious business and fly with equally serious backup.

Make sure you and your crew time your attacks. I don't want one of them left alive or it's going to be a real headache.

title: Two In The Head
description:
Contract's for two targets that need to be taken out at the same time. 

Guess the client is worried that if they aren't eliminated together, one of them will go dark and try to get some revenge.

They go by ‹Target Name› and ‹Target Name 2›.

Find yourself a team, divide and conquer.

And make sure whoever it is has got skills, because these two have a reputation for holding their own in a fight and they for sure won't be alone. Be ready for them to give you some trouble.

title: Unauthorized Surveillance Detected
description: ‹Contractor›

title: Unexpected Inheritance
description:
Hey,

So this is a little awkward for me to talk about, but it turns out that one of the people who passed away on that Covalex station disaster, Kyomi Santos, actually bequeathed me something in her will. I was surprised to hear it, but apparantly I'm now the proud owner of everything stored in box #173. The people at Covalex say I'll be able to get it when the station opens back up but ... this is the awkward part ... I kind of really need it right now. Normally I'd just wait, but I'm trying to start my own business (I make cakes in the shape of people's homeworlds) and the credits I get from selling it will really be a huge help. I've got a little bit stashed away now that I can use to pay for someone to deliver it from Gundo to ‹Destination› for me. I know the whole things a little bit irregular, but if there was any other way I wouldn't be asking.

Thanks for the help,
Thrace

title: Unfinished Contract
description:
Here's the deal, one of our usual heavy hitters, a cat named ‹Target Name›, was sent to Shadowfall to knock out some XenoThreat who'd been hiding there. We knew it was going to be a tall order, but that's why we called in ‹Target Name›. Problem is, we ain't heard from them.

As far as we know XenoThreat are still operating out of that outpost so we gotta assume that ‹Target Name› got popped. We need you to go in and finish what they started. Once that's done, if you can find out what happened to ‹Target Name›, that would be a bonus.

Stows out.

title: Unwanted Guests
description:
We got some outlaws overstaying their welcome on one of our stations. They tried to pull a fast one on us but now they’re trapped in ‹location›. We need you to clear ‘em out. 

Rough & Ready doesn’t want a single one of them left alive when you’re through. Don’t care how messy it gets as long as it gets done, got it?

- Smokey

title: Up in Smoke
description:
We’ve been trying to access some sensitive data over at ‹Location› but there seems to only be one backdoor we can use. The issue is we need someone onsite to trigger it. And I really do mean trigger it.

If you can head over there and destroy part of their infrastructure, the emergency back up systems will kick online and we should be able to access everything we want. 

Wish I could see the surprise look on the faces of the lowlifes running the place when it happens.

-Bit Zeros

title: Upgrade Intrepid
description: If you are looking for Intrepid ship that more intrepid. Wikelo can help. Bring things and you will get special touches on ship by Wikelo and pretty new coat to it. Bye.

title: Urgent - Ship Under XenoThreat Attack
description:
A distress beacon came in from <EM4>‹Location›</EM4> about a ship under attack from XenoThreat. The pilot reports that their shields are failing and they can't outrun the attackers.

The ship's a <EM4>‹Ship›</EM4>, but the pilot's Human, which  according to XenoThreat's twisted way of thinking, makes them a traitor to Humanity and a target for their hate.

We're looking for operators to head out there and do some good.

Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

title: URGENT CAPITAL FLEET REFUEL
enemyShips: Anvil F7C-M Super Hornet Mk I
Anvil F7C-R Hornet Tracker Mk I
description:
DD here - I've got something special for you,

I just received a ping from <EM4>Asteroid Mining Base</EM4>. A strike force led by a ‹Ship› just dropped into the system and are looking for a fast refuel before heading back out. 

They  need <EM4>‹Hydrogen Fuel› SCU of Hydrogen and ‹QTFuel› SCU of Quantum Fuel</EM4> asap and will pay <EM4>‹Fuel Rate› aUEC per SCU of Hydrogen</EM4> and  <EM4>‹QTFuel Rate› aUEC per SCU of Quantum</EM4> for it. As a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

I won't lie - I'm more than a little jealous. Getting up close and personal to a ship that big? Should be one to tell the grandkids about.

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"

title: URGENT CONVOY REFUEL
description:
Hey again,

I've got a beacon at <EM4>‹Location›</EM4> and this one's a bit more complicated than usual. Got small convoy of ships requesting <EM4>‹Hydrogen Fuel› SCU of Hydrogen Fuel</EM4>. Impressive coordination and lack of planning to all need refueling at the same time. 

The client will pay you at the rate of <EM4>‹Fuel Rate› aUEC per SCU of Hydrogen</EM4>, and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

Hopefully since the area they're in is pretty safe, there shouldn't be too much trouble lurking, but these days you never know. Wouldn't hurt to get them back flying again as quick as you're able.

Happy trails,

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"

title: URGENT REFUEL REQUEST: ‹Ship›
enemyShips: Anvil F7C-M Super Hornet Mk I
Anvil F7C-R Hornet Tracker Mk I
Anvil F7C-S Hornet Ghost Mk I
description:
Hey, you!

I've got a beacon at <EM4>Asteroid Mining Base</EM4>. They say their tanks are running dry and they could use ‹Fuel Type›. If you're interested, I get the feeling they'll be really pleased to see you.

The client vessel will pay you at the rate of <EM4>‹Fuel Rate› aUEC per SCU of Hydrogen</EM4> and  <EM4>‹QTFuel Rate› aUEC per SCU of Quantum</EM4>, and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

They're stuck out in an area with a bad reputation, though things have been a bit more quiet recently. Still worth staying alert I'd say, just in case there's still trouble lurking out there. 

Either way, the sooner everyone's able to get flying again - and that includes you - the better.

Happy trails,

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"

title: URGENT: Boarding Action In Progress
description:
An executive client just informed us that their 890 Jump had been intercepted at ‹Location› and boarded by outlaws. They would prefer to have this handled privately owing to the sensitive nature of proprietary data that's being stored aboard. 

Your first priority will be to clear all outlaws as quickly as possible so that a recovery team can be dispatched to return the ship to the owner. The longer the outlaws have control of the vessel, the higher the chance it will be lost. I recommend you acquire a team for this outing to expedite matters. 

Note that thanks to a small contingent of Security Personnel who stayed aboard, all surviving members of the crew were able to flee in an escape craft. The current status of the remaining security is unknown, but just in case, keep an eye out for friendlies when you engage the hostiles.

Secondly, if at all possible, the client is *very* interested in preventing the theft of the aforementioned data. If you are able to stop the theft of their confidential data stores before they are transmitted, a generous bonus will be issued.

Needless to say, this is a client I would very much like to keep happy. 

Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

title: URGENT: Retake Security Post Kareah
description:
Security Post Kareah is under attack by an unknown number of assailants. 

Crusader is seeking contractors to quickly travel to the station and eliminate all trespassers in the vicinity before our security forces are overwhelmed.  

We’re not sure whether the attackers are targeting the contraband in our evidence lockup or our CrimeStat database, but whatever they’re after, they need to be dealt with. You will receive a combat bonus for each target neutralized.  

By accepting this contract, you agree to abide by all Crusader Security protocols: If you harm any guards or other authorized contractors while on the station, your contract will be terminated and you will be marked as a target. 

Time is of the essence, but make sure you’re well equipped to handle the hostiles before responding. 

CONTRACT AUTHORIZED BY: 
Liaison Officer Bautista 
ID# 948J030K

title: UWC'S HIRING REFUELERS
description:
Hey!

DD from the United Wayfarers Club here.

The UWC offers repair, rearming and refueling services across the UEE. It just so happens that we're on the look-out for new affiliates whose ships are fitted for refueling. If you've got the fuel pods and like it when people are pleased to see you, the UWC might be the club for you.

And if you think it might be, I've got a live beacon you might like.

If you do happen to like it, a word to the wise: <EM4>make sure your fuel pods are full before you head out</EM4>.

A Club member has run out of <EM4>‹Hydrogen Fuel› SCU of Hydrogen Fuel</EM4> at <EM4>Asteroid Mining Base</EM4>. I'm not sure on the details, like how they ended up out there with no Go Juice, but the UWC doesn't like to leave folk hanging.

The client vessel will pay you at the rate of <EM4>‹Fuel Rate› aUEC per SCU of Hydrogen</EM4> and  <EM4>‹QTFuel Rate› aUEC per SCU of Quantum</EM4>. As a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

It's a straightforward run. Perfect if you want to get a feel for this kind of job. Get out there, fill up the tanks of their <EM4>‹Ship›</EM4> and get them on their way. Do enough runs like this, and the process becomes muscle memory. Until then, there's a <EM4>journal entry</EM4> on your mobiGlas called "Refueling Protocols" that covers the basics.

There have been no reports of outlaw activity in that sector, but stay alert. I always recommend you aim for a fast turnaround. The sooner you're done, the sooner I can fix you up with another contract. UWC's always looking for new affiliates. 

Looking forward to working with you.

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"

title: Verified Freelancer Bounty Assessment
description:
In an effort to increase the safety of Crusader and its environs, Crusader Security is seeking qualified individuals to assist with the collection of bounties in the area. 

We have evaluated that you possess the skill set needed and as such, we would like to offer you an initial trial bounty contract for ‹Target Name› last seen at ‹Location›. 

Upon the successful completion of this contract, you will be placed on Crusader's Verified Freelancer list and be eligible for any future bounty collection work as it becomes available.

CONTRACT AUTHORIZED BY:
Liaison Officer Bautista
ID# 948J030K

title: Verified Freelancer Bounty Reassessment
description:
Good news! Crusader Security has decided to offer you another chance at being a bounty contractor. We are hoping that during this time you have corrected any past performance issues and can once again be a useful asset.

First though, we are required to reevaluate you, and as such, would like you to complete this bounty contract for ‹Target Name›. 

Upon the successful completion of this trial, you'll be restored to Crusader's Verified Freelancer list and be eligible for any future bounty collection work as it becomes available.

CONTRACT AUTHORIZED BY:
Liaison Officer Bautista
ID# 948J030K

title: Verify Deceased Criminal: ‹Target Name›
description:
Hockrow Agency 
Case File #MP70001
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Summary: 
In need of a highly competent operator for a special assignment. A highly dangerous outlaw that has been evading local authorities for some time has been reported to have been involved in a large-scale ship battle, resulting in their supposed death. Our client wishes to confirm that they have been neutralized.

Contract Investigator Actions:
We require you to head to <EM4>‹Location›</EM4> locate <EM4>‹Target Name›</EM4>’s body and confirm their death.

Additional Notes:
Serious preparation is advised for this contract as there is a strong potential for there to be highly aggressive and dangerous hostiles still on site. Arm yourself accordingly and consider bring other skilled pilots with you.

title: Very Hungry
description:
You humans keep Wikelo very busy. Work more than when I at old souli. But Wikelo very hungry now and can't get food.

Please help. Bring food and drink to Wikelo Emporium at <EM4>‹destination›</EM4>.

Very appreciate your help. Will give thing in return.

Bye.

title: Very Long Distance Covalex Delivery Stanton
description:
Hiya,

Covalex requires a safe pair of hands to pick up some packages and get them where they need to go.

Designating this a long distance delivery so stock up on fuel and supplies. And definitely make sure you bring a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4>.

As for what ship to bring, you'll also need something that can move <EM4>1 SCU cargo containers</EM4>.

‹Contractor›

Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

title: VIP Client Needs Protection
enemyShips: Anvil F7C-R Hornet Tracker Mk I
Anvil F7C-S Hornet Ghost Mk I
description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Escort Ship
Approval code: = ‹Approval Code›

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

In need of a contractor who can report in now. A client has found themselves in hot water over at <EM4>Asteroid Mining Base</EM4> and a protection detail to get away from an asteroid base. They’ve reported multiple, well-armed hostile ships meaning you’ll need a crew of your own to deal with them. Based on the client’s account, these attackers seem highly motivated so they will likely not back down easily.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

title: Vital Resources Needed For Research

requires.title: Interested in Building a Better Future?

description:
To all available contractors,

Rayari scientists are hard at work trying to solve the issues with failing regen tech. Currently, their efforts are hindered by a lack of three resources essential for their experiments: <EM4>saldynium, jaclium, and carinite</EM4>.  

In particular, our scientists at <EM4>‹Destination›</EM4> have had to put their work on hold after running out of those resources. With a restock from our normal provider not possible for months owing to short supply, we’ll pay a premium to anyone who can assist with restocking the materials.

Though we haven’t been able to do thorough scans, there’s a strong belief among our teams that Hathor’s defunct Orbital Laser Platforms were built above areas with a high concentration of these resources. Reactivating these OLP could be your best hope of acquiring what we need.

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing

title: Wanna be a Headhunter?
description:
You know us. You know what we do. System’s getting a little crowded, so we’re looking for some good soldiers to help keep our place here.

If you’re up for it and don’t mind getting your hands dirty, we’ve got something to prove you’ve got the stuff we’re looking for.

‹Target Name› was a former member who sold us out to XenoThreat and got some of their brothers and sisters killed. Now they think they can just live their life without consequence.

You take them out. You get boosted in. Sounds like a fair trade.

They’ve been spotted around ‹Location›, so get there and take care of it.

Stows out.

title: Wanted by ArcCorp: ‹Target Name› (ERT)
description:
ATTN: Bounty Hunters

You might have heard of ‹Target Name› before. They’re an extreme-risk target and they’ve been making headlines recently. The hope is you’ll be able to put together a response team and help BlacJac shut them down for good. Our most recent intel has their sub-capital ship and heavily armed escorts flying over at ‹Location›.
 
I’d recommend making sure you’ve got an up-to-date imprint before heading out. Just in case. 

Good luck,
Gloria Mesa

ATTN: Bounty Hunters

Sources indicate that ‹Target Name› is hiding out over at ‹Location›. When you head out to track them down, just make sure you’re prepared. Might even think about bringing along some backup yourself.  

Thanks,
Gloria Mesa

Private Contract Supervisor
BlacJac Security, "Protection Provided"

Speaking of, I’d start the hunt over at ‹Location› since we have reports of them being spotted in the area.

Thanks,
Gloria Mesa

We weren’t able to get details on exactly what they were piloting, but it seems they did have a few other ships with them. Be ready for a fair bit of resistance when you come calling.

Thanks,
Gloria Mesa

title: Wanted: ‹Target Name›
description:
Here's the deal, we just got word that a XenoThreat power player named ‹Target Name› just came out of hiding and was spotted at Shadowfall. 

Headhunters have been hungry to put this asshole in the ground for months, so we launched an assault against the outpost, but the Judge wants to make sure ‹Target Name› doesn't slip away, so they want to use you as insurance.

This'll be a tough kill in the middle of a warzone, but we'll pay out if you pull it off.

Stows out.

title: Wasting Their Stockpile
description:
Look, Headhunters don't waste time on petty revenge, but I'm not about to let this nonsense fly either.

Some asshole took out a bunch of my crew and has been bragging all over about it. I've also heard that this nullbrain is stockpiling quantum fuel over at <EM4>‹Location›</EM4>. I'd like to see how they deal with some real heat when you fly over there and burn everything they've built to the ground. Oh, and with the amount of firepower they got gathered over there, wouldn't be smart to fly alone on this one, so take a crew with you.

-Stows out

You fly and tell. Bye.

title: Where Wolf? Here Wolf

title: Wikelo Arrive to System

unlocks.title: Look at desert but don't see you

description:
Hello, I am Wikelo. Recent addition to your system and very excited to be here. Spent many time here in UEE and happy to spent more.

Have place where I make things from other things.

Need person to bring me useful things to finish project I work on. You have list. Get, please. I am at <EM4>‹destination›</EM4>.

Will give you item for your help.

Also, when done, if you want to do more. Have many things can make in my humble shop. Come, look at pretty poster and then decide what you want me to make.

Bye.

title: Wikelo Navy F7
description: Know how much you Humans like Navy so Wikelo have one now. If you want Wikelo version of F7 mk2, bring me things and you are in. Very funny. Bye.

title: Wildlife Control: ‹Creature›
description:
ABOUT THE JOB
microTech Protection Services need a professional to bring the number of ‹Creature› in the wild back to within acceptable parameters. Their population is increasing too quickly, and culling some of their numbers will help ensure the situation doesn’t spiral out of control.

RESPONSIBILITIES
• Provide own transportation.
• Locate the ‹Creature› on ‹Location›.
• Use force as necessary to eliminate the ‹Creature›.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
• 1 year of relevant mercenary and/or security experience.
• Access to combat equipment.
• Available for immediate deployment.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
• Experience with extermination

For more information on the animals in question, refer to "The Guide to Stanton Wildlife" in your Journal.

title: Wildlife Population Adjustment
description:
ABOUT THE JOB
microTech Protection Services need a professional to eliminate several creatures of various species. This is a preventative measure to ensure their population size doesn’t increase beyond acceptable parameters.

RESPONSIBILITIES
• Provide own transportation. 
• Locate the target species on ‹Location›.
• Use force as necessary to eliminate the animals.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
• 1 year of relevant mercenary and/or security experience.
• Access to combat equipment.
• Available for immediate deployment.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
• Experience with extermination.

For more information on the animals in question, refer to "The Guide to Stanton Wildlife" in your Journal.

title: Wipe Citizens for Prosperity Data Farm
description:
Turns out those Citizens for Prosperity bastards have been gathering intel on us. They're going to try to cut us off from several revenue streams and bleed us dry. Can't let that happen. 

Head to ‹Location› and destroy their data storage. 

That should teach them not to stick their noses where they don't belong.

-Stows out

title: Wipe Out Drug Stash
description:
ATTN: Verified Mercenary Operators

It seems there’s a new operator trying their hand at manufacturing drugs over at ‹Location›, but the product they’re putting out is extremely toxic. 

We’re sorting through how to handle the arrests, but the important thing is to prevent any more of their supply getting distributed. I need you to get down there and destroy the drugs they’re storing on site.

There's a good chance the facility isn't abandoned, so you might run into these thugs when you head down there, so be ready for a fight. But if their gun skills are anything like their chemistry, it probably won’t be much of one. 

Thanks,
Gloria Mesa

Private Contract Supervisor
BlacJac Security, "Protection Provided"

title: Wipe Out XenoThreat Servers
description:
Something just fell into my lap that is way too good to pass up. XenoThreat's intelligence gathering is a bit of legend in the circles I run in and it turns out that they're storing a whole heap of their best intel at Scraper's Turn.

title: Worth the trouble
description:

Stows out.

There are only a few known locations where these materials can be sourced, mainly from now defunct Hathor Group sites on <EM4>Daymar and Aberdeen</EM4>.
